title: Tho meni tho mi kum
content:
1.	Tho meni tho mi kum, e tho ma nja de ngo, 
    Tic pare thum. 
    Kume mae m’utop wadwoke ndhu i ng’om, 
    Enwang’u yom ma nja, enwang’u yom. 
 
2.	Tho meni tho mi kum, e tho ma nja de ngo, 
    Can pare thum. 
    Eyom i vut Yesu, eyom i vut Yesu, 
    Enwang’u yom ma nja, enwang’u yom. 
 
3.	Tho meni tho mi kum, e tho ma nja de ngo, 
    Bicer kendo. 
    Yesu m’uvoyo tho biloko kume do, 
    En de biai i liel, biai kendo. 
 
4.	 Tho meni tho mi kum, e tho ma nja de ngo, 
     Eni polo. 
     Ebedo k’anyong’a i kwo ma nja ku nja, 
     I polo ba Jalar Yesu Kristu.

title: Ka tic para bithum i ng’om
content:
1.  Ka tic para bithum i ng’om mae, e abiai, 
    Abicidho mal’ i polo ka ma ber; 
    Abineno Jalarna kan atundo bang’e ca, 
    Ebijola ber ma ku mutoro kwa. 
 
           Abinene, abing’eye, 
           Poyotiende ku cinge de binen; 
           Abing’eyo E Jalarna, 
           Ma jugure kor yen nibodhowa. 
 
2.  Man anyong’a binega kan awok i vute ca, 
     Ka wanendra wang’ ku wang’ i ka ma leng’, 
     Abipake kum kisa, ku mer pare dit andha, 
     Kum kabedo ma eyiko ira nja. 
 
3.  E juwadwa ma nuti kuca gibifoyo dit, 
     Ka wanendra kugi kendo ka ma leng’; 
     Ebiyweyo piwang’wa, can mwa de birwinyo kpo, 
     Wabi foyo kum waneno Yesu cu. 
 
4.  Abimondo i polo de ku kendi ma tar pu, 
     Ma Jalarna ronya kude ma leng’ njwa; 
     Rimbe lonyo jupare e gibedo leng’ mandha, 
     E gidoko jucampacu kude nja.

title: ‘Tis so Sweet
content:
1.	E ber dit ya wagen Yesu, wan wageno rimbe ndhu.
    Kum Elwoko cwinywa ceke tek wayio Yesune.

              Yesu, Yesu, wan wagene, wan wayio lem pare. 
              Yesu, Yesu, e Jalar mwa, wan wakio dwogone. 

2.	 E ber dit ya wan wagene, wawek dubo ceke cen.
      Kum wageno Yesu, ketho wabed kwo, e cwinywa kwi.

3.	 Tin wabedo kud anyong’a, kum wageno Rwoth Yesu.
     E Jalarwa, e Jarimbwa, Ebibedo bang’wa nja.

title: Pak mandha bed ni Mungu
content:
Pak mandha bed ni Mungu, 
Ku Wode, ku Tipo Maleng’ bende; 
En etie i thangambere, 
Bibedo de ndhu rondo, Mungu mi kwo, Amen, Amen.

title: Yesu Jalar dong' wupake
content:
1.  Yesu Jalar dong’ wupake, 
     Gin m’etimo ng’a ma ng’eyo? 
     Ang’o ma waculo ire? 
     Ndhu gin mwa ceke. 
 
2.  Yesu, nyinge mir anyong’a, 
     En Ubimo ma jabang’wa, 
     Nyinge mio tego iwa, 
     Tek warwo kude. 
 
3.  Wugen Yesu, wu Jukristu, 
     Kum ewaruwu ku rimbe; 
     Ebikurowu ceng’ ceke, 
     Kum elokre ngo. 
 
4.  Gwokwa Yesu, wa juperi, 
      Watim iri kum wameri, 
      Tek wacung i lembe peri 
      Ibijolowa. 
 
5.  Ceng’ ma wabitund’ i beng’i 
      Wabibedo leng’ i weng’i, 
      Wabipeki de ndhu rondo 
      Kuca i polo.

title: Wafoyo Mungu, en m’emaruwa dit
content:
1.  Wafoyo Mungu, en m’emaruwa dit, 
    Kum Yesu ma Wode, m’emio iwa. 
 
              Wan wafoyo Yesu Kristu,  
              Wan wafoyo Yesu: 
              Wan wafoyo Wod Mungu, 
              Wafoyo Yesu. 
 
2.  Wafoyo Jalar, en m’ewacu kumae, 
     Ebimio kwo pare ni ju m’uyie. 
 
3.  Wafoyo Jajuk, en m’ebedo bang’wa 
     En m’enenowa ceke, emaruwa dit.

title: Pak Mungu, won gin ma ber kpo
content:
1.	Pak Mungu, won gin ma ber kpo 
    Pake wu dhanu yu mi ng’om; 
    Jumalaika pake malu, 
    Pak Wego, Wod, Tipo Maleng’, 
 
2.	Wu dhanu ma wuyie kpo, 
    Mond i ot pare ku pake; 
    Wubin bang’e ku mutoro, 
    Wuyung Mungu wupak nyinge. 
 
3.	Rwoth Yesu e Mungu mandha, 
    Ecwiowa ku tegone; 
    Tek wayie, ejolowa, 
    Ekwayuwa ni rombene. 
 
4.	Rwoth Mungu en E jabero 
    E jakisa en E jammer; 
    E jakony mwa, E jatel yo, 
    E jalar mwa, jakwach ma ber.

title: Doxology
content:
1.	E mer pa Mungu dit apila, wacopo pore tak de ngo;
    Ekadhu malu ku wi cero, man cil i tipopiny mi tho.
    Ju ma gisendri dit i dubo, Rwoth Yesu tho pigi de,
    Elwong’ogi gibin i bang’e, Ewek dubo migi pet.

               E mer pa Mungu dit apila, wacopo pore de ngo.
               Ju ma pwe ceke gibifoyo, mer pare cil nja ku nja.
            
2.	Ker ceke ma ni keni i ng’om, ku lonyone binyothri pet.
    Ju ma gikwero rwo ni Mungu, ndiri bimakugi ma gwei.
    Man mer pa Mungu bijwik de ngo, birem de ngo cil mi nja.
Bero ma copo bodho dhanu, eromo pak nja ku nja.

3.	Kadok jupong’o ng’om ku polo, ku lembe ma jugoro ngi
    Pi mer pa Mungu yor i bang’wa, m’Enyutho iwa i Wode;
    Jucopo ninyutho tak de ngo, dit mi mer pare bang’wa.
    Kitabu ceke ma jukiewo, binyutho ng’ete kende.

title: Ubimo ma dwong’ wapek
content:
1.	Ubimo ma dwong’ wapeki, 
    Yesu Kristu, Wod Mungu; 
    Wan ceke, warum i weng’i, 
    In I dwong’ ma sagu kpo. 
    In ikendi m’iromo, Kum tic peri ceke cu.  
 
2.	Ubimo ma dwong’ wapeki, 
    Yang’ jukweri, juguri; Ento tho ivoyo ceke, 
    Tin in I jacampacu. 
    In ikendi m’iromo, Kum itho pi dhanu yu. 
 
3.	Ubimo ma dwong’ wapeki, 
    Mungu m’umeri ketho 
    Kwong’ mi dubo mwa i wii, 
    Dwoki lam mi dubo kpo. 
    In ikendi m’iromo, Kum ivoyo tho iwa. 
 
4.	Ubimo ma dwong’ wapeki, 
    Kum icer kind ju m’utho; Kristu pa 
    Mungu wayungi, Ibibimo dhanu yu. 
    In ikendi m’iromo, Kum I Rwoth mi rodhi kpo.

title: The Love of God
content:
1.	E mer pa Mungu dit apila, wacopo pore tak de ngo;
    Ekadhu malu ku wi cero, man cil i tipopiny mi tho.
    Ju ma gisendri dit i dubo, Rwoth Yesu tho pigi de,
    Elwong’ogi gibin i bang’e, Ewek dubo migi pet.

                E mer pa Mungu dit apila, wacopo pore de ngo.
                Ju ma pwe ceke gibifoyo, mer pare cil nja ku nja.

2.	Ker ceke ma ni keni i ng’om, ku lonyone binyothri pet.
    Ju ma gikwero rwo ni Mungu, ndiri bimakugi ma gwei.
    Man mer pa Mungu bijwik de ngo, birem de ngo cil mi nja.
    Bero ma copo bodho dhanu, eromo pak nja ku nja.

3.	Kadok jupong’o ng’om ku polo, ku lembe ma jugoro ngi
    Pi mer pa Mungu yor i bang’wa, m’Enyutho iwa i Wode;
    Jucopo ninyutho tak de ngo, dit mi mer pare bang’wa.
    Kitabu ceke ma jukiewo, binyutho ng’ete kende.

title: Alogo tin kugweno
content:
1.  Alogo tin kugweno, alonyo cinga dre,  
    Amiogi ni Yesu nitimo tic ire. 
 
            Tienda, dong’ ikuri ka m’icidh’ i ie  
            Wek atim ni Yesu gin m’eyenyo re. 
 
2.  Dong’ itha wuwinj Yesu m’enyutho tic ira,  
     Kara cinga tim ire, atim kud anyong’a. 
 
3.  Akurogi ku wang’a i tic ku tugo de,  
     Maku agwokgi ber ba, ku ba rupiny ceke!

title: Pak nying’ Rwoth Yesu
content:
1.	Pak nying’ Rwoth Yesu, nying’ ma dwong’ 
    Malaika rum ire; 
    Jamkermiwic waroi wie, 
    Wayunge Rwoth mi rwodhi!     
    Jamkermiwic waroi wie, 
    Wayunge Rwoth mi rwodhi! 
 
2.	Wu piny pare ma piwu tek 
    I wang’ Jawar ma Rwoth, 
    Ekoyowu pi tic ma pwe, 
    Wuyunge Rwoth mi rwodhi!   
    Ekoyowu pi tic ma pwe, 
    Wuyunge Rwoth mi rwodhi! 
 
3.	Wu suru ceke, dhanu yu, 
    M’ubedo kwo i ng’om, 
    Wudode ni ubimo mu, 
    Wuyunge Rwoth mi rwodhi!   
    Wudode ni ubimo mu, 
    Wuyunge Rwoth mi rwodhi! 
 
4.	Ka wabitundo kuca ma 
    Wajwigra the tiendi, 
    Wapeki dit ku wer ma nja,  
    Wayungi, Rwoth mi rwodhi! 
    Wapeki dit ku wer ma nja, 
    Wayungi, Rwoth mi rwodhi!

title: My Jesus I Love Thee
content:
1.	Rwoth Yesu ameri, Itie Rwodha nja,
    Aweko mutoro mi ng’om m’ucida.
    Jarimba ma leng’ Kwe, Jalarna ma cu,
    Kawono ameri ma sagu ma con kpo.

2.	 Ameri Yesu, kum Ilar Imara,
     Ikabu lem dubo m’unuro cwinya.
     Ikendo jamker mir ukudho pira,
     Rwoth Yesu ameri ku mer ma sagu kpo.

3.	 Ameri ma kwo, abimeri k’i tho, 
     K’anyong’a mi cwinya apeki ndhu cu. 
     Tek kuma bivoc maku apeki asu. 
     Rwoth Yesu ameri ku mer ma sagu kpo.

4.	 I udi m’lyiko i polo ma njwa, 
     Abifoyi Rwodha, mutoro mandha. 
     Ku jamker i wia abiwero pak iri, 
     Rwoth Yesu ameri ku mer ma sagu kpo.

title: Tek wukicru kawono
content:
1.	Tek wukicru kawono, 
    Yer nying’ Yesu nying’ ma ber; 
    Ebijukowu k’anyong’a, 
    Ka wuyero nying’ Jalar. 
 
           Nyinge mit, nyinge mit, 
           Nyinge mit m’usagu kpo; 
           Nyinge mit, nyinge mit dit,     
           Nyinge mit m’usagu kpo. 
 
2.	Ka Satani bin’ i beng’wu, 
    Ma eyenyo bidhowu; 
    Yer nying’ Yesu kud i cwinywu, 
    Ebilworowu ndhu. 
 
3.	Ka wacokra mal’ i polo, 
    Wabineno wang’ Yesu; 
    Wabiwero kanga pare, 
    Ebibed’ ubimo ndhu.

title: A Shelter in the Time
content:
1.	Tek lworo nyai i cwinywa dit
    Kapondo mwa e Rwoth Mungu.
    Ekurowa i can ma lic kapondo mwa e Rwoth Mungu.

                E Mungu In i cana :::kapondo mwa!:::
                E Mungu In i cana :::kapondo mwa!::: n’i Rwoth Mungu.
                (Versi 2, 3, 4 wer “Kapondo mwa e Rwoth Mungu” calu ma malu)

2.	 Tek koth ucwi e polo mor, ---
     Tek ng’om umiel e pi de woi, ---

3.	 Ku ba dieceng’, Ku ba diewor, ---
     Thong’om m’uwotho i mudho, ---

4.	 Rwoth konya do i lembe kpo, ---
     I Mungu para ndhu rondo, ---

title: Waweru wer ma wafoi ko Yesu
content:
1.  Waweru wer ma wafoi ko Yesu, 
    Kum mer ma dit m’emaru kowa; 
    Keth etho piwa wi yen m’athara, 
    Elwokwa ceke, wabed leng’ njwa. 
 
             Waweru wer ma wafoi ko Yesu, 
             Kum pi lem tho m’etho ko kor yen; 
             Rimbe m’ucwir elwoko ko kier mwa, 
             Ewaru dubo ceke cen. 
 
2.  Waweru wer ma wafoi ko Yesu, 
     Con aba para jukabu cen; 
     Eculo banja para ku kisa; 
     Bero m’etimo kaporne mbe. 
 
3.  Waweru wer ma wafoi ko Yesu, 
     Abidhe ceke voyowa ngo, 
     Kum tego pare ene aloci 
     M’evoyo dubo ku tho de kpo. 
 
4.  Waweru wer ma wafoi ko Mungu, 
     Wadoko wote ku yioyic; 
     Ebilund cokowa ndhu i bang’e, 
     E wabidoko cal kude de.

title: I Will Sing the Wondrous Story
content:
1.	 Abi wero lem pa Kristu, Yesu En m’Etho pira.
     Con Eweko Won i polo kar’ Etho Ebodh kowa.

                 Abi wero lembe pare, lem pa Yesu ma Jalar.
                 Wabiwero ku jupare, nja ku nja ku wer mandha.

2.	 Kan arwinyo Yesu nwang’a con arwinyo swa i ng’om.
     Yesu bino de i bang’a, En Emio ira kwo.

3.	 Woth ubedo tek dit ira, en edaru tegona.
     Wang’a tho, e ndiri nega, Yesu wodha kud i can.

4.	 Wang’a cido dit ku mudho, lworo nega de mandha,
     Tego pare riemo lworo ka Yesu wok i bang’a.

5.	 Ka tho nega Ebikura, kan aweko ng’om mae.
     Ebibedo ndhu i bang’a keth atund i polone.
english_name: I Will Sing the Wondrous Story

title: Lembe mi mutoro wok i yo pa Mungu
content:
1.  Lembe mi mutoro wok i yo pa Mungu, 
    Ni kum Yesu Kristu ma Wod Mungune 
    Yesu Kristu tho kum kier mi dhanu ceke 
    Yesu Jalar nuti, dong’ ifoi Yesu. 
 
           Dong’ ifoi Yesu, dong’ ifoi Yesu, 
           Yesu Jalar nuti, dong’ ifoi Yesu, 
           Dong’ ifoi Yesu, dong’ ifoi Yesu, 
           Yesu Jalar nuti, dong’ ifoi Yesu. 
 
2.  Foyofoc unyay’ anyong’a kud i cwinyjo, 
     Kum eriemo can m’ubedusendowa; 
     Tek mutoro nuti, can de bilund ringo, 
     Yesu Jalar nuti, dong’ ifoi Yesu. 
 
3.  Lem ma rac mi ng’om umulowa wa dhanu, 
     En esendowa i woth mi kwo ma nyen; 
     Ento tek wafoyo Yesu kud i cwinywa, 
     Lem m’usendowa dong’ Mungu kabu cen. 
 
4.  Jok ma ene won ndra thoko dit ewingwa, 
      Yenyo corowa cen ku ba Mungu mwa; 
      Dong’ wabed ku tego wanen ru ba Mungu, 
      Yesu Jalar nuti, dong’ ifoi Yesu.

title: It’s just like His Love
content:
1.	Jarimo para Yesu, Emara dit mandha, mer pare ma Emara
    Ko usagu mange le.
    Kum tek akier atuc ire, Eweko dubona, 
    Emaka ki i cinge de, wode m’Emaru dit.

             E Yesu Kristu m’ukabu dubo cen,
             En e Jagwokna ku ba rupiny ceke.
             E Yesu de m’utelo wia ber, e Yesu ma Jamer.

2.	 Ceng’ moko ka masendi betimo cwinya de, mer pa Jalar
     Apido ngo kum Jok usenda dit.
     E Yesu lund urieme bor, Ebedo ru ia.
     Acopo wero foc mandha kum Yesu ma Jamer.

3.	 Ka can unuro cwinya, jumerna moko tho. Aringo ndhu ba Munguna, 
     Ejuka de kumae:
     “Kud iywak calu judubo ma genogen umbe.”
     I polo wabinendra be ku Yesu ma Jamer.

4.	  Ayenyo dit awer ru pi mer m’Emara ko, pi gwok ma
      Yesu gwoka ko an ma a ber ungo.
      Wod Mungu ma Yesu Kristu m’Ubimo ma Won yung
      Ma ceng’ ku dwi ku cero de gipaku Nyinge dit.

title: Rwoth Yesu yenyo ju mandha
content:
1.  Rwoth Yesu yenyo ju mandha, 
    Jukristu ma giwore; 
    Ma cwinygi kpo ubedo tar, 
    M’uripo ku pa Yesu. 
 
            Ameri Yesu in ma Rwoth, 
            Ora e abicidho yot; 
            Abituco lem mi both, 
            Yesu ma Jakisa. 
 
2.  Rwoth Yesu yenyo ju mandha, 
     Niponjo lembe pare, 
     Ni ju m’urwinyo, ma Jalar 
     Usendre pigi bende. 
 
3.  Rwoth Yesu yenyo ju mandha 
     Ma copo voyo dubo. 
     Wa der mi ng’om, wapondo ngo, 
     Wawotho ngo i mudho. 
 
4.  Rwoth Yesu yenyo ju mandha, 
     Nikwayu rombe pare; 
     Wating’ nyithindho migi de, 
     Wadwokogi i dwonde.

title: Lead me to Calvary
content:
1.	Yesu Imio kwo ira, dwong’ ubed iri nja.
    Keth apoi piri ku ba saa, nyuth ira Kalvari.

             Keth apoi pi Gethsemane, keth apoi de pi can peri
             Man keth apoi pi mer peri, nyuth ira Kalvari.

2.	 Liel ma ni cana nyutho de, ka ma juyikoi.
     Jukur mi polo tundo be, gigwoko avuji.

3.	 Ayenyo Rwoth abin beng’i ku giramia de.
     Kwij tho uthum, Ivoyo liel kuca wi Kalvari.

4.	 Keth atim gin m’lyenyo ri, i nindona ceke.
     Keth alub toki ku ba ceng’, nyuth ira Kalvari.

title: Kulo rimo nuti
content:
1.  Kulo rimo nuti m’udhenyni 
    M’ebeai i ng’et Jalar; 
    Tek judubo rony i kulone, 
    Ebilwoko dubo cen. 
    Ebilwoko dubo cen, elwoko dubo cen. 
    Tek judubo rony i kulone, 
    Ebilwoko dubo cen. 
 
2.  Yang’ jakwo m’uvoc efoyo dit, 
     Ni kum kisa pa Jalar; 
     Keca an, m’adubo calu en, 
     An aweko dubna lwany. 
     An aweko dubna lwany, aweko dubna lwany, 
     Keca an m’adubo calu en, 
     An aweko dubna lwany.  
 
3.  Nyathi Rombo tho pi dhanu yu; 
      Tego rimbe nuti asu; 
      Cil i nindo ma kanisa dho, 
      Biboth ni dubo ndhu. 
      Biboth ni dubo ndhu, eboth ni dubo ndhu, 
      Cil i nindo ma kanisa dho, 
      Biboth ni dubo ndhu. 
 
4.  Por m’aneno rimbi kuca Rwoth, 
     Nwang’ ethwogere ceng’ m’itho; 
     Mer m’imara ko uroma dit, 
     Ebiroma cil m’atho. 
     Ebiroma cil m’atho, biroma cil m’atho, 
     Mer m’imara ko uroma dit, 
     Ebiroma cil m’atho. 
 
5.  Abiwero wer ku dwal ma mit, 
      Ma bipako tegoni, 
      Nwang’u leba maeni mi tho, 
      Daru vuto ling’ i ng’om. 
      Daru vuto ling’ i ng’om, evuto ling’ i ng’om, 
      Nwang’u leba maeni mi tho, 
      Daru vuto ling’ i ng’om.

title: I am Thine O Lord
content:
1.	An a peri Rwoth, dwendi winjre mit kum Iweco pi merni.
    An ayeny’ Inyai yioyic ira keth acor i kumi dri.

             Tela ::ceng’ni:: vuti Rwoth keth apoi pi tho peri,
             Tela ::ceng’ni:: vuti Rwoth,
             Ceng’ni ka ma rimbi cwir.

2.	Dong’ Ikoya tin ya atim iri, konya Rwoth ku beroni.
    Keth ageni ndhu wang’a nen beng’i, man atim ru ka cwinyi.

3.	 Tek abino Rwoth, In Ikwera ngo kan arum i weng’i dwe.
     Wec mwa bedo mit man ekonya dit, kum Inyayu bedopwe.

4.	 Karamb ng’eyo merni uvoya Rwoth ma k’aneno weng’i ngo.
     Man anyong’ani sagu ng’eyong’ec, ebing’eire beng’i cu.

title: Tim tic ni Yesu Kristu
content:
1.  Tim tic ni Yesu Kristu 
     Ka fodi kumi leng’ 
     Tim ire tic ku tego, 
     Tim ku ba rupiny;  
     Tim ticne ku mutoro,  
     Ka fodi ceng’ urieny,  
     Kum diewor ubino,  
     Ka tic mwa bithum. 
 
2.  Yesu utimo tic dit, 
     Kinde m’etie i ng’om,  
     Ekeyo kumjo dupa 
     Cil ma ticne thum; 
     Esendre dit apila,  
     Endre ekwero ngo, 
     Ceke etimo iwa,  
     Cil tho m’etho ko. 
 
3.  Yesu beneno bang’wa,  
     Lem moko kandre ngo,  
     Eng’eyo lem m’i iwa,  
     Ku tic m’watimo;  
     Ber ka walubo toke,  
     Ku tic m’etimo en,  
     Wanyuth ko ya wamare,  
     Wafoye kudo.

title: Wubin, nen Wod Mungu
content:
1.  Wubin, nen Wod Mungu, pake kud anyong’a!  
    Junyole mukere i Bethlehem. 
    Tipo Maleng’ ubino wi min mire; 
    Wubin wuyung Wod Mungu, (3)  
    Yesu Jalar. 
 
2.  Jumalaika wero karacelo kudwa, 
     Wumi dwong’ ni Mungu ma malu ngbir;  
     Dong’ cwinywu kwi wu dhanu mi mutoro, 
     Wubin, wuyung Wod Mungu, (3)  
     Yesu Jalar. 
 
3.  Wajoli Rwoth Yesu kum iwok i kindwa,  
     Warum ku jurieko wayungi k’ajok,  
     In m’I Rucwic, ironjri ku kum ng’eca,  
     Wubin, wuyung Wod Mungu, (3)  
     Yesu Jalar.

title: Sweet Hour of Prayer
content:
1.	Akoyo nindo moko ndhu, nirwo m’arum ko ni Rwoth Mungu.
    M’acopo ting’o lembe kpo, akel apedhe i wang’e ndhu.

                  Arum the kom mi beroni, ajolo kisa peri de.
                  Ku tegocwiny akweyi do, Ikonya i nindo mi ndiba kpo

2.	 Tek can usagu cwinya kpo, Ikwio cwinya ku beroni.
     Ang’eyo ngo ram akweyi, eyikre cu ni kum Tiponi.

3.	 Cor bang’a Mungu konya tin, acoro ceng’ni kum beroni.
     Adundena upong’ andha, ku yic m’ayio ko Munguna.

title: Ang’o lwoko cwinya kpo
content:
1.  Ang’o lwoko cwinya kpo? 
    Rimo Jalar Yesu kende. 
    Ang’o keyo cwinya yo? 
    Rimo Jalar Yesu kende. 
 
            Rimo Jalar m’ucwir, 
            M’ulwoko ia ceke; 
            Mana gin mange mbe, 
            Rimo Jalar Yesu kende. 
 
2.  Gin m’ulwoko cwinya pet, 
     Rimo Jalar Yesu kende; 
     Mungu E Jakisa dit, 
     Kum rimb Jalar Yesu kende. 
 
3.  Cul m’eculo piwa kpo, 
     Rimo Jalar Yesu kende; 
     Berocwinya bodha ngo, 
     Rimo Jalar Yesu kende. 
 
4.  Ang’o dwoka doko leng’? 
     Rimo Jalar Yesu kende; 
     Cwinya geno polo tin, 
     Kum rimb Jalar Yesu kende.

title: Cing’ ario timo tic ni Yesu
content:
1.  Cing’ ario timo tic ni Yesu,  
     Leb acel yero lem pare,  
     Ith ario winjo gin m’eyero,  
     Dwal acel de wero wer. 
 
               Rwoth wabino, Rwoth wabino,  
               Kawa ceke wa nyithindho;  
               Rwoth wabino, Rwoth wabino,  
               Ponjwa piri do. 
 
2.  Tiel’ ario wotho i yo pare,  
     Ma bitund’ i pacu pare;  
     Wang’ ario somo buku pare,  
     Ma nyutho iwa yo mi kwo. 
 
3.  Cwiny acel amio ni Yesu,  
     An de ang’eyo ebotha;  
     An abitimo tic ni Rwodha,  
     An a nyathin pare mandha.

title: Saviour Again to Thy
content:
1.	Wadaru paku nyingi Mungu mwa,
    Man warwo iri ku nying Rwoth Jalar.
    Meni wapokra mi mugisani warum the tiendi miwa kwiocwiny.

2.	Ka wan walal ma ceng’ uyenyo mwony,
    Konj kwiocwiny i wiwa i Jadwong’.
    Gwokwa pi wec tek dhogwa yenyo kier,
    Cimwa pi dubo kara wawoth ber.

3.	Kwi cwinywa tek ruvwa wok ku diewor,
    Ineno ceke, gwokwa, ku walwor.
    Wan wa nyithindho ma Inyolo In,
    In Ibikurowa cil i rupiny.

4.	Kwo mwa de ceke peri In i Rwoth,
    Romwa ku tego wacir lembe kot.
    Ka tic bithum ma rundi mwa bijik,
    Ku kwo ma nja wamond i kwiocwiny.

title: Ng’a m’uwinjo lembe
content:
1.  Ng’a m’uwinjo lembe, lembe ma mit, 
     Yer ni dhanu ceke, lembene ber dit; 
     Lembe mir anyong’a wok i bang’wa tin, 
     Ng’a m’uyio, dong’ ebin! 
 
             Ng’a muyio, bin! Ng’a muyio, bin! 
             Tipo Mungu wacu iri, “Dong’ ibin!” 
             Ju m’umwony i dubo Mungu lwong’owu, 
             Ng’a m’uyio, dong’ ebin! 
 
2.  Ng’a m’uyenyo bino dong’ kud egal, 
     Nen dhugola thwolo mond i ie do. 
     Yo mi kwo e Yesu, en ekende ba! 
     Ng’a m’uyio, dong’ ebin! 
 
3.  Lem ma Mungu ng’olo elokre ngo, 
     Tek iyio Yesu ibinwang’u  kwo; 
     Tego pare copo nyoli ndhu ma nyen, 
     Ng’a m’uyio, dong’ ebin!

title: God Be With You
content:
1.	 Wabinendra ndhu i tiend Jalar ka warum nirwo i bang’e.
     The komker mi bero pare, wabinendra ndhu i tiend Jalar.

                 (ku ba versi ceke kacakrine ku kadarne:
                 Wabinendra ndhu i tiend Jalar)

                 Mungu kur kindwa, Ekur kindwa,
                 Cil i ceng’ m’warombo tiend Jalar.
                 Mungu kur kindwa, Ekur kindwa,
                 Wabinendra ndhu i tiend Jalar.

2.	 --- Bed museme ku the bombe, 
     Ebikuri calu rombe ---

3.	 --- Ebiyeyi ndhu ku bote,
     Ibibedo yo i kore ---

4.	 --- Nindo peri kpo ni cinge 
     Cil m’Ecoki ko i bang’e, ---

title: Lem ma tek ubidhowa
content:
1.  Lem ma tek ubidhowa 
     Wa Jukristu ma ni ng’om, 
     Can ma tek unurowa, 
     Lembe dupa sendowa; 
     Wang’wa neno ber ungo, 
     Wang’wa umbre kud utur, 
     Gibilero ka wacokra bang’e nja. 
 
            Ceng’ mange wabing’eyo cu, 
            Ka wacokra malu i polo. 
            Wabiwero wer kud anyong’a mandha 
            Nwang’u lembe ceke wok kakare cu. 
 
2.  Kec unegowa i ng’om, 
     Tic de jonyo kumwa dwong’, 
     Ng’om uti unyayu doi, 
     Piny mwa ceke de belui; 
     Kwaruwa gicayo cik, 
     Ketho Mungu lamugi, 
     Ebithum ceng’ ma wacokra bang’e nja. 
 
3.  Tho ma negowa i ng’om, 
     Ceng’ mange dong’ ebithum; 
     Ceng’ ma Rwoth ugamuwa, 
     Wabed bang’e nja ku nja. 
    Ju ma gibidong’ i ng’om 
    Gibinwang’u can ma dwong’, 
    Wabineno ka wacokra bang’e nja.

title: Jesus Lover of my Soul
content:
1.	Yesu i jarimona, wek ajeng’i kori In,
    Kinde ma jubidha hai, ka Jok senda dit mandha.
    Kura In, i Jalarna, cil m’abidhene bithum.
    Yabna polo peri ngbeng’, Ijol cwinya beng’i do.

2.	Ka m’aring i ie mbe, cwinya jengre ndhu kumi.
    Kud ikuna abed rwa, gwoka, juka In asu.
    An ageno para In, konyna kpo ai i beng’i.
    Um wia m’ubedo ngbeng’ ku tipo mi bombi In.

3.	In i Kristu, Iroma, anweng’i Isagu kpo.
    Bodh jubudo, ju ma rwa, kei kum jo gwok ju ma kic.
    Nyingi leng’ man e mandha, a jadubo ma andre.
    I won bero mandhandha, an acido a jandra.

4.	Bero kpo ai i beng’i mak’ eum dubona kpo.
    Rimbi en e yath mandha, dwoka leng’ Igwoka ndhu.
    In i kwo ma dhenyni nja, wek agam dru i beng’i.
    Dhenjri ru yor i cwinya, meu i ia nja ku nja.

title: Anwang’u Yesu Kristu
content:
1.  Anwang’u Yesu Kristu, edoko jarimba, 
    Pire sagu dit i cwinya andhandha; 
    Yesu calu thiu uboko ma ber ma ng’wice ng’ar, 
    An amaru Yesu dit ku cwinya kpo. 
 
              Ekonya ceng’ ku ceng’ kpo, i can enuti de, 
              Ter m’unura kpo eyeyo ira de, Haleluya! 
              Ene calu cero jobi, kugweno de enen. 
              An amaru Yesu dit ku cwinya kpo. 
 
2.  Abidhe de besenda, e Yesu voye en, 
     Nik esenda dit m’acopo cire ngo; 
     An aweko Jok, aringe, ku lembe pare kpo, 
     Dong’ alubo ng’ei jarimba ma Yesu. 
 
3.  Eweko dhanu ki ngo, enuti ceng’ ku ceng’, 
     Tek giyie andhandha ku cwinygi kpo; 
     Yesu E jagwok m’ukura dieceng’ ku  diewor de, 
     Man ka kec upodho ebirieme kpo. 
 
4.  Anyong’a nego cwinya, jarimba nuti nja, 
     Ebigwoka ber m’ecopo weka ngo; 
     Kum enyayu foc i cwinya, mutoro dit mandha. 
     An amaru Yesu dit ku cwinya kpo.

title: Con Yesu lor’, i ng’om mae
content:
1.  Con Yesu lor’, i ng’om mae,  
     Yesu ma Jalar mwa;  
     Eweko lonyo ma pare,  
     Yesu ma Jalar mwa. 
 
            Yesu ma Jalar mwa,  
            Wa dhanu wameri;  
            Yesu ma falar mwa,  
            Warwo i beng’i. 
 
2.  Esendre ya elar ko wa,  
     Yesu ma Jalar mwa;  
     Ekwero ngo nitho kumwa,  
     Yesu ma Jalar mwa. 
 
3.  Ka Yesu tho eai k’i liel,  
     Yesu ma Jalar mwa;  
     Elund eidho ka ma leng’,  
     Yesu ma Jalar mwa. 
 
4.  Ka Yesu ai kud i polo,  
      Yesu ma Jalar mwa;  
      Bidwogo kar’ ecokwa kpo,  
      Yesu ma Jalar mwa.

title: I Love to Tell
content:
1.	Ayero lem pa Yesu, e mit mandha ira,
    Pi Yesu ku dwong’ pare, mer de m’Emaru kowa.
    Ayero lem pa Yesu, kum en lemandha,
    Eromo cwinya ceke ma sagu lem mange.

                Ayero lem pa Yesu, Elaru ju m’urwinyo
                Ebodho ju m’uyio, Yesu m’umaruwa.

2.	Ayero lem pa Yesu, elar ekonya dre.
    Ayenyo dong’ ayere kara ekonyi de,
    Ayero lem pa Yesu, esagu pidoic,
    Esagu mido mi cam, e mit ma sagu kic.

3.	Ayero lem pa Yesu, jumoko winjo ngo.
    Girem ni dwong’ pa Mungu, Lembariba wacu do.
    Ayero lem pa Yesu, e lem mi both iwa.
    Aol ungo niyere, ya Yesu tho piwa.

4.	Ayero lem pa Yesu, kum kec unego jo,
    Pi kwen mi kwo ma Yesu, Ecopo yeng’o jo.
    Ayero lem pa Yesu, abed afoi Jalar.
    Amare con ku tin de, abibemare nja!

title: Tek imbe ku piny mi ng’om
content:
1.  Tek imbe ku piny mi ng’om, 
     Ywak unyai i dhogi dwong’, 
     Kec unegi dit – Aka! e kendi yec; 
     Mungu gwoko winyo kpo, 
     Cwinygi ringo rii ungo, 
     Mi masendi peri ceke ba Yesu. 
 
               Mi bang’e, mi bang’e 
               Mi masendi peri ceke ba Yesu. 
               Kan isendri, man ivoc, 
               Rwo I bang’e, kud ikoc. 
               Mi masendi peri ceke ba Yesu. 
 
2.  Tek tho remo kumi hai, 
     Congi mbe, i ng’ic ma gwei; 
     Cwinyi de udoko rac, e weng’i col; 
     Dong’ ing’ei Yesu jakei, 
     Ebiweki ngo, etie, 
     Mi masendi peri ceke ba Yesu. 
 
3.  Tek judegi doti rac, 
     E gilwong’o nyingi swa, 
     Ii pido ya juwedu weki  kpo; 
     Yesu nuti i beng’i nja, 
     Cir ku tegocwiny wada! 
     Mi masendi peri ceke ba Yesu. 
 
4.  Tek iol, imaku ti, 
     Tego mbe m’uromo tic, 
     Lwar upodh’ i wii, ter iyeyo ngo; 
     Mungu maru ju m’uti, 
     Bed i kore, gwake ki, 
     Mi masendi peri ceke ba Yesu.

title: Come Thou Fount
content:
1.	Naka an a jatic pa Jok ku lem dubo pare de.
    Ento dong’ ayenyo para i Jalar ma Wod Mungu.

             Yesu roma kud anyong’a kum Emio kwo ma nja.
             En e Rwoth mwa ma Jalar mwa,
             En e Jamer mandhandha.

2.	 Yesu Kristu yang’ Ebino kar’ Ebodhwa ju m’ukier.
     Man Eii ku wonabali nwang’ eyenyo ya warwiny.

3.	Yesu Kristo ma jugure, kar’ Edwok cwiny dhanu nyen.
    Ewodh dhanu kud i mudho, Etel wigi ka ma leng’.

4.	Yesu Kristo Ebidwogo kar’ Ecokwa ju m’uboth,
    Wabibedo nja wakugi, Ebibimo dhanu yu.

title: Ka wawotho ku Rwoth
content:
1.  Ka wawotho ku Rwoth, mberemberene yot, 
     Wothne bedo ber dit, emiero; 
    Rwoth ni bang’wa awe, dong’ walub toke dre, 
    Man watimu kayeny pare cu. 
 
          Gene, wore, yo mange moko mbe, 
          Ma junwang’u k’anyong’a, 
          Ndhu i lembe pare. 
 
2.  Paru can moko mbe, yutho wang’jo de mbe,  
     Ma Jalar jukowa ngo ie; 
     Cwiny ma jiji de mbe, man pi wang’wa ng’oi ngo,  
     Kum Jajuk nuti, wagene ndhu. 
 
3.  Ter ma pek nurowa, kud adieng’acwiny mwa,  
     Yesu wacu wabol i kore; 
     Tho m’urubowa rek, yen m’athara ma pek,  
     Ju m’ugene, eyungogi dre. 
 
4.  Dong’ waribra kude, dong’ wabed the tiende,  
      Wabiwotho waku Yesu dre; 
      Wabitimo ire, wabifoye awe,  
     Kud walwor, wagene, wawore.

title: There is a Fountain
content:
1.	Kulo rimo nuti m’udhenyni m’ebeai i ng’et Jalar.
    Tek judubo rony i kulone,
    ::Ebilwoko dubo cen:: Elwoko dubo cen.
    Tek judubo rony i kulone, Ebilwoko dubo cen.

2.	Yang’ jakwo m’uvoc efoyo dit ni kum kisa pa Jalar.
    Keca an, m’adubo calu en,
    ::An aweko dubna lwany:: Aweko dubna lwany.
    Keca an, m’adubo calu en, an aweko dubna lwany.

3.	Nyathi Rombo tho pi dhanu yu, tego rimbe nuti asu.
    Cil inindo ma juyic mandha,
    ::Gibiboth ni dubo ndhu:: Giboth ni dubo ndhu.
    Cil i nindo ma juyic mandha, gibiboth ni dubo ndhu.

4.	Por m’aneno rimbi kuca Rwoth,
    Nwang’ ethwogre ceng’ m’ltho.
    Mer m’Imara ko uroma dit
    ::Ebiroma cil m’atho:: Biroma cil m’atho.
    Mer m’Imara ko uroma dit, ebiroma cil m’atho.

5.	Abiwero wer ku dwal ma mit ma bipaku tegoni.
    Nwang’u leba maeni mi tho,
    ::Daru vuto ling’ i ng’om:: Evuto ling’ i ng’om.
    Nwang’u leba maeni mi tho, daru vuto ling’ i ng’om.

title: Dong’ akwai Yesu
content:
1.  Dong’ akwai Yesu kum lembe para, 
    Akenda ebicoprena ngo; 
    Ka ng’om usaga Yesu bilara,  
    Yesu bilara, Yesu Kristu. 
 
             Dong’ akwai Yesu, dong’ akwai Yesu,  
             Akenda ebicoprena ngo, 
             Dong’ akwai Yesu, dong’ akwai Yesu,  
             Yesu bilara, Yesu Kristu. 
 
2.  Dong’ akwai Yesu pi can m’unega,  
     En e jarimba, eriemo can.  
     Tek an apenje, en de bikonya,  
     Yesu ni bang’a, ebijuka. 
 
3.  Con a jadubo, ketho arwinyo,  
     Satani bidha ku lem mi ndra;  
     Dong’ akwai Yesu, E jatel wia,  
     Yesu bikura, Yesu Kristu.

title: Whosoever Heareth
content:
1.	Ng’a m’uwinjo lembe, lembe ma mit,
    Yer ni dhanu ceke, lembene ber dit.
    Lembe mir anyong’a wok i bang’wa tin,
    Ng’a m’uyio, dong’ ebin!

                   ::Ng’a m’uyio bin!:: Tipo Mungu wacu iri.
                   “Dong ibin!” Ju m’umwony i dubo
                   Mungu lwong’owu, ng’a m’uyio dong’ ebin!

2.	 Ng’a m’uyenyo bino dong’ kud egal,
     Nen dhugola thwolo, mond i ie do.
     Yo mi kwo e Yesu, En e kende ba!
     Ng’a m’uyio dong’ ebin!

3.	 Lem ma Mungu ng’olo elokre ngo,
     Tek iyio Yesu ibinwang’u kwo.
     Tego pare copo nyoli ndhu ma nyen,
     Ng’a m’uyio, dong’ ebin!

title: Ayeny’ awoth i yo ma cu
content:
1.  Ayeny’ awoth i yo ma cu  
    Ku ba rupiny, wakudi Rwoth;  
    Acidh i wang’a ndhu ku rwo,  
    Ikura kara kud avoc. 
 
            Rwoth peya malu ceng’ni in,  
            Acung i ng’eti ka ma leng’;  
            Ka ma mugisa sagu kpo,  
            Ayenyo aidh malu do. 
 
2.  Ayenyo ngo adong’ kakae,  
     Abidhe dit, masendi kwa;  
     Jumoko foyo ng’om mae,  
     Andre ayeny’ aidh malu. 
 
3.  Ayeny’ acir abidhe kpo,  
     Atim tic ber avoi dubo; 
     Gin ma tek Mungu nyolo nyen,  
     Eloyo ng’om k’awanyane. 
 
4.  Ayeny’ atund i ng’om ma nyen,  
     Kar’ anen dwong’ pa Rwoth ma leng’;  
     Atundo ngo kum berona,  
     Endre kum kwo m’emiona.

title: I’ve a Message
content:
1.	An awinjo lembanyong’a Haleluya, 
    Ayenyo ya iwinje de.
    Lembagora ai ba Mungu, Haleluya,
    “Nen ba Yesu ibinwang’u kwo.”

               Nen ba Yesu, umira, nen ba Yesu inwang’ kwo.
               Lembagora, ai ba Mungu, Haleluya
               “Nen ba Yesu ibinwang’u kwo.”

2.	 Lembene e lem mi mer, Haleluya,
     Jarimba dong’i winje cu.
     Lembanyong’a ai i polo, Haleluya,
     Yesu wacu en e lemandha.

3.	 Kwo juketho iri ngbeng’, Haleluya,
     Juyenyo inwang’ kwo mi nja.
     Tek ineno yo ba Rwoth, Haleluya,
     Yesu kende copo bodhi do.

4.	 Abiyeroni pira, Haleluya, 
     Maram anwang’u kwo mi nja.
     Saa m’ayio nying’ Jalar, Haleluya,
     Yesu bodho cwinya saa nica.

title: Aneno polo yabre
content:
1.  Aneno polo yabre, man nen riuni ma tar, 
    Ere ng’atu ma ni wie ma julwong’o Lemandha;  
    Man i bedopwe epoko lembe man etimo mony,  
    E nyinge Lemandha! 
 
            Dwong’ ni Mungu, Haleluya! (3)  
            Wapaku nyinge nja! 
  
2.  Man eronjre de ku kendi ma juvong’o ku rimbe,  
     E jamkermiwic dupa man nying’ wang’e ve lebmac,  
     Man ku pala ma ni dhoge en egoyo thek ma rac,  
     Mungu Jategokpo. 
 
3.  Ibitim’ ang’o ceng’ nica tek idong’ the kwinyone?  
     Ebinyono pany mi kwinyo pare, ng’a bikonyi ke?  
     Tek ipodho ni Jategokpo enyayu ndiri kwa,  
     Lok cwinyi bang’e tin. 
 
4.  Ka fodi kisa nuti ai, iyi Wod Mungu tin,  
     Ebijoli, ngisi pare lwar, elwong’i dong’ ibin;  
     Tek igalu ngo iyi Jalar m’utho pi duboni,  
     E ibipake de.

title: Yesu, Yesu, Yesu
content:
1.  Yesu, Yesu, Yesu, 
    Ju bilwong’o nyinge Yesu, 
    Kum En etho nibodho dhanu yu, (2) 
    Yesu ma Jalar mwa. 
 
2.  Yesu, Yesu, Yesu, 
     Wabiboth ku rimbe, Yesu, 
     Rimbe m’ucwir nibodho dhanu yu, (2) 
     Ni ju m’uyie kpo.

title: Mond i cwinya
content:
Mond i cwinya, mond i cwinya, 
Ko imond i cwinya, Rwoth Yesu. 
Mond ia tin, bed ia nja, 
Ko imond i cwinya, Rwoth Yesu.

title: How Sweet the Name
content:
1.	Adieng’acwiny m’utimowa wabol i wi Yesu,
    Kum ie pido dit piwa, Ekurowa de du.

2.	Ka ter ma pek unurowa, evoyowa mandha,
    Wakwaye, man Ekonyowa, Yehova, tego mwa.

3.	Tek Mungu mulo cwinywa de, ku can, ku pidoic,
    Wang’eyo En Eponjowa, wabed ku yioyic.

4.	E ka can mwa ma keni thum Edwokowa ndhu cu
    Rwoth mwa bijolowa malu i bang’e i polo.

title: Grace Greater Than
content:
1.	Bero pa Mungu kaporne mbe, 
    Berone lwar ma sagu kier mwa. 
    Kuca wi Kalvari Kristo tho, 
    Rimb Nyathi Rombo pa Mungu cwir.

                 Bero ….. Bero …..
                 (Bero ma dit) (Ma pore ngo)
                 Berone romo nilwoko ic.
                 Bero ….. Bero …..
                 (Bero ma dit) (Ma pore ngo)
                 Bero ma dit sagu dubna kpo.

2.	 Dubo ma kwar ngbo i cwinywa kpo, 
     Ketho warwinyo bor ku Mungu.
     Bero pa Mungu ma porne mbe 
     Nyutho kapondo, yen m’athara.

3.	 Dubo mi cwinywa ekandre ngo, 
     Wayeny ang’o m’ulwokwa ndhu cu?
     Nen, rimo thwogre wi Kalvari, 
     Rimo bilwoki tar sagu pei.

4.	 Bero ma thum de ngo nja ku nja, 
     Giramia ni ju m’uyie. 
     Wun ma wuyenyo wunen wang’ Rwoth, 
     Wubin wujol bero pare tin.

title: Tel wia ba dhanu tin
content:
Tel wia ba dhanu tin 
M’ung’eyo Yesu Kristu ngo, 
Gony ira ka ywak migi kara ajukgi do. 
Jumoko igi pido ngo, 
Ku rwo girwo de ungo. 
Roma ku Tipo peri, tel wia Yesu Rwoth.

title: Ju m’anyong’a negogi ni kum Yesu
content:
Ju m’anyong’a negogi ni kum Yesu, 
Yesu, Yesu, Yesu. 
Ju m’anyong’a negogi ni kum Yesu, 
Gibifoye nja ku nja.

title: Ikuro Yesu tin!
content:
1.  Ikuro Yesu tin? Ebidwogo!  
    Nyo fok iyie ngo; 
    Cwinyi iloko de ngo 
    Tek nwang’u edwogo tin?  
 
           Ebidwogo, Yesu m’ubimo mwa,  
           Ku dwand jumalaika, dwal ma dit,  
           Man dwand agwara winjre mit,  
           Wacok dhogwa, wabed ku Yesu nja. 
 
2.  Akuro Yesu tin, ebidwogo!  
     Yesu biterowa 
     Kuca i polo mi nja;  
     Wa ju ma wagene tin. 
 
3.  Lworo binega ngo, ebidwogo!  
     Ka pokolembe wok  
     Para juketho wi Rwoth  
     Yang’ con kan etho pira. 
 
4.  Ayeny’ awoth ma pwe, ebidwogo!  
     Lewic binega ngo; 
     Abijole k’anyong’a, 
     Tek Yesu bidwogo tin.

title: If you are Tired
content:
1.	Tek in iol ku lem dubo, jamer, kwai Yesu Ewek dubo peri.
    Tek in iyenyo inwang’ kwo ma nyen, igen tego pa Yesu Rwoth.

                 Kawono, kud ikwere, kawono, yab ire do
                 Kawono tuc duboni kwai Yesu Elwok cwinyi leng’.

2.	 Tek in iyenyo adunde ma leng’ kwai Yesu Ewek dubo peri.
     Rimb Yesu cwir nilwoko duboni, yi ire ya rimbe lonyi.

3.	 Tek cwinyi dieng’, kwiocwiny mbe ma gwei,
     Kwai Yesu Ewek dubo peri.
     Anyong’a mi ng’om ie nanu, wada, i Yesu ibinwang’u yom.

4.	 Yesu beyiko kabedo ma ber ni ju ma gijole mandhandha.
     Tek in iyenyo ibed bang’e nja, ecopre ni kum yioyic.

title: Kwiocwiny pa Mungu calu pi ma mol
content:
1.	Kwiocwiny pa Mungu calu pi ma mol, 
    Mondo ndhu I cwinywa, kwio racne kpo; 
    Ceng’ ku ceng’ enyai m’emedre iwa cu, 
    Man edoko thuth ketho wabedo yo. 
 
               Mungu mwa Yehova kwio cwinywa ndhu,     
               Gin ma dhoge wacu ene lemandha. 
 
2.	Wapondo i cinge kum lemebe ma rac 
    Yenyo nyayu ndiri, podoic mi ndra. 
    Kud ipid lem ng’om ku gin ma galu ngo. 
    Bed yo! Mungu kuri, kum eol ungo. 
 
3.	Kud ilwor masendi, Mungu ie en. 
    Mer pare bikuri, ebirieme cen. 
    Gene nindo ceke, ebikonyi de, 
    Kwiocwiny pa Mungu, kwiocwiny ma dhe.

title: When we all get to Heaven
content:
1.	Mer pa Yesu maku ya jupake, wer pi bero pare ku kisa.
    Ebeyiko udi dupa mal’i polo i bang’e.

              Ka watundo i polo wabinwang’u mutoro dit mandha.
               Ka waneno Yesu wabibepaku nyinge nja. 

2.	  Ka fodi wawoth i ng’om maeni mudho cido wang’ayo iwa.
      Dwong’ ku bero pa Rwoth Yesu dwoko wang’wa leng’ andha.

3.	 Dong’ wabed asu ku tic m’Emio, wagene pi tego ku ba ceng’.
     Sukulia pare nuti wabinwang’e ka ma leng’.

4.	 Dong’ wacir masendi ceke kuni wabineno wang’ Jalar Yesu.
     Kan Ejolowa i polo, wabibedo kude nja.
english_name: When we all get to Heaven

title: Praise Him, Praise Him
content:
1.	::Pake:: Yesu Kristu ma Jawar mwa!
    Cak wer i ng’om ceke kum mer ma dwong’.
    ::Pake:: wu jumalaika m’i bang’e,
    Pak nyinge ma tegone sagu nja!
    Ebikurowa, wan wa nyithindho pare,
    Rombene Ekwayuwa ku ba saa.

               ::Pake:: yung Yesu Kristu ma Rwoth mwa,
               Pake hai ku wer mir anyong’a kwa!

2.	 ::Pake:: Yesu Kristu ma Jawar mwa!
     Rimbe cwir, Etho de pi dubo mwa.
     Jalar mwa, wagene pi both ma juboth ko.
     ::Pake:: maku wayunge do!
     Merne pore ngo, ng’a copo pido lwarne?
     Dhanu yu mi ng’om Yesu maru kpo.

3.	 ::Pake:: Yesu Kristu ma Jawar mwa!
     Ebibino bimo wi dhanu yu!
     Ker bibedo pare mandha ku ma pwe de,
     Rwoth mi rwodhi, maku juyunge le!
     Ubimo mandha, bimwa ku cwiny m’ukwio,
     Con Ijwigri, meni judodi dre!

title: O for a thousand
content:
1.	Ayenyo Mungu mi ira lem yung m’ayunge ko.
    Ewara ndhu ku tegone ku berone mandha.

2.	Rwoth para mina tegocwiny m’atuc ko beroni,
    Ni ju mi ng’om kara giyi, gin de gifoi nyingi.

3.	E Yesu! Nyingi mit andha ekwio cwinya lwe!
    Eriemo can ku lworo de enyay’ anyong’a kwa.

4.	 Egonya kud i dubona, ewodha kud i tho.
     Enyayu foyofoc ira, rimbe udwoka leng’.

title: The Lily of the Valley
content:
1.	Anwang’u Yesu Kristu, Edoko jarimba,
    Pire sagu dit i cwinya andhandha.
    Yesu calu thiuboko ma ber ma ng’wice ng’ar,
    An amaru Yesu dit ku cwinya kpo.

                 Ekonya ceng’ ku ceng’kpo, i can Enuti de,
                 Ter m’unura kpo Eyeyo ira de, Haleluya!
                 En e calu cero jobi, kugweno de enen.
                 An amaru Yesu dit ku cwinya kpo.

2.	 Abidhe de besenda, e Yesu voye En,
     Nik esenda dit m’acopo cire ngo.
     An aweko Jok, aringe, ku lembe pare kpo.
     Dong’ alubo ng’ei jarimba, ma Yesu.

3.	 Eweko dhanu ki ngo, Enuti ceng’ku ceng’,
     Tek giyie andhandha ku cwinygi kpo.
     Yesu e jagwok m’ukura dieceng’ ku diewor de,
     Man ka kec upodho Ebirieme kpo.

4.	 Anyong’a nego cwinya, jarimba nuti nja,
     Ebigwoka ber m’Ecopo weka ngo.
     Kum Enyayu foc i cwinya, mutoro dit mandha.
     An amaru Yesu dit ku cwinya kpo.

title: Kal pa Rwoth cido ngo
content:
1.  Kal pa Rwoth cido ngo kum e leng’,  
    Man ke dubo ku tho bende mbe;  
    Yesu yiko kabedo ma ber, 
    Ebicokowa ndhu ceng’ ma nge. 
 
            Ng’ombe leng’, ng’ombe leng’, 
            Ng’om ma ber, mire ma, nja ku nja! 
            Ng’ombe leng’, ng’ombe leng’,  
            Ng’om ma ber, mire ma, nja ku nja! 
 
2.  Ka wanyiko dhu wath kuca bo,  
     Wabigoyo muzira wi Rwoth;  
     Kwiocwiny pare sagu mi ng’om,  
     Man kakeca emiowa yom. 
 
3.  Kum mugisa m’ekonjo wiwa,  
     Man kum merne m’emaru kowa;  
     Wabipaku nying’ Mungu mi nja,  
     Ene Wegwa m’upido piwa.

title: Onward Christian Soldiers
content:
1.	Wacidhu, Jukristu, waci kiedo Iwiny, 
    Wanen ko ba Yesu Jathek yioyic, 
    En Etelo wiwa, Ebivoyo de,
    Kied ku tegocwinywu, wabivoyo be.

                 Wacidhu Jukristu, waci kiedo Iwiny,
                 Wavoi ko jadegi ndhu ku tegocwiny!

2.	 Tek walubo Yesu wabivoyo Jok, 
      Tek wacogo wie ebiringo pio. 
      En e won abidhe, won agobe de,
      Lemandha bivoye, wawodh lembene.

3.	 Kanisa pa Kristu en e thek acel, 
     Ku juwadwa dupa, Jatelwic acel. 
     Kisa pare ribowa ndhu ku ripocwiny.
     Wan acel ku genogen, man ku berocwiny.

4.	 Dong’ wacidh i wang’wa wan wa ju pa Rwoth,
     Aloci ni bang’wa rondo ku rondo 
     Ubimo mwa Yesu bimo dhanu yu, 
     Dwong’ ku pak mi dhogwa bed ni Rwoth mwa ndhu!

title: Yesu Jalarna eloro i ng’om
content:
1.  Yesu Jalarna eloro i ng’om,  
     Yesu Wod Mungu m’esendre piwa;  
     Ia wang’ li kan awinjo pire 
     Ya ebeyenyo an. 
     Ebino yenyo an, ebino yenyo an,  
     Ia wang’ li kan awinjo pire,  
     Ya ebeyenyo an. 
 
2.  Yesu Jalarna etho kakara,  
     Banja m’i wia eculo ira, 
     Ia wang’ li kan awinjo pire  
     Ya en etho pira. 
     Ebino tho pira, ebino tho pira,  
     Ia wang’ li kan awinjo pire  
     Ya en etho pira. 
 
3.  Yesu Jalar E jakwac ma ber dit,  
     En ebesayu ndhu rombe m’ukier;  
     Ia wang’ li kan awinjo dwande  
     Kan ebelwong’o an, 
     Ebino Iwong’o an, ebino Iwong’o an,  
     Ia wang’ li kan awinjo pire  
     Ya ebelwong’o an. 
 
4.  Yesu Jalarna bidwogo i ng’om,  
     En ebicoko juyic m’uyie, 
     An abinene m’eloro i ng’om,  
     Man ebiting’a de. 
     Man ebiting’a de, man ebiting’a de,  
     An abinene m’eloro i ng’om,  
     Man ebiting’a de.

title: Precious Promises
content:
1.	Yang’ Mungu ng’olo ya Ebikonyi
    Tek ibesendri pi bedopwe.
    “I yo m’ikwanyu, kind ng’om ku polo 
    Wang’a bikengo wii i yo.”

                “An Abimio riekona iri, wang’a bikengo wii i yo,”
                 I yo m’ikwanyu kind ng’om ku polo 
                 Wang’a bikengo wii i yo.”

2.	 Ka lembabidhe bedieng’o cwinyi,
     Dubo bevoyi i yo mi kwo.
     Bed ndhu ku tego kum Mungu ng’olo 
     “Wang’a bikengo wii i yo.”

3.	 Tek nwang’ igeno gin ma jufoyo
     Ento enyothre, lembene rany.
     Ponji bijuki tek ibiparu Mungu mandha, Ewondowa ngo.

4.	 Ka tho bedhingi, tegoni thum de, ii bepido, kwoni bevoc,
     Winj dwande kuca ram Ebewacu,
     “Wang’a bikengo wii i yo.”

title: E Bethlehem m’ibedo nok
content:
1.  E Bethlehem m’ibedo nok  
    Ivuto yo i thim, 
    Ku cero de gilingo wii,  
    E piny ceke ling’ ti;  
    Ento i mudho nino  
    Juneno der ma dwong’,  
    Erieny ni ju m’uyenyo both,  
    Ni dhanu yu mi ng’om. 
 
2.  Maria nyolo Yesu m’E  
     Mukere ma Jalar, 
     Ku diewor bu jukuro ru  
     Nyathin ma pire lwar.  
     Cil cero de gidunyo, 
     Anyong’ane mi both.  
     Ubimo mio kwiocwiny  
     Wi dhanu yu mi ng’om. 
 
3.  Ku piny ma col ma biti man  
      Ku dieworne ma ling’; 
      E giramia wok iwa 
      Ma Yesu Jalar mwa.  
      Juwinjo wer mi polo,  
      Ka Yesu wok i ng’om,  
      Man ke emondo i cwiny ju  
      M’uyie, ju m’urwo. 
 
4.  Nyathin ma leng’ mi Bethlehem, 
     Bin, mond i iwa tin, 
     Wodh dubo mwa, lwok iwa de, 
     Bin nyolwa dok ma nyen. 
     Wafoyo kum iloro 
     Nikelo iwa both; 
     Bed bang’wa Rwoth, rom iwa Rwoth,  
     Ma in Imanuel.

title: Far Away in the Depths
content:
1.	Yor i cwinya awinjo wer pare ma mit, 
    Midone sagu mido mi kic, 
    Man ewinjre ve wer ma juwer’i polo,
    Ebejuko cwinya yo mandha.

                  Mungu oro iwa kwiocwiny pare kud i polo.
                  Rwoth akwei keth cwinya pong’ hau kude do,
                  Kwiocwiny ma binyutho merni.

2.	 Kwiocwiny pa Mungu ma ni yor i cwinya, 
     En e gin ma pire tek andha. 
     Ng’atu moko de mbe ma bimaye ira 
     Cil m’amondo i pacu pa Rwoth.

3.	 Kwiocwiny ma ni ia bemiona yom 
     Kum abedo i cing Yesu Rwoth, 
     Ebegwoka museme dieceng’ ku diewor.
     Ketho dwong’ pare caru cwinya.

4.	 Ceng’ mange kan aidho i pacu pa Rwoth 
     Abineno Jacak kwiocwiny. 
     Abiwero pak kuca ku jumaleng’ kwa,
     Pak mwa de wabiwero kumae.

5.	 Kwiocwiny umbe iri e jarimona
     M’ibesendri ku lembe mi ng’om? 
     Yesu yeny’ Edok iri Jarimbi ma dhe,
     Dong’ iyi man ijol kwiocwiny.

title: Yesu Kristu ai k’i liel
content:
1.  Yesu Kristu ai k’i liel, Haleluya!  
    Ju mi polo nene tel, Haleluya!  
    Ndiri tho edaru kpo, Haleluya!  
    Wan wawero ku mutoro, Haleluya! 
 
2.  Tic pa Kristu ceke thum, 
     Kum etho pi dhanu yu,  
     Dubo copo bime ngo,  
     Tho ceke de evoyo. 
 
3.  Aloci mi tho ane? 
     Man ke kwirne de ane?  
     Yesu voyo tho ma gwei,  
     Wan wafoyo Rwoth awe. 
 
4.  Dong’ wacopo idh’ i polo,  
     Banja ceke Yesu culo,  
     Kristu telo yo iwa, 
     Wan wanwang’u kwo ma nja.

title: O Zion Haste
content:
1.	Wun ma wuyio Yesu ni Jalar mu, 
    Yer ni ng’om ng’ung’ ya Mungu En e der. 
    Ecwio ng’om ku ceke ma ni ie,
    Eyenyo ngo ya ng’atu moko rwiny.

                 Yer lembanyong’a, lem kwiocwiny,
                 Lembe pi Yesu ma e Jawar mandha.

2.	 Nen dhanu lwar ma gin girwiny’ i dubo, 
     Jutwiogi ku kol ma pa won ndra, 
     Giwinjo ngo ya Yesu tho pi dubo, 
     Giwinjo ngo pi kwo ma nja ku nja.

3.	 Waci wayer, wa jumulembe pare, 
     Rwoth Yesu tho nilaru dhanu yu. 
     Kud wagal, nyap bende kud ecerwa,
     Ento wanyebgi ndhu ba lokocwiny.

4.	 Maku wumi wotwu ku nyigwu bende, 
     Piny mu ma le wumi niorogi. 
     Rwo de areri, Mungu winjo ceke,
     Man gin m’itimo Yesu foyo kpo.

title: Ang’eyo Yesu nuti
content:
1.  Ang’eyo Yesu nuti, eni i ia tin,  
    Waweco karacelo ku rwo ku ba rupiny;  
    Eting’a kan apodho, ejuko cwinya dit,  
    Jategokpo m’ukonya i can ma lic. 
 
              Eai! Eai! Evoyo tho ma gwei!  
              Alubo toke ku ba ceng’, 
              I woth mi bedopwe. 
              Eai! Eai! Ene Jategokpo!  
              Jawarna bedo kwo mandha,  
              Ebedo i ia. 
 
2.  Ekonyo dhanu ceke m’ugeno tegone,  
     Etelo wi jupare i yo mi bedopwe;  
     Kadwogo pare dhingo kan ebicokowa,  
     Biterowa, wabed kuca bang’e nja. 
 
3.  Wufoi Jalar areri, evoyo ndiba kpo,  
     Mutorone bikonyi, ebedekonyojo;  
     Iyie, gene, wore, ku pidoic ma cu,  
     Jarimoni E Yesu, ma Rwoth mi kwo.

title: Beneath the Cross
content:
1.	The yen m’athara keca acung i ng’et Jalar,
    Ve cana ma juketh’ i ng’om nikonyo ju m’uvoc.
    En e kabedo ma wacopo nwang’u yom ie,
    Kum ter ma pek m’unurowa, muloic m’usendo jo.

2.	 Wi yen ma’thara keca aneno Yesu Rwoth.
     Eyeyo kier mwa ceke En, goc pare canguwa.
     Can nego cwinya kan aparu ram Etho pira,
     Mer pare sagu ng’eyong’ec, an aromo tak de ngo.

3.	 Abed the yen m’athara, kabedo mange mbe.
     Ayenyo para ya anen der m’i wang’ Yesu Rwoth.
     Kud apid pi lembe mi ng’om, can piny ku lonyo de.
     Lewic unega pi dubna, ami dwong’ ni Rwoth Yesu.

title: Yang’ Mungu ng’olo ya ebikonyi
content:
1.  Yang’ Mungu ng’olo ya ebikonyi,  
    Tek ibesendri i yo bedopwe. 
    “I yo m’ikwanyu kind ng’om ku polo  
     Wang’a bikengo wii i yo.” 
 
              “An abimio riekona iri  
               Wang’a bikengo wii i yo, 
               I yo m’ikwanyu kind ng’om ku polo  
               Wang’a bikengo wii i yo.” 
 
2.  Ka lembabidhe bedieng’o cwinyi,  
     Dubo bevoyi i yo mi kwo; 
     Bed ndhu ku tego kum Mungu ng’olo  
     “Wang’a bikengo wii i yo.” 
 
3.  Tek nwang’ igeno gin ma jufoyo,  
Ento enyothre lembene rany;  
Ponji bijuki tek ibiparu, 
Mungu mandha, ewondowa ngo 
 
4.  Ka tho bedhingi, tegoni thum de, 
Ii bepido, kwoni bevoc; 
Winj dwande kuca ram ebewacu,  
“Wang’a bikengo wii i yo.”

title: O Beulah Land
content:
1.	Rwoth Mungu mwa uyero ngbeng’ pi polo pare ka maleng’,
    Ekuro ju m’ubedo cu m’ukio Wode Yesu Rwoth.

                  E ka maleng’ e ka m’urieny,
                  Ma Yesu sagu der mi ceng’.
                  Eyiko ndhu kabedo mwa ma beco m’ubekurowa.
                  Ceng’ moko Ebijolowa kuca i polo nja ku nja.

2.	 I polo pacu pa Jalar kakeca dubo mondo ngo.
     Juparu kec ku rieu de ngo man can ku tho bibedo mbe.

3.	 Juwinjo dwal mi foyofoc, ku wer ma wabepaku ko
     Jalar mwa, Yesu Kristu Rwoth m’utho nimio iwa kwo.

title: Rwoth, ayeny’ abed Jakristu
content:
1.  Rwoth, ayeny’ abed Jakristu,  
     Yor i cwinya, yor i cwinya,  
     Rwoth, ayeny’ abed Jakristu,  
     Yor i cwinya. (3) 
     Rwoth, ayeny’ abed Jakristu,  
     Yor i cwinya. 
 
2.  Rwoth, ayeny’ amarjo ceke,  
     Yor i cwinya, yor i cwinya,  
     Rwoth, ayeny’ amarjo ceke,  
     Yor i cwinya. (3) 
     Rwoth, ayeny’ amarjo ceke,  
     Yor i cwinya. 
 
3.  Rwoth, ayeny’ abed ma leng’ njwa,  
     Yor i cwinya, yor i cwinya, 
     Rwoth, ayeny’ abed ma leng’ njwa,  
     Yor i cwinya. (3) 
     Rwoth, ayeny’ abed ma leng’ njwa,  
     Yor i cwinya. 
 
4.  Rwoth, ayeny’ acir abidhe,  
      Yor i cwinya, yor i cwinya,  
      Rwoth, ayeny’ acir abidhe,  
      Yor i cwinya. (3)  
      Rwoth, ayeny’ acir abidhe,  
      Yor i cwinya. 
 
5.  Rwoth, ayeny’ abed calkudi,  
     Yor i cwinya, yor i cwinya,  
     Rwoth, ayeny’ abed calkudi,  
     Yor i cwinya. (3) 
     Rwoth, ayeny’ abed calkudi,  
     Yor i cwinya.

title: Shall we Gather at the River
content:
1.	Wabi cokra i polo ku jumalaika pare.
    Wabipake karacelo mal’ i polo ba Mungu maleng’.

                Wabinendra i polo, dhanu ceke ma giyio Yesu.
                Wabibedo kud anyonga ni kum Rwoth mwa ma Yesu Jalar.

2.	 Con ka Yesu dok i polo Eyiko kabedo iwa,
     Ebijolowa i bang’e kara wabed ndhu kuca mi nja.

3.	 Wabibedo kud anyong’a ku juwadwa ma ni polo.
     Wabifoye ka waneno udi dupa m’Eyiko ma cu.

4.	 Ceng’ mange ma Yesu dwogo, ceng’ maeca dhingo ceng’ ni.
     Dong’ wabed ku rwo, wakie, bed ayika nicidho kude.
english_name: Shall we Gather at the River

title: Tipo Mungu tel wiwa
content:
1.  Tipo Mungu tel wiwa,  
    In m’ikonyo dhanu nja.  
    Peiwa yo yo ku cingwa,  
    Wa juwoth i ng’om ma ngbeng’;  
    Ju m’uvoc gifoyo dit, 
    Ka giwinjo dwendi mit, 
    “M’umung’ kwe kwe, jawoth, bin!  
    Luba, abikobo in.” 
 
2.  Jarimbwa m’I ber mandha,  
     In m’ikonyo dhanu nja. 
     Kud iwek cwinywa bed mbwang’,  
     Ka wawira swa i ng’om;  
     Won abidhe sendowa,  
     Cwinywa voc ma geno jwik.  
     “Dong’ imung’ yo, jawoth, bin!  
     Luba, abikobo in.” 
 
3.  Ka tic mwa bedhingo thum,  
     Wabekuro yom ma nja,  
     Gin m’udong’ ndhu genogen  
     Ma wageno kwo mandha;  
     Ka wakadhu yo mi tho,  
     Wan wajengra kum Jalar,  
     “Dong’ imung’ yo, jawoth, bin!  
     Luba, abikobo in.”

title: When I Get Home
content:
1.	Jubiting’o terna kpo i ka maleng’,
    Jubijola kuca cu i ka maleng’. Abiwero wer kwa
    Ku kendi ma tar cwe, abipaku Yesu i ka maleng’.

                 ::I ka maleng’, i ka maleng’,
                 Can mwa birwinyo ceke, i ka maleng’.::

2.	 Mudho mbe m’ucido wang’a ka maleng’,
     Der ma kuca sagu ceng’ i ka maleng’.
     Kuni de ekonya, yoje de emenyo,
     Ebitelo wia cil ka maleng’.

3.	 Abineno wang’ Jalar i ka maleng’, abifoyo rimbe de
     I ka maleng’, wang’e abineno, nyinge abipaku,
     Nja ku nja i bang’e i ka maleng’.

title: Ceng’ni ba Munguna
content:
1.  Ceng’ni ba Munguna i ng’eti ki,  
     Tek can binega re, dong’ lem moko mbe;  
     Werna bibed’ asu, ceng’ni i ng’et Mungu,  
     Ceng’ni ba Munguna, ceng’ni beng’i ki. 
 
2.  Wothna ariri swa i ng’om ma rac,  
     Piny ceke mudho kwa, ayom the cana.  
     Lekna bibed’ asu ceng’ni i ng’et Mungu,  
     Ceng’ni ba Munguna, ceng’ni beng’i ki. 
 
3.  Keth yo maeni nyang’ i wang’a tin,  
     Gin kpo ioro ri ndhu ku kisani;  
     Malaika gwela ku ceng’ni i ng’et Mungu,  
     Ceng’ni ba Munguna, ceng’ni beng’i ki. 
 
4.  Ka cwinya maku ai, tic para thum,  
     Ceng’ dwi, ku cero de rwiny i wang’a ndhu,  
     Weja bibed’ asu, ceng’ni i ng’et Mungu,  
     Ceng’ni ba Munguna, ceng’ni beng’i ki.

title: Hark the Herald Angels Sing
content:
1.	Winj malaika ka giwero Yesu wok i Bethlehem,
    Yesu ma Jalar mi dhanu, Yesu ma junyol’ i dwol.
    Yesu ma jarimo iwa, Yesu En e Mungu wiwa.
    Yesu winj wapaku In kum Imaru dhanu dit.
    Malaika gipeki de, wa dhanu wapeki dre.

2.	 Kristu e Jalar mandha, Kristu En e Rwoth mi nja,
     Kristu En e Mungu wiwa, En Eweko polone.
     Etho kar Eting’wa ceke, Elonywa kum lem mi dubo.
     Mer m’Emaru kowa ngi, ketho Kristu tho kumwa.
     Malaika gipake dre, maku wan wapake de.

3.	 Ju m’i polo rwo ru ire, Yesu Kristu Rwoth mi nja.
     Malaika de igi wang’ li ka ginen’ Ewekogi,
     Kar Ebin i ng’om mi tho, Eng’ei can m’usendowa,
     Yesu weko ng’om mi kwo kar’ Ebin Elar kowa.
     Yesu kristu Wod Mungu wan wapeki k’anyong’a.

title: Ka lembe wok i ia pi Jalar
content:
1.  Ka lembe wok i ia pi Jalar,  
    Lembene ma jupadu ko wang’e,  
    Akayo, aka! eketho ia pido, aka, aka!  
    Lembene ma jupadu ko wang’e. 
 
2.  Ka lembe wok i ia pi Jalar,  
     Lembene ma jugure ko kor yen,  
     Akayo, aka! eketho ia pido, aka, aka!  
     Lembene ma jugure ko kor yen. 
 
3.  Ka lembe wok i ia pi Jalar, 
     Ka ng’et Yesu jucobe de ku tong’,  
     Akayo, aka! eketho ia pido, aka, aka!  
     Ka ng’et Yesu jucobe de ku tong’. 
 
4.  Ka lembe wok i ia pi Jalar,  
     Lembene ma juyike ko i liel,  
     Akayo, aka! eketho ia pido, aka, aka!  
     Lembene ma juyike ko i liel. 
 
5.  Ka lembe wok i ia pi Jalar,  
     Lembene ma ecer kudo m’etho, 
     Afoyo andha! eketho ia wang’ li andha, andha!  
     Lembene ma ecer kudo m’etho. 
 
6.  Ka lembe wok i ia pi Jalar,  
      Lem m’eketho ko ia doko tar, 
      Afoyo andha! eketho ia wang’ li, andha, andha!  
      Lem m’eketho ko ia doko tar.

title: While the Shepherds Watched
content:
1.	Jukwac gikuro rombe ma gibedo ndhu i thim.
    Malaika wok m’uai ba Rwoth e der ucarugi.

2.	 Gilworo dit, malaika re uwacu ‘‘Kud ulwor,
     Rwonglembe mir anyong’a dwong’, ubed ni dhanu kpo.”

3.	 Junyolo tin i Bethlehem, i kal pa Daudi Rwoth,
     Jalar ma Yesu Kristu Rwoth ma Wod Mungu Wego.

4.	 E meni giranyuthane, juboyo nyathinne
     Ku bongu mi mukere, man jupiele ka mi cam.

5.	 E eni eni malaika gipaku Mungu mit.
     Giyero lembanyong’a ma bijuko dhanu dit.

6.	 Pak Mungu Rwoth ma malu ngbir, Emio kwiocwiny.
     Mutoro bed ba dhanu yu ma Mungu foyogi.

title: Wacidhu wu pa ker pa Rwoth
content:
1.  Wacidhu wu pa ker pa Rwoth,  
    M’enyolowu ku yo mi both;  
    Wuai tho tho, wuci yau yau,  
    Wucwal tic man wurende pio.  
 
             Wacidhu, wacidhu, 
             Woth i yo mi kwo;  
             Wacidhu, wacidhu, 
             Rwoth Yesu menyo yo. 
 
2.  Wacidhu ndhu ku bang’wa yu,  
     Ka palacam e eni ndhu,  
     Jukai mwoka wupoi pi koth,  
     Emaru nyotho cam pa Rwoth. 
 
3.  Wacidhu kud amora do,  
     Kum jumalaika kengowa;  
     Udul mi jumulembe de,  
     Gitiekowa gikonyowa. 
 
4.  Wacidhu, ceng’ udhingo mwony,  
     Ku mudho ticne timbre ngo;  
     Wuai ku rwo, wukweru kpo,  
     Wulok cwiny ju m’urwinyo do.

title: O Little Town of Bethlehem
content:
1.	E Bethlehem m’ibedo nok ivuto yo i thim,
    Ku cero de gilingo wii, e piny ceke ling’ ti.
    Ento i mudho nino juneno der dwong’.
    Erieny ni ju m’uyenyo both, ni dhanu yu mi ng’om.

2.	 Maria nyolo Yesu m’e mukere ma Jalar.
     Ku diewor bu jukuro ru nyathin ma pire lwar.
     Cil cero de gidunyo anyong’ane mi both.
     Ubimo mio kwiocwiny wi dhanu yu mi ng’om.

3.	 Ku piny ma col ma biti man ku diewor ma ling’,
     E giramia wok iwa ma Yesu Jalar mwa.
     Juwinjo wer mi polo ka Yesu wok i ng’om,
     Man ke Emondo i cwiny ju muyie, ju m’urwo.

4.	 Nyathin ma leng’ mi Bethlehem, bin, mond i iwa tin.
     Wodh dubo mwa lwok iwa de, bin nyolwa wadok nyen.
     Wafoyo kum Iloro ni kelo iwa both.
     Bed bang’wa Rwoth, rom iwa Rwoth, ma In Imanuel.

title: In iroma ceng’ ku ceng’ kpo
content:
1.  In iroma ceng’ ku ceng’ kpo.  
     I jarimba ma ber dit; 
     Man i yo m’ucidh’ i polo  
     Abilubona toki. 
 
               Ceng’ni in, ceng’ni in, (2)  
               I yo ma cidho i polo  
               Abilubona toki. 
 
2.  Kadok can de wok i bang’a,  
      Yesu nuti ceng’ni an;  
      Abifoyo in I kendi,  
      Wabicidho wakudi. 
 
3.   Kadok tho de wok i bang’a,  
      Yesu nuti ceng’ni an;  
      Lworo ceke ringo bor cen,  
      Jagwokna ni vuta en.

title: When I Survey
content:
1.	Pi yen m’athara wapid pire be
    Ma Rwoth mi polo utho i wie.
    Giki ma naka kuloka ira ceke mananu, kuhaya kwa.

2.	 Ikwera Yesu ya kud alula, endre agen tho m’ltho ko pira.
     Gin m’uyenyo wilo wia piri aweke ceke ni kum rimbi.

3.	 Masendi m’Isendri ko i kumwa
     Nyutho mer peri m’Imaru kowa,
     Yau mer ma dit ma rokeni ane? Can ma dit ma rokeni ane?

4.	 Kadok alonjra ku piny mi ng’om yu
     E giramia m’urem dit iri.
     Merni m’Imara ko jai ira ndhu, atingra dho amira iri.

title: Ku cwiny ma mol eyenya
content:
1.  Ku cwiny ma mol eyenya ka dubo voya ma! 
     Ebiela de wi goke, ekela ndhu i dwol, 
     Malaika de giwero wer, 
     Ram werne romo polo gbur. 
 
             Mer ma dit m’uyenya, 
             Rimone m’ung’iewa; 
             Bero pare kela ndhu i dwol, 
             Bero dwong’ m’ukela ndhu i dwol. 
 
2.  Elwoko rem mi dubo, ewire ndhu ku mo,  
     Enwang’a kan arwinyo, evonj i bang’a mwa;  
     E dwal ma mit va pare mbe, 
     Eketho cwinya kwio kwe. 
 
3.  Enyutho poyo gute, e rimbe cwir de le,  
     Jamker ma mir ukudho, juroi i wie de;  
     Enen’ ang’o i ia e? 
     M’esendre ko kumeno e? 
 
4.  Abedo ndhu i vute, derne ucara cwe, 
     Kinde m’aneno wang’e afoyo kisane;  
     Arem nipeki Munguna, 
     Kadok apeki nja ku nja. 
 
5.  Ma nindona bekadhu, e cwinya kwio ndhu,  
     Akuro piny m’uru ma bisagu wagi yu;  
     Ka wa juyic, mugolene, 
     Wabed i ng’ete ka ma leng.

title: When I Think how they Crucified my Lord
content:
1.	Ka lembe wok i ia pi Jalar, lembene ma jupadu ko wang’e,
    Akayo, aka! Eketho ia pido, aka, aka!
    Lembene ma jupadu ko wang’e.

2.	 Ka lembe wok i ia pi Jalar, lembene ma jugure ko kor yen.
     Akayo, aka! Eketho ia pido, aka, aka!
     Lembene ma jugure ko kor yen.

3.	 Ka lembe wok i ia pi Jalar,
     Ka ng’et Yesu jucobo de ku tong’
     Akayo, aka! Eketho ia pido, aka, aka!
     Ka ng’et Yesu jucobo de ku tong’.

4.	 Ka lembe wok i ia pi Jalar, lembene ma Juyike ko i liel, 
    Akayo, aka! Eketho ia pido, aka, aka!
    Lembene ma juyike ko i liel.

5.	 Ka lembe wok i ia pi Jalar, lembene ma Ecer kudo m’Etho.
     Afoyo andha! Eketho ia wang’ li, ::andha::
     Lembene ma Ecer kudo m’Etho.

6.	 Ka lembe wok i ia pi Jalar, lem m’Eketho ko ia doko tar.
     Afoyo andha! Eketho ia wang’ li, ::andha::
     Lem m’Eketho ko ia doko tar.
english_name: When I Think how they Crucified my Lord

title: Adieng’acwiny m’utimowa
content:
1.	Adieng’acwiny m’utimowa 
    Wabol i wi Yesu; 
    Kum ie pido dit piwa, 
    Ekurowa de du. 
 
2.	Ka ter mapek unurowa, 
    Evoyowa mandha; 
    Wakwaye, man ekonyowa 
    Yehova, tego mwa. 
 
3.	Tek Mungu mulo cwinywa de, 
    Ku can, ku pidoic; 
    Wang’eyo en eponjowa, 
    Wabed ku yioyic. 
 
4.	E ka can mwa ma keni thum, 
    Edwokowa ndhu cu; 
    Rwoth mwa bijolowa malu, 
    I bang’e i polo.

title: E jutic mi mwoka julwong’owu
content:
1.  E jutic mi mwoka julwong’owu, 
     Nikayu i mwoka pa Yesu Rwoth; 
     Ku pala mi lembe jutimo tic, 
     Jutime asu cil i ceng’ pa Rwoth. 
 
           Jutic ni kani ma kungi mor? 
           Ma yenyo ya Mungu yunggi ceng’ ajok? 
           E ng’a bibino nikonyowa? 
           Nicoko camne juter i kal? 
  
2.  Ka mwoka e eni i ng’om ceke, 
     E jubedo diedo kum mwokane; 
     Jutim ticne lam ento camne lwar, 
     E kudi wagal ki kum palacam. 
 
3.  Wubin dong’ ku pala wu ju ma leng’, 
     Wacokra k’amora i mwokane; 
     Keth cwinywu kum tic cil i ceng’ pa Rwoth, 
     Mutoro bisagre i ceng ajok.

title: My Saviour First of All
content:
1.	Katic para bithum ing’om mae e abiai, 
    Abicidho mal’ i polo ka ma ber. 
    Abineno Jalarna kan atundo bang’e ndhu. 
    Ebijola ber ma ku mutoro kwa.

                         Abinene, abing’eye, poyotiende ku cinge de binen.
                         Abing’eyo e Jalarna, ma jugure kor yen ni bodhowa.

2.	 Man anyong’a binega kan awok i vute bo,
     Ka wanendra wang’ ku wang’ i ka maleng’
     Abipake kum kisa, ku mer pare dit andha,
     Kum kabedo ma Eyiko ira nja.

3.	 E juwadwa ma nuti kuca gibifoyo dit,
     Ka wanendra kugi kendo ka maleng’.
     Ebiyweyo piwang’wa can mwa de birwinyo kpo.
     Wabifoyo kum waneno Yesu cu.

4.	 Abimondo i polo de ku kendi ma tar pu
     Ma Jalarna ronya kude maleng’ njwa.
     Rimbe lonyo jupare e gibedo leng’ mandha,
     E gidoko jucampacu kude nja.

title: Mungu nuti kindwa eni,
content:
1.  Mungu nuti kindwa eni, 
    Ndhu ku tego Tipone; 
    Tek wakwaye ebiketho 
    Polo cor koth wiwa tin. 
 
           Wek ebin, wakweyi Mungu, 
           Cor mugisa wiwa tin; 
           Wabekuro, wabekuro, 
           Mungu mwa yep cwinywa do. 
 
2.  Mungu nuti kindwa eni, 
     I kind cokri mwa mae; 
     Ava yepocwiny ni kumwa, 
     Kud iwek ya cwinywa ai. 
 
3.  Mungu nuti kindwa eni, 
     Dong’ wakwai ku ripocwiny; 
     Mac mi mer uwang’ i iwa, 
     Ketho gin ma rac urwiny. 
 
4.  Jalar winjwa ka wakweyi, 
      Ka warum the tiendi ling’; 
      Wan wayio Tipo romwa, 
      Ya edwokwa wadok leng’.

title: Jakwac mandha E Yesu
content:
1.  Jakwac mandha E Yesu, 
     Ekuro rombene; 
     Elwong’ogi ku nying’gi, 
     Ging’eyo dwande de. 
     Jumoko ai k’i cinge, 
     Giwinjo dwande ngo, 
     Giwotho swa i yamba, 
     Giweko wang’ayo. 
 
           Girwinyo ndhu pami rombe, 
           Ma gikwanyu yo mi lum; 
           Maku wan wacokgi i dwol pa jakwac, 
           Ka giboth ni tho mi mac. 
 
2.  Iyenyo ya icidhi, 
     Niyenyo rombene, 
     Ni Yesu ma Rwoth peri, 
     Ka ma eori re? 
     M’ipido ngo pi kumi, 
     Man kum masendine; 
     Ipido nahu pi tije 
     M’itimo ni Rwodhi.

title: Haleluya! Haleluya!
content:
1.  Haleluya! Haleluya! Haleluya! 
     Juciko liel, masendi thum, 
     Jalar mwa voyo tho iwa, 
     Wapake ndhu ku pak mandha. 
     Haleluya! 
 
2.  Eii ku tho ku kero dit, 
     Jukwoj Kristu elalu dra, 
     Juwero wej anyong’a kwa, 
     Haleluya! 
 
3.  Evuto ceng’ adek i liel, 
     Ento eai ku dwong’ ma dit; 
     Wayungi Rwoth m’I wiwa in, 
     Haleluya! 
 
4.  Goc peri cangu juperi 
      Kum kwir mi tho m’ukayugi, 
      Wanwang’u kwo wapaku in. 
      Haleluya!

title: Christ the Lord is Risen
content:
1.	Yesu Kristu ai k’i liel, Haleluya!
    Ju m’i polo nene tel, Haleluya!
    Ndiri tho Edaru kpo, Haleluya!
    Wan wawero ku mutoro, Haleluya!

    (Ka ba versi ceke, Haleluya kumeno)

2.	 Tic pa Kristu ceke thum, -- 
     Kum Etho pi dhanu yu, --
     Dubo copo bime ngo, --
     Tho ceke de Evoyo, --

3.	 Aloci mi tho ane? --
     Man ke kwirne de ane? --
     Yesu voyo tho ma gwei --
     Wan wafoyo Rwoth awe, --

4.	 Dong’ wacopo idh i polo, --
     Banja ceke Yesu culo, --
     Kristu telo yo iwa, -- 
     Wan wanwang’u kwo ma nja, --

title: Ubimo ma Rwoth m’edwong’
content:
1. Ubimo ma Rwoth m’edwong’ i polo, 
    Wer ire pi mer ku tego pare; 
    E ban mwa, ku pala, asi, ku tong’ de, 
    Dong’ wapak nying’ Mungu ku tego ceke. 
 
2.	Pak bero pare, ku riekone de, 
    Derne romo ng’om, elero wang’wa; 
    Kum kwinyo m’edagu ko dubo ma rac, 
    Ng’ecwiny pare opo kum lembe ma swa. 
 
3.	Ipido piwa, igwokowa de, 
    I Wegwa mi kwo m’ikonyowa le; 
    Waneno kony peri i koth ku ceng’ de, 
    Icego cam iwa, wafoyi awe. 
 
4.	Wa dhanu ma ng’ic, jubidhowa dit, 
    Lem kum ku lem ng’om, Jok sendowa dit; 
    Wageni Rwoth Yesu, avoci mandha, 
    Rucwic, ku Jalar mwa, jarimbwa mandha. 
 
5.	Mugisa iri kum tegoni lwar, 
    Ku mer peri de m’imaru kowa, 
    Wameri, wadodhi, wapeki Mungu. 
    Jol wer mwa ku pak ma wapeki  kudo.

title: Wang’a benenoi, Rombo mi Kalvari
content:
1.	Wang’a benenoi, Rombo mi Kalvari, 
    Mungu Jalar; 
    Winja kan aberwo, 
    Wek dubo para kpo, Ia m’ubedo col, lwoke dok tar. 
 
2.	Mungu Jakisa dit, Ang’ic, dwoka bed tek, 
    Mungu para; 
    Itho pi dubona 
    Kum mer m’imara ko, 
    Mer ma bithum ungo ndhu nja ku nja. 
 
3.	Ka yo bedoko col, an de amaku ol, 
    Nyuth ira yo; 
    Lok mudho dok va ceng’, 
    Ler cwinya dwoke leng’ Kura, m’ageno in, kud akier do! 
 
4.	Ka can udoko lic, ka cwinya yenyo voc, 
    Konya Rwotha; 
    Kum gwok m’igwoka ko, 
    Lworo binega ngo, 
    Ting’a i kori, abed beng’i nja.

title: Nen jukristu, Rwoth uloyo
content:
1.  Nen jukristu, Rwoth uloyo 
    Jukwoje ma tho ku liel; 
    Dode malu kum ejwigre, 
    Cong ceke birum ire, 
    Haleluya, Haleluya! 
    Dong’ wayung Ubimo mwa. 
 
2.  Yung Jalar mwa Yesu Kristu, 
     Dong’ eromo kom mi ker; 
     Landu mwoka ju m’uvoyo 
     Ma kud i kind ju m’utho, 
     Haleluya, Haleluya! 
     Ubimo mir ubimo. 
 
3.  Ju m’udage gin gicaye, 
     Ya ene Wod Mungu ngo, 
     Ere jumaleng’ gifoye, 
     Kristu genogen mi dwong’, 
     Haleluya, Haleluya! 
     Kristu genogen mi dwong’. 
 
4.  Winj ka dhanu dodo nyinge! 
      Winj gigoyo muzira! 
      Both, man dwong’, ku tego ire, 
      Rwoth Mungu Jategokpo! 
      Haleluya, Haleluya! 
      Rwoth Mungu Jategokpo!

title: Mungu Rwoth ma leng’ kwe
content:
1.	Mungu Rwoth ma leng’ kwe, 
    M’I jatego ceke; 
    Pir kugweno wer mwa idho I beng’I tin, 
    Mungu Rwoth ma leng’ kwe,     
    Jatego, jakisa; 
    Mungu acel m’unyuthre i adek. 
 
2.	Mungu Rwoth ma leng’ kwe, 
    Ju m’uboth gipeki; 
    Gin girwo i beng’i ku the komker m’urieny, 
    Malaika mi polo 
    De girum i weng’i, 
    M’itie ku kwong’a, tin de, nja ku nja. 
 
3.	Mungu Rwoth ma leng’ kwe, 
    Kadok mudho geng’i, 
    Kadok ju m’udubo gineno dwong’ni ngo; 
    In I leng’ ikendi,    
    Ng’a mange rom kudi? 
    Tegoni, merni, leng’ni sagu kpo. 
 
4.	Mungu Rwoth ma leng’ kwe, 
    M’I jatego ceke; 
    Ju mi ng’om ku polo de paku nyingi tin. 
    Mungu Rwoth ma leng’ kwe, 
    Jatego, jakisa; 
    Mungu acel, m’unyuthre i adek.

title: Wapeki Mungu Wegwa
content:
1.	Wapeki Mungu Wegwa, 
    In I won lembe mandha, Wabepeki! 
    In I Wegwa ma leng’ 
    Mungu ma piri dwong’, Wamio yung iri, 
    Wegwa mi nja. 
 
2.	Wapeki Yesu ma Wod, 
    Lembe m’uloro i ng’om, Wabepeki! 
    Rombo m’utho ni lam, 
    M’isendri dit ku can, 
    Jalar m’ubodhowa, Yesu Kristu. 
 
3.	Wapeki Tipo Maleng’  
    Tipo ma jajuk mandha, Wabepeki! 
    Itelo wiwa cu, 
    Wakwei iromwa do, Man ibed japonji mwa, 
    Tipo Maleng’. 
 
4.	Wapeki Mungu acel, 
    M’inyuthri i yo adek, Wabepeki! 
    Mungu, Wegwa, ku Wod, 
    Tipo ma juko jo, 
    Wapeki ku cwinywa, Mi nja ku nja.

title: Yesu imio kwo ira
content:
1.	Yesu imio kwo ira, 
    Dwong’ ubed iri nja, 
    Keth apoi piri ku ba saa, 
    Nyuth ira Kalvari. 
 
              Keth apoi pi Gethsemane,     
              Keth apoi de pi can peri;         
              Man keth apoi pi mer peri,     
              Nyuth ira Kalvari. 
 
2.	Liel ma ni cana, nyutha de, 
    Ka ma juyiko I; 
    Jukur mi polo tundo be, 
    Gigwoko avuji. 
 
3.	Ayenyo Rwoth abin beng’i  
    Ku giramia de; 
    Kwij tho uthum, ivoyo liel 
    Kuca wi Kalvari. 
 
4.	Keth atim gin m’iyenyo ri, 
    I nindona ceke; 
    Keth alub toki ku ba ceng’, 
    Nyuth ira Kalvari.

title: Der mi kwo para
content:
1.	Der mi kwo para Yesu Rwoth, 
    Imenyo ira yo mi both; 
    Lem mi ng’om an ayenyo ngo, 
    Egeng’o weng’i ira do. 
 
2.	Kan aol dit kum tic ma tek 
    Iting’o ira ter ma pek; 
    Apoi pi yom m’imio ri, 
    Kan abibedo i beng’i. 
 
3.	Bed i bang’a ku ba rupiny, 
    Kum tek itie ikwio cwiny;
    Ikura Yesu dieceng’ du, 
    In I Mungu, inindo ngo. 
 
4.	Ka tho bisenda can mandha, 
    Dong’ ibed bang’a, Rwoth mi nja; 
    Yesu Jalar, jol cwinya do, 
    Abed i beng’i i polo.

title: E ber dit ya wagen Yesu
content:
1.  E ber dit ya wagen Yesu, 
     Wan wageno rimbe ndhu, 
     Kum elwoko cwinywa ceke, 
     Tek wayio Yesune. 
 
            Yesu, Yesu, wan wagene, 
            Wan wayio lem pare; 
            Yesu, Yesu, E Jalar mwa, 
            Wan wakio dwogone. 
 
2.  E ber dit ya wan wagene, 
     Wawek dubo ceke cen, 
     Kum wageno Yesu ketho 
     Wabed kwo, e cwinywa kwi. 
 
3.  Tin wabedo kud anyong’a, 
      Kum wageno Rwoth Yesu; 
      E Jalarwa, E jarimbwa, 
      Ebibedo bang’wa nja.

title: Rwoth Yesu ameri
content:
1.	Rwoth Yesu ameri, itie Rwodha nja, 
    Aweko mutoro mi ng’om m’ucida, 
    Jarimba ma leng’ pwe, Jalarna ma cu, 
    Kawono ameri ma sagu ma con kpo. 
 
2.	Ameri Yesu, kum ilar imara, 
    Ikabu lem dubo m’unuro cwinya, 
    Ikendo jamker mir ukudho pira,
    Rwoth Yesu ameri ku mer ma sagu kpo. 
 
3.	Ameri ma kwo, abimeri k’i tho, 
    K’anyong’a mi cwinya apeki ndhu cu, 
    Tek kuma bivoc abipeki asu, 
    Rwoth Yesu ameri ku mer ma sagu kpo. 
 
4.	I udi m’iyiko i polo ma njwa, 
    Abifoyo Rwodha, mutoro mandha, 
    Ku jamker i wia de abiwero, 
    Rwoth Yesu ameri ku mer ma sagu kpo.

title: Bed i bang’a, in i Rwoth Munguna
content:
1.	Bed i bang’a, in i Rwoth Munguna, 
    Ka ceng’ umwony e piny uyutho bi, 
    Ka jukony mange mbe, jajuk de mbe, 
    In I jajuk ma cu, bed i bang’a. 
 
2.	I saa ma kwo mi kum mae bithum, 
    Yungri mi ng’om ku dwong’ne bikadhu, 
    Lokri ma swa mi ng’om ku nyothne de, 
    In ma ilokri ngo bed i bang’a. 
 
3.	Rwoth bed i bang’a ku ba ceng’ ceke, 
    Mi ira tego, acir abidhe; 
    I jatel wia kara awoth pwe, 
    Dieceng’ ku diewor Rwoth bed i bang’a. 
 
4. Rupiny biwok, dhanu ceke bicer, 
    Anyong’a nuti i polo ma ber, 
    Der peri rieny, mudho ceke bithum; 
    I kwo, i tho, Mungu, bed i bang’a.

title: Mungu kurowa ma ber
Anyong’a kwa
content:
1.  Anyong’a kwa! Anyong’a kwa!  
     Kum Yesu tho elaruwa; 
     Mutoro pong’o cwinywa dit, 
     Wafoyo Rwoth ku foc mandha. 
 
             Lem ma dit, lem ma dit, 
             Kum Yesu lwoko dubo mwa, 
             Dong’ warwo ire, wabed leng’ 
             Wacir abidhe ku ba ceng’ 
             Lem ma dit, lem ma dit, 
             Kum Yesu lwoko dubo mwa. 
 
2.  Amira ceke ni Rwodha, 
     Aim tic ire, tic mandha; 
     Enyayu wer i dhoga kwa, 
     Adundena bepake nja! 
 
3.  Dong’ tic mi both m’etimo thum, 
     Adoko pare, piny ma dhe; 
     Ku dwal ma mit elwong’a “Bin, 
     Lub toka ndhu i yo ma pwe.”

title: Nying’ Yesu winjre ber ira
content:
1.  Nying’ Yesu winjre ber ira, 
    Emit ma sagu  ceke; 
    Kum nying’ mange wi ng’om ngung’ 
    Uromo ngo calu en. 
 
            An amaru Yesu, an amaru Yesu, 
            An amaru Yesu, kum elar emara dit. 
 
2.  Epoya pi rimbe m’ucwir 
     M’ulwoko dubo ceke; 
     Epoya de pi mer pare, 
     M’emaru ko dhanu pet. 
 
3.  Epoya de k’i can para, 
      Ya can m’utime sagu; 
      Eng’eyo yeyo can mwa de, 
      Eting’o cwinywa malu.

title: Wafoyo Jalar mwa
content:
1.	Wafoyo Jalar mwa 
    M’utho pi dhanu yu; 
    Kum yioyic m’uribowa 
    Wadoko thek acel. 
 
2.	Wacokra the komker 
    Pa Rwoth mi bedopwe,   
    Wang’eyo ebiwinjowa 
    Ka waberwo ire. 
 
3.	Ka can unegowa, 
    Enurowa de dit; 
    Juwadwa konyowa ku juk 
    M’udwoko cwinywa tek. 
 
4.	Ka kindwa pokre dra, 
    Enyayu can iwa; 
    Ere i polo ka ma njwa 
    Wapokra nga mi nja.

title: Rwodha, ng’wek kwen mi kwo
The yen m’athara pa Jalarna
content:
1.  The yen m’athara pa Jalarna, 
    An aywak kum lem dubona; 
    Yesu lwok ia dwoke tar, 
    Dong’ afoi Jalar. 
 
             Dong’ afoi Jalarna, dong’ afoi Jalarna, 
             Rimb Jalarna yang’ ucwir pira, 
             Dong’ afoi Jalar. 
 
2.  Afoyo Yesu ma Jalarna, 
     Kum en esendre, etho kuma; 
     En de ekura, bikura nja, 
     Dong’ afoi Jalar. 
 
3.  Ni dub m’adubo aboth mumbe, 
      Yesu de bedo i ia lwe; 
      An ke abedo i ie de, 
      Dong’ afoi Jalar. 
 
4.  Iko ibin de ba Jalarna, 
     En de bileri ku rimbe nja; 
     Ilund ifoye ku foc mandha, 
     Dong’ ifoi Jalar. 
 
              Dong’ ifoi Jalarni, dong’ ifoi Jalarni, 
              Rimb Jalarni yang’ ucwir piri; 
              Dong’ ifoi Jalar.

title: Mer pa Yesu, maku ya jupake
content:
1.  Mer pa Yesu, maku ya jupake, 
     Wer pi bero pare ku kisa; 
     Ebeyiko udi dupa, 
     Mal’ i polo i bang’e, 
 
              Ka watundo i polo 
              Wabinwang’u mutoro dit mandha; 
              Ka waneno Yesu, 
              Dwandwa bipaku nyinge nja. 
 
2.  Ka fodi wawoth i ng’om maeni, 
     Mudho cido wang’ayo iwa; 
     Dwong’ ku bero pa Rwoth Yesu 
     Dwoko wang’wa leng’ andha. 
 
3.  Dong’ wabed asu ku tic m’emio, 
      Wagene pi tego ku ba ceng’; 
      Sukulia pare nuti, 
      Wabinwang’e ka ma leng’, 
 
4.  Dong’ wacir masendi ceke kuni, 
      Wabineno wang’ Jalar Yesu; 
      Kan ejolowa i polo, 
      Wabibedo kude nja.

title: Ayero lem pa Yesu
content:
1.  Ayero lem pa Yesu, e mit dit mandha ira, 
    Pi Yesu ku dwong’ pare, mer de m’emaru kowa. 
    Ayero lem pa Yesu, kum ene lemandha; 
    Eromo cwinya ceke, ma sagu lem mange. 
 
             Ayero lem pa Yesu, elaru ju m’uwinjo, 
             Ebodho ju m’uyio, Yesu m’umaruwa. 
 
2.  Ayero lem pa Yesu, elar ekonya dre; 
     Ayenya dong’ ayere kara ekonyi de. 
     Ayero lem pa Yesu, esagu pidoic, 
     Esagu mido mi cam, e mit ma sagu kic. 
 
3.  Ayero lem pa Yesu; jumoko winjo ngo, 
     Girem ni dwong’ pa Mungu, lembariba wacu do; 
     Ayero lem pa Yesu, e lem mi both iwa, 
     Aol ungo niyere, ya Yesu tho piwa. 
 
4.  Ayero lem pa Yesu, kum kec unegojo; 
     Pi kwen mi kwo ma Yesu, ecopo yeng’ojo. 
     Ayero lem pa Yesu, abed afoi Jalar, 
     Amare con ku tin de, abibemare nja!

title: Pake! Pake!
content:
1.  Pake! Pake! Yesu Kristu ma Jawar mwa, 
     Cak wer i ng’om ceke kum mer ma dwong’, 
     Pake! Pake! Wu jumalaika m’i bang’e 
     Pak nyinge ma tegone sagu nja! 
     Ebikurowa, wan wa nyithindho pare, 
     Rombene ekwayuwa ku ba saa! 
 
              Pake! Pake! Yung Yesu Kristu ma Rwoth mwa, 
              Pake hai ku wer mir anyong’a kwa! 
 
2.  Pake! Pake! Yesu Kristu  ma Jawar mwa! 
     Rimbe cwir, etho de pi dubo mwa, 
     Jalar mwa, wagene pi both ma juboth ko; 
     Pake! Pake! maku wayunge do! 
     Merne pore ngo, ng’a copo pido lwarne? 
     Dhanu yu mi ng’om, Yesu maru kpo. 
 
3.  Pake! Pake! Yesu Kristu ma Jawar mwa! 
     Ebibino, bimo wi dhanu yu! 
     Ker bibedo pare mandha ku ma pwe de; 
     Rwoth mi rwodhi, maku juyunge le! 
     Ubimo mandha! Bimwa ku cwiny m’ukwio, 
     Con ijwigri, meni judodi dre!

title: Meni ang’eyo, Yesu Rwodha
content:
1.  Meni ang’eyo, Yesu Rwodha, 
    Berone bedo nja i cwinya; 
    Tipone nyolo dhanu ma nyen, 
    Anyong’a nega ceng’ ku ba ceng’, 
 
              Both ma juboth ko ai i bang’e, 
              Lembe m’eng’olo etimbre be. 
              Mungu maraga kud iyeny ki, 
              Kum Yesu kende, E m’ubodhi. 
 
2.  Konya ku yero lem peri ber, 
     Gin ma iyenyo e ma ayer; 
     Ayeny awoth i yo peri cu, 
     Lembe mi ng’om abiweke do. 
 
3.  Yesu ameri, tel wia nja, 
     Akuro dwogo peri mandha; 
     Ang’ayo wang’a yor i polo, 
     Kum ibigamu juperi kpo.

title: Wupak nying’ Mungu m’Ubimo
content:
1.  Wupak nying’ Mungu m’Ubimo 
    E Mungu ma won yung; 
    Emio Wode ya etho 
    Ni laru dhanu yu. 
 
              Yesu bodhowa! Yesu bodhowa! 
              Yesu bodhowa ku rimbe. 
              Yesu bodhowa! Yesu bodhowa! 
              Yesu bodhowa ku rimbe. 
 
2.  Nying’ Yesu sagu nying’ mange; 
     Wayunge ku wer mwa; 
     Ejany malu jatego kpo, 
     Juyunge ku wer kwa. 
 
3.  Jawar, Jalar, Jarimb dhanu 
     Ma yang girwinyo swa, 
     Eyabu yo mi both iwa 
     M’utundo i polo. 
 
4.  Julwong’o nyinge Wang’uic, 
     Japorlembe ma ber; 
     Jaditmawijo, Kwiocwiny, 
     Jatego ma wi ker.

title: Ayenyo Mungu mi ira
content:
1.  Ayenyo Mungu mi ira 
    Lem yung m’ayunge ko. 
    Ewara ndhu ku tegone, 
    Ku berone mandha. 
 
2.  Rwoth para mina tegocwiny 
     M’atuc ko beroni, 
     Ni ju mi ng’om kara giyi; 
     Gin de gifoi nyingi. 
 
3.  E! Yesu! Nyigi mit andha, 
     Ekwio cwinya lwe! 
     Eriemo can ku lworo de, 
     Enyay’ anyong’a kwa. 
 
4.  Egonya kud i dubona, 
     Ewodha kud i tho; 
     Enyayu foyofoc ira, 
     Rimbe udwoka bo.

title: Pak nying' Rwoth Yesu
content:
1.	Pak nying’ Rwoth Yesu, nying’ ma dwong’ 
    Malaika rum ire; 
    Jamkermiwic waroi wie, 
    Wayunge Rwoth mi rwodhi! 
    Rwoth mi rwodhi kpo! 
 
2.	Wu piny pare ma piwu tek 
    I wang’ Jawar ma Rwoth, 
    Ekoyowu pi tic ma pwe, 
    Wuyunge Rwoth mi rwodhi! 
    Rwoth mi rwodhi kpo! 
 
3.	Wu suru ceke, dhanu yu, 
    M’ubedo kwo i ng’om, 
    Wudode ni ubimo mu, 
    Wuyunge Rwoth mi rwodhi! 
    Rwoth mi rwodhi kpo! 
 
4.	Ka wabitundo kuca ma 
    Wajwigra the tiende, 
    Wapeki dit ku wer ma nja,   
    Wayungi, Rwoth mi rwodhi! 
    Rwoth mi rwodhi kpo!

title: Tek lworo nyai i cwinywa dit
content:
1.  Tek lworo nyai i cwinywa dit, 
    Kapondo mwa e Rwoth Mungu; 
    Ekurowa i can ma lic, 
    Kapondo mwa e Rwoth Mungu. 
 
            E Mungu in I cana, kapondo mwa! 
            Kapondo mwa, kapondo mwa; 
            E Mungu in I cana, kapondo mwa! 
            Kapondo mwa n’i Rwoth Mungu. 
 
2.  Tek koth ucwi e polo mor, 
     Kapondo mwa e Rwoth Mungu; 
     Tek ng’om umiel e pi de woi, 
     Kapondo mwa e Rwoth Mungu. 
 
3.  Ku ba dieceng’, ku ba diewor, 
     Kapondo mwa e Rwoth Mungu; 
     Thong’om m’uwotho i mudho, 
     Kapondo mwa e Rwoth Mungu. 
 
4.  Rwoth konya do i lembe kpo, 
     Kapondo mwa e Rwoth Mungu; 
     I Mungu para ndhu rondo, 
     Kapondo mwa e Rwoth Mungu.

title: Wan wawinjo lemandha
content:
1.  Wan wawinjo lemandha, 
     Yesu kende Jalar; 
     Lembene mutoro kwa! 
     Yesu kende Jalar. 
     Rimone belwokowa, 
     Rimbe copo lonyowa, 
     Yioyic m’unyuthowa 
     Yesu kende Jalar! 
 
2.  Mungu wacu iwa kpo 
      Yesu kende Jalar; 
      Dong’ wuwinj kathere do, 
      Yesu kende Jalar. 
      Dhanu yu wung’eye be, 
      Co ku mon, nyithindho de 
      Wucik ithwu kume ki! 
      Yesu kende Jalar! 
 
3.  Dong’ wu dhanu wuwinj cu, 
      Yesu kende Jalar; 
      En ekwero mire ngo, 
      Yesu kende Jalar. 
      Tek wayie, wabiboth, 
      Lembe pare wacu do; 
      Keth jung’ei kathere cu, 
      Yesu kende Jalar.

title: Ageno bero para ngo
content:
1.  Ageno bero para ngo, 
    Ajengra kum lem ng’om de ngo; 
    Ndhu rimb Yesu m’uoi pira, 
    Ku berone m’agenona. 
 
            Yesu ma kidi mi gundot, 
            Jukwere con, m’ekelo both; 
            Jukwere con, m’ekelo both. 
 
2.  Tek mudho cido wang’a de, 
     Ageno bero peri be; 
     Tek dubo voya, cida bi, 
     Elwoka tek atucogi. 
 
3.  Lewic umbe ni jupare 
     M’ugene i masendi de; 
     Eng’olo lembaribane 
     M’ulokre ngo, jugene dre. 
 
4.  I ceng’ mi lieu, tic mwa ma ber  
     Binen ni dhanu ceke her! 
     Eronya ndhu ku bedopwe 
     M’unen ni Thekdhanumange.

title: Yesu loro, jolo can
content:
1.  Yesu loro, jolo can 
     Kar’ elar judubo wan, 
     Aka! Edoko jacan, 
     Haleluya! E Jalarna! 
 
2.  Dhanu yanye, caye dit, 
     Julubne de weke pet; 
     Jupade, jufode lith. 
     Haleluya! E Jalarna! 
 
3.  Dubo cidowa col ku, 
      Yo ma leng’ waweko yu; 
      Yesu re eleng’ ma njwa. 
      Haleluya! E Jalarna. 
 
4.  Ram etho ko mire ma! 
      Tho ku liel ekaku dra, 
      Kan eidho ba Wegwa. 
      Haleluya! E Jalarna.

title: Pi yen m’athara wapid pire be
content:
1.  Pi yen m’athara wapid pire be, 
     Ma Rwoth mi polo utho i wie, 
     Giki ma naka kuloka ira, 
     Ceke ma nanu, kuhaya kwa. 
 
2.  Ikwera Yesu ya kud alula, 
     Andre agen tho m’itho ko pira; 
     Gin m’uyenyo wilo wia piri 
     Aweke ceke ni kum rimbi. 
 
3.  Masendi m’isendri ko i kumwa 
     Nyutho mer peri m’imaru kowa, 
     Yau mer ma dit ma rokeni ane? 
     Cen ma dit ma rokeni ane? 
 
4.  Kadok alonjra ku piny mi ng’om yu, 
     E giramia m’urem dit iri, 
     Merni m’imara ko jai ira ndhu, 
     Atingra dho amira iri.

title: Nak’ a jatic pa Satani
content:
1.  Nak’ a jatic pa Satani, 
     Ku lem dubo pare de; 
     Ento dong’ ayenyo para, 
     I Jalar ma Wod Mungu. 
 
             Yesu roma kud anyong’a, 
             Kum emio kwo ma nja; 
             Ene Rwoth mwa ma Jalar mwa, 
             Ene Jamer m’andhandha. 
 
2.  Yesu Kristu yang’ ebino, 
     Kar’ ebodhwa ju m’ukier; 
     Man eii ku wonabali, 
     Nwang’ eyenyo ya warwiny. 
 
3.  Yesu Kristu ma jugure, 
     Kar’ edwok cwiny dhanu nyen, 
     Ewodh dhanu kud i mudho, 
     Etel wigi ka ma leng’. 
 
4.  Yesu Kristu, ebidwogo, 
     Kar’ ecokwa ju m’uboth; 
     Wabibed’ i ng’om wakugi, 
     Ebibimo dhanu yu.

title: An ayenyona lonyo ku jupiny dit ungo
content:
1.  An ayenyona lonyo ku jupiny dit ungo, 
    An ayeny’ amond i polo ba Yesu Kristu; 
    I kitabu pa Mungu, e kitabu mi kwo, 
    Ko iyer ira Yesu, nyo igoro nyinga? 
 
              Nyo igoro nyinga i kitabu mi kwo? 
              I kitabu ma peri, nyo igoro nyinga? 
 
2.  Dubo para gi dupa calu kwio dhu nam. 
     Ento rimo Jalarna uberucogi kpo; 
     Lembe peri m’ukieure ene lembe mandha, 
     Kadok dubo gi kwar ngbo, ebilwokogi kpo. 
 
3.  Pacu para i polo, ene leng’ njwa mandha, 
      Ju m’ubedo i ie kendo kendi ma tar; 
      Dubo ceke mbe kuca, man ke lem tho de mbe, 
      Ka ma Yesu ni ie, nyo jugoro nyinga?
