title: Kud ikuna Jalar Yesu
content:
1.  Kud ikuna Jalar Yesu, 
     Winj lem para do. 
    Kan ikonyo jumange, Rwoth, 
    Kud ikuna do! 
 
          Jalar, Yesu, kud ikuna do! 
          Kan ikonyo jumange, Rwoth, kud ikuna do! 
 
2.  Ia pido kum lem dubo, 
     Dong’ atuce kpo; 
     Can unego cwinya ceke, 
     Yesu lara do! 
 
3.  Tipo peri copo konya 
     Ku ng’ic para do, 
     Etel wia yor i beng’i, 
     Eyik rwona cu. 
 
4.  Yesu in ijuko cwinya 
     Sagu jumange; 
     Dong’ ageno in ikendi, 
     Ng’atu mange mbe.

title: Lem ma dit lem pa Yesu
content:
1.  Lem ma dit lem pa Yesu. (3) 
    Lembe roma dit andha. 
 
2.  Ebitela ba Yesu. (3) 
     Lembe roma dit andha. 
 
3.  Kum ekonya ceng’ ceke, (3) 
     Lembe roma dit andha. 
 
4.  Kan avoc, ebijuka, (3) 
     Lembe roma dit andha. 
 
5.  Ebitera i polo, (3) 
     Lembe roma dit andha.

title: In iwok ba Yesu kara elwoki?
content:
1.  In iwok ba Yesu kara elwoki? 
    En elwoki ku rimbe m’ucwir? 
    Nindo nini in igeno berone? 
    En elwoki ku rimbe m’ucwir? 
 
            Elwoki ku rimo? 
            En elwoki ku rimbe m’ucwir? 
            Cwinyi bedo leng’ ma sagu vulo kpo? 
            En e elwoki ku rimbe m’ucwir? 
 
2.  In iwotho ku ba ceng’ i ng’et Jalar? 
     En elwoki ku rimbe m’ucwir? 
     In ijengri ru kor Yesu Kristu Rwoth? 
     En elwoki ku rimbe m’ucwir? 
 
3.  Ceng’ ma Yesu dwogo, ebinweng’i leng’? 
     En elwoki ku rimbe m’ucwir? 
     Ii doko tar ni kum rimb Jalarni? 
     En elwoki ku rimbe m’ucwir? 
 
4.  Gin m’uwilo wi i kume, baye cen, 
     En elwoki ku rimbe m’ucwir? 
     Koc ku dubo ceke woth i bedopwe, 
     En elwoki ku rimbe m’ucwir?

title: An amaru Mungu
content:
1.  An amaru Mungu! 
    En ukungu mer mandha, 
    Yesu bino yenyowa, 
    Man etho nilaruwa, 
    Wa judubo ceke. 
 
           An a nyathin pa Mungu, asikari pa Yesu, 
           Abiworo cik pare, tegone bikonya. 
 
2.  An amaru Yesu! 
     Kum emio kwo iwa, 
     Kan etho wi Golgotha; 
     Man ebino ribowa, 
     E Jarimo mandha. 
 
3.  Jajuk para nuti, 
     Ayenyo eroma de, 
     E Japonji para de, 
     Etuco the lembene 
     Mi lembe pa Mungu. 
 
4.  Ava gin m’unega, 
      Woth ma yor i polo re, 
      Kaka dhanu mandhandha 
      Wabitimo tic ma leng’ 
      Nja ku nja k’anyong’a.

title: Rimo m’akira pire wok
content:
1.  Rimo m’akira pire wok 
    Bang’a m’a jadubo, 
    Ya tek julwoka kude ngo, 
    Dub’na birucre ngo. 
 
             Elonyowa, elonyowa, 
             Rimb Yesu cwir nilonyowa, 
             Wafoi Jalar mwa Yesu, kum 
             Elonyowa ma nja ku nja. 
 
2.  Awotho ngo i mudho tin, 
     Kum Yesu der mi ng’om; 
     Etelo wiwa ku ba ceng’, 
     Walubo toke ndhu. 
 
3.  Ia wang’ li kum berone 
     M’ukethe tho piwa; 
     Rwoth Yesu kende m’uromo 
     Niyeyo dubo mwa.

title: Yesu Kristu en E yo
content:
1.  Yesu Kristu en E yo, 
     Kajik yoje ka ma leng’, 
     Tek wakwanyu yoje dre, 
     Wabitundo i bang’e. 
 
            Yesu Rwoth, Jalar mwa, 
            Wabifoye nja ku nja; 
            Yesu Rwoth, Jalar mwa, 
            Wabifoye nja ku nja. 
 
2.  Yesu en E lemandha, 
     En edagu lem mi ndra, 
     Man E kwo ma nja ku nja, 
     Terowa ndhu ba Wegwa. 
 
3.  Yesu ene kwen mi kwo,  
     Kec binegowa ngo; 
     Bed imi kwen iwa do, 
     Kwen m’uai ndhu i polo. 
 
4.  Yesu ene der mi ng’om, 
     Der m’umio iwa kwo; 
     Woth i mudho rwinyojo, 
     Der pare benyutho yo.

title: Yesu belwong’i bin bang’e tho
content:
1.  Yesu belwong’i bin bang’e tho, 
     Lem pare nyutho E yo mi kwo; 
     Keni i kindwa ecungo tin, 
     Ewacu “Dong’ ibin”. 
 
            Wabinene kud anyong’a kwa, 
            Ku juwadwa ma gicokri lwar, 
            Gidoko tar ma dubo de mbe, 
            Rimb Yesu lwokogi. 
 
2.  Wuwek nyithindho bin ba Jalar, 
     Kum ker mi polo migi mandha; 
     Elwong’ogi ku cwinye ma ber, 
     Kud wugal ki! Wubin! 
 
3.  Par pire cu, elwong’i asu 
     Man ebijoli, bin bang’e pio; 
     Wek dubo peri, lub tok Jalar, 
     En ebinyoli nyen.

title: Ddwand Rwodha mit ira
content:
1.  Ddwand Rwodha mit ira, 
     M’ulwong’a bin bang’e; 
     Bilwoko ia ku rimbe, 
     M’ucwir wi Kalvari. 
 
              Abebino Rwoth, abebino Rwoth, 
              Ko ilwok ia edok leng’  
              Ku rimoni m’ucwir. 
 
2.  Kadok abedo ng’ic, 
     Mi ira tegoni, 
     Lony gondrina ku rimoni 
     E poyone bithum. 
 
3.  Abino Yesu Rwoth, 
     Iketh ageni ndhu, 
     Ikwio cwinya cungo ti, 
     Dwok yioyicna cu. 
 
4.  Afoyo rimb Yesu, 
      Afoyo berone; 
      Afoyo Rwoth Yesu Kristu, 
      Ku tegone ceke.

title: An awok ba Kalvari
content:
1.  An awok ba Kalvari, 
    A jacan e kuma ng’ic; 
    An ayenyo kwo ma nja, 
    Kum iyeyo dubona. 
 
            Rwoth ageno beroni, 
            Kum itho wi Kalvari; 
            Rimbi cwir nilonyojo, 
            Lara Yesu, lara do. 
 
2.  Dubo bimo tipona, 
     Nindo lwar awotho swa; 
     Yesu weco yo ira, 
     “Abibodhi ku rimba”. 
 
3.  Dong’ amira gira bo; 
     An adoko peri ndhu, 
     Kuma dho ku pinya kpo, 
     An amio iri do.

title: Were kendo, emit ira
content:
1.  Were kendo, emit ira, 
    Lembe ma dwong’ mi kwo! 
    Yesu Kristu ewok bang’a, 
    Lembe ma dwong’ mi kwo. 
    Nwang’a swa i yamba,  
    Lembene ugwela. 
 
            Anyong’a kwa, lembe mandha, 
            Lembe ma dwong’ mi kwo. 
            Anyong’a kwa, lembe mandha, 
            Lembe ma dwong’ mi kwo. 
 
2.  Yung Jalar kum emiowa  
     Lembe ma dwong’ mi kwo. 
     Kisa nege pi ju ma swa, 
     Lembe ma dwong’ mi kwo. 
     Tek watuco dubo, 
     En ecopo ruco. 
 
3.  Keth ewinjre ni dhanu pet, 
     Lembe ma dwong’ mi kwo, 
     Watund kugi i polo de, 
     Lembe ma dwong’ mi kwo. 
     Wanen be Jawar mwa, 
     Wapak nying’ Jalar mwa.

title: Bin dhanu yu
content:
1.  Bin dhanu yu, bin dhanu yu, 
     Wurwinyo dit andha; 
     Jalar mu de belwong’owu. 
     Winj dwand Jalar mu tin. 
 
             Bin ba Yesu, bin ba Yesu, 
             Ebelwong’owu; 
             Bin ba Yesu, bin ba Yesu, 
             Ebilaruwu. 
 
2.  Kum rimb Jalar yang’ con uoi 
     Nibodho dhanu yu; 
     Tuc dubo mu m’ucidowu, 
     Rimbe bilwokowu. 
 
3.  Ewacu “An a lemandha, 
     Ku kwo, ku wang’ayo.” 
     Kwany yoje ndhu m’igalu ngo, 
     E ibinwang’u kwo. 
 
4.  Bin mond i kind Jukristu do, 
     M’ulubo bedopwe, 
     Wakudu karacelo wa 
     Bitundo ka ma leng’.

title: Tek in iyenyo inwang’ kwo ma nja
content:
1.  Tek in iyenyo inwang’ kwo ma nja, 
    Nen Rombo pa Mungu. 
    Ndhu Yesu kende mio both mandha, 
    Nen Rombo pa Mungu. 
 
          Nen Rombo pa Mungu, 
          Kuca wi Kalvari; 
          Ecopo bodhowa en ekende, 
          Nen Rombo pa Mungu. 
 
2.  Bed kud anyong’a, Yesu meri dit, 
     Nen Rombo pa Mungu. 
     Tin ebilwoki ku rimbe m’ucwir, 
     Nen Rombo pa Mungu. 
 
3.  Lok cwinyi tin, gen peri Yesu Rwoth, 
     Nen Rombo pa Mungu. 
     Yio Rwoth Yesu mio iwa kwo, 
     Nen Rombo pa Mungu. 
 
4.  Ceng’ ma watundo malu ka ma leng’, 
     Yesu binen iwa; 
     Man ebidoko Rwoth mi dhanu pet, 
     Kerne bibedo nja.

title: Ceng’ ma pidoic udieng’o cwinyi
content:
1.  Ceng’ ma pidoic udieng’o cwinyi 
     Kwai Yesu konyi, kwai Yesu konyi; 
     Cwinyi ringo rr kum lembe moko 
     Kwai Yesu konyi, gene. 
 
             Kwai Yesu konyi, kwai Yesu konyi, 
             E Jamer mandhandha; 
             Jakony mange mbe ma ro ku Yesu, 
             Kwai Yesu konyi, gene. 
 
2.  Can unegi, man pi weng’i oi brr, 
     Kwai Yesu konyi, kwai Yesu konyi; 
     Kud ilwor ki, ento yie kende, 
     Kwai Yesu konyi, gene. 
 
3.  Cwinyi miel e lworo de benegi, 
     Kwai Yesu konyi, kwai Yesu konyi; 
     Dubo nyayu lewic dit i weng’i, 
     Kwai Yesu konyi, gene. 
 
4.  Tek ilworo tho ma ibitho ko, 
     Kwai Yesu konyi, kwai Yesu konyi; 
     Ko ilar iyie kud i cwinyi, 
     Kwai Yesu konyi, gene. 
 
5.  Tek ithoko voyo lem mi dubo, 
      Kwai Yesu konyi, kwai Yesu konyi; 
      Som lem pa Rwoth Yesu, ebijuki, 
      Kwai Yesu konyi, gene.

title: Lem pa Yesu abiyio
content:
1.  Lem pa Yesu abiyio, (3) 
    Abiyio lembe pa Yesu. 
 
            Yo m’etelo abilube, (3) 
            Abilund ng’ei Yesu Kristu. 
 
2.  Ka can nuti abikwaye, (3) 
     Abikwayu ru Yesu Kristu. 
 
3.  Lem m’eyero abiwinjo, (3) 
      Abiwinjo lembe pa Yesu. 
 
4.  Tic m’emio abitimo, (3) 
     Abitimo ni Yesu Kristu. 
 
5.  Ka tho senda abigene, (3) 
      Abigeno ru Yesu Kristu.

title: Walub tok Yesu kum ene der mwa
Dwok cwinya leng’ Yesu
content:
1.  Dwok cwinya leng’ Yesu, pidoicna bende, 
     Mia mwonyolembe tek jucora cen; 
     Dong’ agen Jalarna, man abed ku rwo, 
     Kab adieng’acwinya, bim wi kuma dho. 
 
2.  Mi dwokrileng’ iwa, walub bedopwe, 
     Wayenyo iromwa ku Tipo Maleng’; 
     Wathkumwa tim iri, jumiru mandha, 
     Keth can de unegwa tek watimo swa. 
 
3.  Wang’ei yeny pa Mungu m’e yire, m’e cu, 
     Man kothwa de lokre, wathier kumwa dho; 
     Wang’ei lembang’ola, wawore awe, 
     Wabed calu Yesu, kud ayine de.

title: Nyo an a soldat pa Jalar
content:
1.  Nyo an a soldat pa Jalar, akendo kendine? 
    Lewic unega pi Rwodha, amung’o berone? 
 
2.  Nyo an ageno abed nyap, ju mange sendri gin? 
     Juyenya e aura ve, wek gin githo i lwiny? 
 
3.  Jakworna Jok ku dubo dee, edoko jamerna? 
     Amer ku ju m’udagu Rwoth, arogo juwada? 
 
4.  Dong’ awek amone ma rac, m’atimo ba juwada! 
     Mak’ akied lwiny ku tegocwiny, atho ko ng’ei Rwodha!

title: Yo ma Yesu telo iwa bedo ber
content:
1.  Yo ma Yesu telo iwa bedo ber, 
    Wa jukwenda pare dong’ wawore tho; 
    Ju ma wotho kude jumutoro kwa, 
    Ndhu niwotho ka ma Yesu orowa. 
 
            Lworo mbe, cac umbe, wawinj dwand Jalar, 
            Ka ma Yesu orowa wawore ba. 
 
2.  Tek awotho kude, ebiweka ngo, 
     Ka jumerna bende kindwa koc kugi; 
     I masendi ceke kadi ndiba de, 
     Yesu nyayu foyofoc i dhoga re. 
 
3.  Tek wamaru Yesu dong’ wamare cu, 
     Gin ma ie yenyo dong’ watime ndhu; 
     Lem mi ng’om bikadhu kud ayungane, 
     Ento wabibedo nja ku nja bang’e.

title: Wukuru, wubed nger de
content:
1.  Wukuru, wubed nger de, 
     Wu soldats pa Yesu; 
     Wuting’ abera pare, 
     Man wulub toke cu. 
 
            Jadegi mwa Satani, m’uyenyo rwinyo dhanu; 
            Jalar mwa Yesu loye kor yen mi Kalvari. 
 
2.  Wukuru, wubed nger de, 
     Ku tego pa Yesu; 
     Wukoc ku dubo ceke, 
     Ku lem pa Jok de ndhu. 
 
3.  Wukuru, wubed nger de, 
     Rony jamtho pa Mungu; 
     Wugut ni wonabali, 
     E ebiringowu. 
 
4.  Wukuru, wubed nger de, 
     Ceng’ moko lwiny bithum; 
     E Yesu won aloci 
     Bibimo dhanu yu.

title: Athang’u cinga beng’i Rwoth
content:
1.  Athang’u cinga beng’i Rwoth 
    Dieceng’ ku diewor bu! 
    Aywak ba ng’a tek ikuna? 
    Yehova won tego. 
 
           Ayio do, ayio do, 
           Ya Yesu tho pira, 
           Rimbe m’ucwir wi Kalvari 
           Belonyo gondrina. 
 
2.  Juthumo nyathi romboni, 
     M’ing’olo iwa con; 
     Apoi pi kadhukuwijo, 
     Ketho waboth ni tho. 
 
3.  Iwinjo ywak mi dhoga de 
     Kum can m’utima dit; 
     Imia caku lonyoni, 
     Ni kum Jalar Yesu.

title: Kudh agwara do
content:
1.  Kudh agwara do, dong’ wacokra kpo! 
    Jukwojwa gitie i wang’wa ca! 
    Ting’ abera mwa wakur bang’e ba! 
    Yesu Jawipiro mwa mandha! 
 
            Bed tek! Wuting’ cingwu m’uoi jeble! 
            Bed ayika! Wudwok congwu tek! 
            Cidh i weng’wu, lwiny ma dit bekiedre! 
            Yesu Jawipiro mwa mandha! 
 
2.  Cung atira do, wuriei cu jufwa! 
     Lem mi bedopwe m’esagu kpo! 
     Aloci ku dwong’ ene yioyic, 
     Yesu Jawipiro mwa mandha! 
 
3.  Man ka lwiny uthum ka wavoyogi, 
     Sukulia mwa jamkermiwic; 
     Ini Mungu mwa, wabipeki nja, 
     Wabilubo Jawipiro mwa!

title: Cwinywa ripo ndhu;  Jengri, jengri
content:
1.  Cwinywa ripo ndhu waku Yesugi 
     Ka wajengra kor Jalar Yesu,  
     Wan wabedo ber, pidoic umbe,  
     Ka wajengra kor Jalar Yesu. 
 
             Jengri, jengri; 
             Ejengo ju m’ugene cu.  
            Jengri, jengri; 
            Dong’ wajengra kor Jalar Yesu. 
 
2.  Wan wawotho ber i yo pa Jalar  
     Ka wajengra kor Jalar Yesu. 
     Yo mwa lero ber kum Yesu m’E der,  
     Ka wajengra kor Jalar Yesu. 
 
3.  Wan wayeny’ ang’o, wan walwor ang’o  
     Ka wajengra kor Jalar Yesu?  
     Cwinywa kwio kpo, ndiri ringo bor  
     Ka wajengra kor Jalar Yesu.

title: Wacidhu, Jukrisu, waci kiedo lwiny
content:
1.  Wacidhu, Jukrisu, waci kiedo lwiny, 
     Wanen ko ba Yesu jathek yioyic; 
     En etelo wiwa, ebivoyo de, 
     Kied ku tegocwinywu, wabivoyo be. 
 
               Wacidhu Jukristu, waci kiedo lwiny, 
               Wavoi ko Satani ndhu ku tegocwiny! 
 
2.  Tek walubo Yesu wabivoyo Jok, 
     Tek wucogo wie, ebiringo pio; 
     Ene wonabidhe, won agobe de, 
     Lemandha bivoye, wawodh lembene. 
 
3.  Kanisa pa Kristu, ene thek acel, 
     Ku juwada dupa, jatelwic acel; 
     Kisa pare ribowa ndhu ku ripocwiny, 
     Wan acel ku genogen, man ku berocwiny. 
 
4.  Dong’ wacidh i wang’wa wan wa ju pa Rwoth, 
     Aloci ni bang’wa rondo ku rondo; 
     Ubimo mwa Yesu bimo dhanu yu, 
     Dwong’ ku pak mi dhogwa 
     Bed ni Rwoth mwa ndhu!

title: Cung i lembang’ola
content:
1.  Cung i lembang’ola pa Rwoth Yesu mwa, 
     Dong’ ipak nying’ Yesu, dong’ ifoye nja; 
     Lembe pare cungo ene lemandha, 
     Cung i lembang’ola pa Jalar. 
 
          Gene, gene, 
          Dong’ igen gin ceke ma Rwoth Yesu ng’olo, 
          Gene, gene, 
          Gen lembang’ola pa Rwoth Yesu mwa. 
 
2.  Cung i lembang’ola pa Rwoth Yesu mwa, 
     Lembe pare nyothre ngo, ebedo nja; 
     Man lewic binego ju m’ugene ngo, 
     Cung i lembang’ola pa Jalar. 
 
3.  Cung i lembang’ola pa Rwoth Yesu mwa, 
     Lembe ma bigonyowa e lemandha; 
     Ene lem mi kwo ni ju m’uyie de, 
     Cung i lembang’ola pa Jalar.

title: Jukristu wuwek lem ma sai
content:
1.  Jukristu wuwek lem ma sai, 
     Wameku ban mi lwiny; 
     Wugalu dwong’ i lem mi ng’om, 
     Wunyayu ndhu ng’eicwiny, 
     Kum Yesu neno dubo mwa, 
     Kadok wasomo hai, 
     Aloci mwa m’uloyo ng’om 
     E yioyic mandha. 
 
              Rwoth voyo dubi kpo, Rwoth voyo dubo kpo; 
              Aloci m’uloyo ng’om, ndhu yioyic mandha. 
 
2.  Wating’ jamtho pa Mungu kpo, 
     Thungu mi yioyic, 
     Waroi asi mi bedopwe, 
     Ku rwo, kwayukwac. 
     Mer pare en abera mwa, 
     Ku pala pa Jalar, 
     Ma lake bith ma kun ku kun, 
     Ma ene lemandha. 
 
3.  Judegi mwa gitiekowa, 
     Gilibo tego mwa, 
     Athero migi kilowa, 
     Gigom kum thungu mwa; 
     Waketho sabu de mi both, 
     Walutho wara de, 
     Aloci mwa m’uloyo ng’om, 
     Ndhu yioyic mandha.

title: Cor ceng’ni bang’a, Rwoth
content:
1.  Cor ceng’ni bang’a, Rwoth,  
     Kwi cwinya, dwoka mol,  
     Kum tegona thum kot,  
     Ang’ic e kuma ol. 
 
             Bed ceng’ni, kud iweka,  
             Tego peri tieka;  
             Konj bero peri roma, 
             Rwoth para; Yesu. 
 
2.  Bed ceng’ni bang’a Rwoth,  
     Jabidhe senda dit; 
     Dwok ter mi cwinya yot,  
     Juka ku dwal ma mit. 
 
3.  Ling’ curna, jajukna,  
     Ing’eyo ndiba mwa;  
     Ku pidoic mi ng’om,  
     Man tho m’usendowa. 
 
4.  A ng’eca peri Rwoth,  
     Amira iri dho; 
     Keth rimbi lwoka cu,  
     Ku pidoia kpo.

title: Mungu, lembe tuc i bang’a
content:
1.  Mungu, lembe tuc i bang’a, 
    Pi mugisa peri de,  
    Ma imio ni juperi, 
    Ko imie ira le. 
    Ira le, ira le, ko imie ira le. 
 
2.  Kud ikuna Mungu Wegwa,  
     Ana rac, akier de swa;  
     Bed ku kisa dit i kuma,  
     Kan atuco dubona, 
     Dubona, dubona, kan atuco dubona. 
 
3.  Jalar Yesu, kud iweka, 
     An ajengra kumi ki; 
     An ayenyo bero peri,  
     Kum itho wi Kalvari, 
     Kalvari, Kalvari, kum itho wi Kalvari. 
 
4.  Mer pa Mungu, mer ma leng’ kwe,  
     Rimb Jalar ma pire tek, 
     Bero peri nen i wothna 
     Kan alubo toki pwe, 
     Toki pwe, toki pwe, kan alubo toki pwe.

title: Yesu, abed ceng’ni in
content:
1.  Yesu, abed ceng’ni in, 
     Ceng’ni rimbi keca; 
     M’ucwir con ni dhanu yu,  
     Kulo mir alwoka. 
 
            Ceng’ni in, ceng’ni in,  
            Abed ndhu the tiendi, 
            Cil ma ceng’ m’atugo woth,  
            M’aci ko i beng’i. 
 
2.  Piny i ng’om a jawirok,  
     Kisa peri nwang’a; 
     In m’I cero jobi iwok,  
     In irieny i wang’a. 
 
3.  Ceng’ni in I rombona,  
     In m’itho kakara; 
     Kony’ awoth ma ber andha,  
     Cil i ceng’ tho para. 
 
4.  Yesu, abed ceng’ni in, 
     Kara in ikonya; 
     Awoth ber ku ba rupiny,  
     Ram atund ko kuca.

title: Mungu biyepo cwiny dhanu
content:
1.  Mungu biyepo cwiny dhanu,  
     Eng’olo lembene con; 
     Ju ma gigalu bipoi ndhu, 
     E calu koth m’ubeton. 
 
             Koth ebicoro, 
             Kum cwinywa tal calu ng’om,  
             Ng’om m’uthwo kau, man ekak de,  
             Eketho cwinywa dok yom. 
 
2.  Mungu biyepo cwiny dhanu,  
     Nyinge m’ucidre bilony;  
     Man ebidwokowa leng’ njwa  
     Ni cilo m’ucidowa. 
 
3.  Mungu biyepo cwiny dhanu,  
     Nyo ebicore ndhu tin,  
     Tipo ma nyen ebimio,  
     Kier mwa juguro kor yen.

title: Jalarna Yesu weco cu
content:
1.  Jalarna Yesu weco cu  
    I bang’a ma wanambu ko;  
    Emaku cinga ku cinge,  
    Epeya ndhu i polone. 
 
           E ka ma leng’, e ka m’urieny,  
           Ma Yesu sagu der mi ceng’;  
           Eyiko ndhu kabedo mwa  
           Ma beco m’ubekurowa,  
           Ceng’ moko ebijolowa  
           Kuca polo nja ku nja. 
 
2.  I polo ka ma ng’wice ng’ar,  
     Kum dubo mbe, e ka ma ber;  
     Juparu kec ku rieu de ngo,  
     Man can ku tho junwang’u ngo. 
 
3.  Juwinjo dwal mi foyofoc,  
     Ku wer ma wabepaku ko  
     Jalar mwa, Yesu Kristu Rwoth,  
     M’utho nimio iwa kwo.

title: Jarimbwa mbe ro ku Jalar Yesu
content:
1.  Jarimbwa mbe ro ku Jalar Yesu, 
    Tak de mbe, tak de mbe;  
    Ng’atu mange mbe m’ulwoko cwinywa,  
    Tak de mbe, tak de mbe. 
 
           Yesu ng’eyo pi can mwa ceke,  
           Ebikonyowa rundi kpo; 
           Jarimbwa mbe ro ku Jalar Yesu,  
           Tak de mbe, tak de mbe. 
 
2.  Jarimbwa mbe ro ku en ma leng’ kwe,  
     Tak de mbe, tak de mbe; 
     Jarimbwa mbe ro ku en ma ming’ de,  
     Tak de mbe, tak de mbe. 
 
3.  Jakristu moko de mbe m’ekuno,  
     Tak de mbe, tak de mbe; 
     Ng’atu m’uyie de mbe m’eriemo,  
     Tak de mbe, tak de mbe. 
 
4.  Gin moko mbe ro ku Jalar Yesu.  
     Tak de mbe, tak de mbe; 
     Mer moko mbe ro ku mer pa Mungu,  
     Tak de mbe, tak de mbe.

title: An amio iri Rwoth
content:
1.  An amio iri Rwoth 
    Jukupiny m’abedo ko,  
    An ku lonyo para kpo  
    Gam maeni, jole do. 
 
2.  Tic m’atimo iri de,  
     Tiend’ ario ku cinga de:  
     Dwanda bende, yike do,  
     Keth apak Jalarna cu. 
 
3.  Nindo para m’an i ng’om  
     Kud anyothe calu con;  
     Atuc lembanyong’a ber,  
     Keth anyeb juwada lwar. 
 
4.  Cal ku yeny m’ayenyo ngo,  
     Ento cal’ iyenyo ri; 
     Pidoicna dwoke nyen, 
     Cwinya de bed ot ma leng’. 
 
5.  Kwona ceke peri, Rwoth, 
     Rimbi dwoka lonyoni;  
     Kwona ceke peri, Rwoth,  
     A jamiru peri do.

title: Kum Mungu maru ng’om mumbe
content:
1.  Kum Mungu maru ng’om mumbe  
    Emio Yesu Wod; 
    Tek ng’atu moko yie ndhu,  
    Ebedo kwo. 
 
2.  Jupadu thenge mire ma!  
     Lau dhoggi cide dit,  
     Ukudho cobo wie de,  
     Wi Kalvari. 
 
3.  Ecer m’eai kendo k’i liel,  
      Wuduny pire i ng’om; 
     Ka mir ang’o ke cwinywa miel,  
     Nilworo tho! 
 
4.  Juting’e malu, ka jajuk  
     Uloro ndhu ve mac, 
     M’E jatel yo, japonji de,  
     Ejukowa. 
 
5.  Jalar bidwogo kendo ba,  
     Emung’o iwa ngo; 
     Ya ebidwogo jolowa  
     I polo nja.

title: Akoyo nindo moko ndhu
content:
1.  Akoyo nindo moko ndhu 
    Ni rwo m’arum ko ni Rwoth Mungu,  
    M’acopo ting’o lembe kpo, 
    Akel apedhe i wang’e ndhu. 
 
             Arum the kom mi beroni, 
             Ajolo kisa peri de; 
             Ku tegocwiny akwei do,  
             Ikonya nindo mi ndiba kpo. 
 
2.  Tek can usagu cwinya kpo,  
     Ikwio cwinya ku beroni;  
     Ang’eyo ngo ram akwei,  
     Eyikre cu ni kum Tiponi. 
 
3.  Cor bang’a Mungu konya tin,  
     Acoro ceng’ni kum beroni,  
     Adundena upong’ andha  
     Ku yic m’ayio ko Munguna.

title: Kud iyi abidhe pa Satani ki
content:
1.  Kud iyi abidhe pa Satani ki,  
    Gut ni wonabali, ebiringoi;  
    Cor ndhu i vut Yesu, ecor i vuti,  
    Wukude, wuvoyo abidhene vi.  
 
              Kwai Jalar ya ekonyi, 
              Ivoi ng’atu m’ubidhi 
              Yesu nuti, bigwoki, 
             Ndhu ku tegone en. 
 
2.  Der ribre nenedi ku mudho mi ng’om?  
     Man bedopwe ribre ngo ku camuco;  
     Bed ku kwerigiri ni lem mi tarwang’,  
     Yung Mungu i kumi, woth i lemandha. 
 
3.  Ni ng’atu m’uloyo Rwoth mio jamker,  
     Man ke jubiyunge ku jamkermiwic;  
     Nen ndhu yo ba Yesu, ku tegone ndhu,  
     Aloci ni bang’wa, wan waku Yesu.

title: Yesu Kristu E jarimbwa
content:
1.  Yesu Kristu E jarimbwa,  
     Dubo mwa eyeyo re;  
     Mungu wacu ya wakwaye,  
     Gin m’wayenyo i bang’e.  
     Kwiocwiny urwinyo iwa,  
     Can usendowa mumbe,  
     Wiwa wil ni rwo ni Mungu  
     Ma waparu pire ngo. 
 
2.  Ndiba kud abidhe nuti,  
     Ku masendi dit mandha;  
     Ento Mungu juko cwinywa  
     Tek warwo i bang’e nja.  
     Ng’atu ma erom ku Yesu  
     Nwangre ngo i ng’om mae,  
     En eng’eyo ng’ic mwa ceke,  
     Wakwai tego i bang’e. 
 
3.  Ter ma pek unuro cwinywa,  
     Tego mwa dong’ nok ma gwei;  
     Tipo pare E jajuk mwa, 
     Mak etel wiwa i rwo. 
     Tek jurimbwa wanjri kumwa,  
     Dong’ waywak ni Mungu mwa, 
     Ebigwakuwa ku bote,  
     Ebijuko cwinywa nja.

title: Tim ve iyenyo, Mungu Rwodha
content:
1.  Tim ve iyenyo, Mungu Rwodha! 
     An a ulobo m’icwio ri; 
     Winya, icwia ku bodhoni,  
     Kan arum dwe the tego peri. 
 
2.  Tim ve iyenyo, Mungu Rwodha!  
     Nen yor i ia, mul ia do; 
     Kan ilwok ia, adok tar pu,  
     Arum, ajwigra the cingi do. 
 
3.  Tim ve iyenyo, Mungu Rwodha!  
     Nen ram a ng’ic ko, ko ikonya do;  
     Tegona ceke ai i beng’i, 
     Keth cwinya dok tek ku tegoni. 
 
4.  Tim ve iyenyo, Mungu Rwodha!  
     Bima I kendi, an a jendi;  
     Roma ku Tiponi ma jajuk,  
     Nen abikuro the tiendi yo.

title: Wabicokra i polo
content:
1.  Wabicokra i polo 
    Ku jumalaika pare;  
    Wabipake karacelo 
    Mal’ i polo ba Mungu ma leng’,  
 
            Wabinendra i polo, 
            Dhanu ceke ma giyio Yesu; 
            Wabibedo kud anyong’a, 
            Ni kum Rwoth mwa ma Yesu Jalar. 
 
2.  Con ka Yesu dok i polo, 
     Eyiko kabedo iwa; 
     Ebijolowa i bang’e 
    Kara wabed ndhu kuca mi nja. 
 
3.  Wabibedo kud anyong’a, 
     Ku juwadwa ma ni polo; 
     Wabifoye ka waneno 
     Udi dupa m’eyiko ma cu. 
 
4.  Ceng’ mange ma Yesu dwogo,  
     Ceng’ maeca dhingo ceng’ni;  
     Dong’ wabed ku rwo, wakie,  
     Bed ayika nicidho kude.

title: Bin juwadwa, nen abera
content:
1.  Bin juwadwa, nen abera pa Rwoth Yesu mwa. 
     Ebelwong’owa jupare, en aloci mwa. 
 
            “Dong’ wuki, kum abibino,” 
             Yesu wacu re, 
             Wan wadwoko lembe ire,  
            “Wan wabedo nger.” 
 
2.  Rwoth bidwogo, en ku kite,  
     Jumalaika de; 
     Jubikudh’ agwara pare,  
     Ku dwand jupare. 
 
3.  Wabekiedo ku Satani,  
     Ku jupare de; 
     Rwoth bimio tego iwa,  
     Wabivoye be. 
 
4.  Kadok mony uyenyo dhetho, 
     Rwoth bijengowa; 
     Tego ceke ai i bang’e 
     Riemo bebe mwa.

title: Mungu in i telo wia
content:
1.  Mungu in i telo wia 
     Kan awoth i ng’om keni; 
     An a ng’ic, in I won tego, 
     Gwoka ndhu ku tegoni. 
     Kwen mi polo, Yesu ene kwen mi kwo. (2) 
 
2.  Pi mi kwo de ai i beng’i, 
     Rieu binega kendo ngo;  
     I yo ceke Yesu kura, 
     Ebitera i polo. 
     I Jalarna, uma ndhu ku beroni. (2) 
 
3.  Kan akadhu kud i longro,  
     Meni tipopiny mi tho;  
     In I karacelo kuda 
     Ketho lworo nega ngo. 
     Rwoth mi bero, abipaku nyingi nja. (2)

title: Ndiri tho birwinyo ka Yesu wok
content:
1.  Ndiri tho birwinyo ka Yesu wok, (3)  
    Nicoko jupare kpo. (3) 
    Ndiri tho birwinyo ka Yesu wok,  
    Nicoko jupare kpo. 
 
2.  Ndiba ceke rwinyo ka Yesu wok, (3)  
     Nicoko jupare kpo. (3) 
     Ndiba ceke rwinyo ka Yesu wok,  
     Nicoko jupare kpo. 
 
3.  Goyo nduru rwinyo ka Yesu wok, (3)  
     Nicoko jupare kpo. (3) 
     Goyo nduru rwinyo ka Yesu wok,  
     Nicoko jupare kpo. 
 
4.  Wabipaku Yesu ma Wod Mungu, (3)  
     Wapake ku cwinywa kpo. (3) 
     Wabipaku Yesu ma Wod Mungu,  
     Wapake ku cwinywa kpo.

title: Kan ebino, kan ebino
content:
1.  Kan ebino, kan ebino nicoko jupare,  
     Dhanu ceke ma giyie, m’umaru Yesu.  
 
              Gibibedo i polo, gibibedo ndhu rondo,  
              Gibibedo i polo, ba Yesu Kristu. 
 
2.  Ebicoko, ebicoko nyithindho m’uyie,  
     Ju m’umaku lembe pare, m’uyio Yesu. 
 
3.  Wa nyithindho, wa nyithindho m’uyio Jalar mwa,  
      Wabibedo mal’ i polo, ba Yesu Kristu.

title: Yesu bibimo ng’om ceke
content:
1.  Yesu bibimo ng’om ceke, 
    Gambre i nam cil i tung’ ng’om;  
    E Rwoth mi rwodhi mi ng’om ngung’,  
    Ubimo mwa, Nyalwo mandha. 
 
             Mungu bidode ma……. 
             Cong ceke rum dwe the komker,  
             Kara leb ceke pak nyinge,  
             Yesu Wod Mungu ma Jalar. 
 
2.  Haleluya! Jategokpo! 
     Mutoro nego cwinywa kpo!  
     Dong’ wami dwong’ ni Jalar mwa,  
     Wapake dre, wayunge nja. 
 
3.  Thek ceke cokri nipake,  
     Ku girajoka dupa de;  
     Winj jumalaika gipake,  
     Ng’om de bipake nja ku nja.

title: Abicidho ma cinga nanu
content:
1.  Abicidho ma cinga nanu,  
    Aci rombo ku Yesu Rwoth;  
    Rundi meni mi ponjo dhanu  
    Gin ma nge mak’ acor cen.  
 
           Wabicungo i wang’ Jalar mwa,  
           Ebikoro i tic mwa kpo;  
           Lewic ni ju ma cing’gi nanu,  
           An ayenyo para ngo. 
 
2.  An alworo ngo tho m’unega,  
     Kum aboth ni kum rimb Yesu;  
     Ento cidho ma cinga nanu,  
     Ebedieng’o cwinya du. 
 
3.  Nindo dupa ukadhu iwa  
     Ma watimo tic moko ngo;  
     Mak’ wacidhu kawono nini,  
     Wayer lembe pa Yesu. 
 
4.  Wa Jukristu wacidhu yau yau,  
     Nindo mi timo tije tin, 
     Ma wapoi ie ju m’urwinyo,  
     Nyo kajik mi ng’omne tin.

title: Ceng’ moko Yesu bicoko dhogwa
content:
1.  Ceng’ moko Yesu bicoko dhogwa,  
     Sukulia tie iwa; 
     Kan ebikoro i tic mwa ceke,  
     Girang’o m’ukier iwa? 
 
              Ceng’ moko Yesu bicoko dhogwa,  
              Wabifoyo cokrine? 
              Nyo ebinwang’u ya wan wanindo?  
              Kie! Kie! Ebitundo rek! 
 
2.  Ka piny uru poi Jalar bidwogo!  
     Ebilwong’o nyingwa kpo; 
     Man tek etuco pi tic m’atimo,  
     Tije nyo atimo cu? 
 
3.  Mugisa pare ni ju m’ukio  
     Dwogo pare ku ba ceng’;  
     Ju ma girwo ma gikuri gigi,  
     Ma woth migi ceke leng’.

title: Ceng’ moko wabicung’ i wang’ Yesu
content:
1.  Ceng’ moko wabicung’ i wang’ Yesu,  
    Ku ju m’ucer k’i tho; 
    Rwoth mwa bituco lembe mwa ceke,  
    Bilwong’o nyingwa kpo. 
 
           Ebilwong’o nying’ jupare kpo, 
           Ju ma leng’ ma rimb Yesu ng’iewo;  
           Kan elwong’o nyinga abiyi,  
           Yesu tho pira. 
 
2.  Rwoth mwa bimio sukulia de 
     Ni ju m’uvoyo ng’om;  
     Man wabibedo kude i polo  
     Ma rondo ku rondo. 
 
3.  Dong’ wabibedo ku jupare nja,  
     Wapokra kendo ngo; 
     Man wabibolo ter mwa the tiend Rwoth,  
     E wabinwang’u yom.

title: E! Juyero ira lembe mi ka ma leng’
content:
1.  E! Juyero ira lembe mi ka ma leng’,  
    Jubewacu ya ebedo ber mandha; 
    Lem m’ucido kadi dhau bende mbe kuca,  
    Der ma sagu ceng’ urieny kuca nja.  
 
            Polo ene ka ma ber, 
            Kuca dhanu gimari kindgi; 
            Lem mi dubo kadi tho bende mbe kuca,  
            Der ma sagu ceng’ urieny kuca nja. 
 
2.  An awinjo ya juwada gidok kuca,  
     E ginwang’u ng’ombe ber mire ma!  
     Man ng’et kulo kun ku kun yen mi kwo nuti,  
     Kec unego ng’atu moko ngo. 
 
3.  Jubewacu ya pi wang’ ton ungo kuca,  
     Kadi can umbe, jung’iero kuca dit;  
     Ng’ombe ber ma sagu ceke mi ng’om mae,  
     Ava ng’ombe timo cwinya dit. 
 
4.  Jubewacu ya won pacu e Yesu Rwoth,  
      Man ebedo wi komker m’urieny tar pu;  
      Pacune e mola kwa, man eleng’ mandha,  
      An acidho kuca ka mi kwo.

title: Polo e ka ma ber
content:
1.  Polo e ka ma ber, anyong’a kwa,  
     Pacu pa Rwoth mi kwo, pacu mandha;  
     Jupare wero ru, wej anyong’a ire ndhu,  
     Pak ma gipake ko e pak mi nja. 
 
2.  Mungu bijolowa i pacune, 
     Emaru dhanu yu ku mer ma dhe;  
     Yesu etho piwa, en elwoko dubo mwa,  
     Edwokowa leng’ njwa kum rimone. 
 
3.  Bin malu i polo, in kud igal, 
      Yesu bitelo yo, mond ndhu i kal;  
      Anyong’a nuti dit, dubo kadi can de mbe,  
      Wabed i beng’i Rwoth ndhu nja ku nja.

title: Tek wun wumaru Rwoth
content:
1.  Tek wun wumaru Rwoth, 
    Wu jumutoro kwa. 
    Wadong’ wapake wakudu, (2) 
    Watieko kom pa Rwoth. (2) 
 
            Wacidho, acidha, 
            Kuca i pacu pa Mungu;  
            Wacidho mal’ i polo,  
            Adhura ma leng’ pa Yesu. 
 
2.  Wu ju m’enyolo nyen,  
     Nedi wupake ngo? 
     Wadong’ wapak ubimo mwa, (2)  
     Wa jumutoro kwa. (2) 
 
3.  Eriemo ndiba cen, 
     E can mwa ringo kpo; 
     Pi wang’wa ceke bende mbe, (2)  
     Wacidh i ka ma leng’. (2) 
 
4.  Tek wun wuyio Yesu 
     Ngo m’utho piwa, 
     Wadong’ wayie wakudu, (2)  
     Dong wabibed’ i polo,  
     Wakudu mi nja.

title: Thuwa i polo e ber dit
content:
1.  Thuwa i polo e ber dit, 
     Tho ku merkum de mondo ngo;  
     Usimbru udine rieny dit,  
     Ode acel ukuro an. 
 
            Acidho thuwa ba Mungu,  
            Acidho thuwa ba Yesu;  
            Atho ngo ku, atho ngo ku,  
            Acidho thuwa ba Mungu. 
 
2.  Udi ma beco dupa tie  
     Kuca ng’ei cero malu ngbir;  
     Ka an aweko ng’om mae  
     Ode acel ukuro an. 
 
3.  I ng’om abedo jawirok,  
     Masendi wok i bang’a kwa;  
     Kadok a calu Lazaro, 
     Thwo oda ngeng’ ni kuca nja. 
 
4.  Wek jumange yeny thugi piny,  
      Ma mac ku pi nyothe cen;  
      Ayenyo para thwo ma ngeng’,  
      Mal’ i polo i vut jadwong’, 
 
5.  Ka ng’om ku cero daru mwony,  
     Man ceng’ ku dwi girwinyo kpo;  
     Man ke tek piny bimor de mbwom,  
     Thwo oda cungo ira ngeng’.

title: Winj malaika ka giyero
content:
1.  Winj malaika ka giyero,  
     Yesu wok i Bethlehem;  
     Yesu ma Jalar mi dhanu,  
     Yesu ma junyol’ i dwol.  
     Yesu ma jarimo iwa,  
     Yesu ene Mungu wiwa,  
     Yesu winj, wapaku in  
     Kum imaru dhanu dit.  
     Malaika gipeki de,  
     Wa dhanu wapeki dre. 
 
2.  Kristu E Jalar mandha,  
     Kristu ene Rwoth mi nja,  
     Kristu ene Mungu wiwa,  
     En eweko polone.  
     Etho kar’ eting’wa ceke,  
     Elonywa kum lem mi dubo,  
     Mer m’emaru kowa ngi,  
     Ketho Kristu tho kumwa; 
     Malaika gipake dre,  
     Maku wan wapake de. 
 
3.  Ju m’i polo rwo ru ire,  
      Yesu Kristu Rwoth mi nja.  
      Malaika de igi wang’ li  
      Ka ginen’ ewekogi; 
      Kar’ ebin i ng’om mi tho,  
      Eng’ei can m’usendowa,  
      Yesu weko ng’om mi kwo  
      Kar’ ebin elar kowa.  
      Yesu Kristu Wod Mungu,  
      Wan wapeki k’anyong’a.

title: Anyong’a kwa! Rwoth Yesu wok
content:
1.  Anyong’a kwa! Rwoth Yesu wok! 
    Wajol Ubimo mwa! 
    Wek emond i adundewa, 
    Emi iwa mutoro kwa. 
 
            Wawer kud anyong’a, wawer kud anyong’a,  
            Wawer, wawer kud anyong’a. 
 
2.  Anyong’a kwa! Jalar mwa wok! 
     Ekelo both iwa. 
     Wek ekab kier ku dubo mwa,  
     Elonywa ni kum cilo mwa. 
 
3.  Anyong’a kwa! Rucwic uwok!  
     Ekabu kwong’ mi ng’om,  
     Egonyo giracwia pet, 
     Ukudho, can ku merone. 
 
4.  Anyong’a kwa! Jajuk uwok!  
     M’ejukowa mandha,  
     Ekwio cwiny, ejuko can,  
     Eyweyo pi wang’wa m’uton. 
 
5.  Kero ku dwong’ bed ire nja!  
     Thek ceke pak nyinge! 
     Judode Rwoth mi rwodhi kpo,  
     Mugisa kwa emio nja.

title: Lembe ma mit, iwa wang’ li
content:
1.  Lembe ma mit, iwa wang’ li!  
    Mudho ng’eny, der urieny,  
    Jubewero pir Imanuel; 
    Mungu loro i ng’om ve nyathin,  
    Yesu Kristu ma Rwoth. 
    Yesu Jalarna m’uwok. 
 
2.  Lembe ma mit, iwa wang’ li!  
     Ju m’i thim rwo i lum; 
     Kwiocwiny ku mutoro ni ng’om,  
     Kwo ma nja bed ni dhanu m’utho,  
     Yesu Kristu ma Rwoth. 
     Yesu Jalarna m’uwok. 
 
3.  Lembe ma mit, iwa wang’ li!  
     Jukwac ai ringo pio 
     Kud anyong’a nineno nyathin,  
     Girwo bang’e, girum ire dwe,  
     Yesu Kristu ma Rwoth.  
     Yesu Jalarna m’uwok. 
 
4.  Yesu ma Rwoth, Imanuel!  
     Wafoyi, warwo de 
     Ve jurieko m’uai i tung’ ng’om;  
     Gin mi cingwa ku kumwa de dho  
     Wan wamio ni Rwoth.  
     Yesu Kristu ma Jalar.

title: Jukwac gikuro rombe
content:
1.  Jukwac gikuro rombe ma  
    Gibedo ndhu i thim,  
    Malaika wok m’uai ba Rwoth,  
    E der ucarugi. 
 
2.  Gilworo dit, malaika re  
     Uwacu, “Kud wulwor, 
     Rwonglembe mir anyong’a dwong’  
     Ubed ni dhanu kpo.” 
 
3.  Junyolo tin i Bethlehem 
     I kal pa Daudi rwoth  
     Jalar ma Yesu Kristu Rwoth,  
     Ma Wod Mungu wego. 
 
4.  E meni giranyuthane,  
      Juboyo nyathinne 
      Ku bongo mi mukere, man  
      Jupiele ka mi cam. 
 
5.  E eni eni malaika 
     Gipaku Mungu mit; 
     Giyero lembanyong’a ma 
     Bijuko dhanu dit. 
 
6.  Pak Mungu Rwoth ma malu ngbir, 
     Emio kwiocwiny; 
     Mutoro bed ba dhanu yu, 
     Ma Mungu foyogi.

title: I adhura pa rwoth Daudi
content:
1.  I adhura pa rwoth Daudi,  
    I dwond dhiang’ junyolo Rwoth;  
    Min uboyo nyathin pare  
    Man epiele ndhu i dwol.  
    Mariamu min nyathin,  
    Yesu ene nyathinne. 
 
2.  En eloro kud i polo,  
     Man etundo piny i ng’om;  
     En ebedo i kind dhanu,  
     Man ebedo ni Mungu.  
     Tic mi bau eponjo dit,  
     Man eworo won ku min. 
 
3.  Fodi E nyathin m’aradu,  
     Ere cwinye mbe ku co;  
     Man edongo ndhu ku bero,  
     Min de kothe ber mandha.  
     Wun awia mange kpo,  
     Wutim tic ku woro kwa. 
 
4.  Kan edoko jalawobi,  
     En eciro abidhe;  
     Lembe ceke mulo ie,  
     Kero pare voc de ngo.  
     Meni en, ekonyowa, 
     Kum eng’eyo lembe mwa. 
 
5.  Ceng’ mange ka wabinene,  
      Tek wamaru lem pare;  
      Wabinene mal’ i polo,  
      Karacelo ba Mungu.  
      En elonyo iwa njwa,  
      Wabibedo kuca nja.

title: I dwol karacelo ku kana ku dhiang’
content:
1.  I dwol karacelo ku kana ku dhiang’  
    Rwoth Yesu juketho i kacam mi lim;  
    E welo ma dit, ento jung’eye ngo,  
    Ebino niyenya kum a jadubo. 
 
2.  Rwoth Yesu ameri ma an de nyathin,  
     Ajoli i ia, kura ku ba ceng’, 
     I mudho ku der de tel wia, Yesu,  
     Kar’ alund amond i beng’i i polo.

title: Yesu vuto i liel, Yesu Jalarna
content:
1.  Yesu vuto i liel, Yesu Jalarna,  
    Endre evoyo liel, Yesu Rwodha.  
 
             Con kan eai kud i liel, 
             En evoyo tho ma e jakwor;  
             En eai jatego, man evoyo liel,  
             Man ebedo kwo ku dhanu pare nja;  
             En eai, en eai! Haleluya, Yesu ai! 
 
2.  Jukur’ avuje de, Yesu Jalarna, 
     Ento jukuro kwe, Yesu Rwodha. 
 
3.  Juciko bang’e de, Yesu Jalarna,  
     Ento jucike kwe, Yesu Rwodha. 
 
4.  Tho ponjo voye de, Yesu Jalarna,  
      Ento eponjo kwe, Yesu Rwodha. 
 
5.  Evoyo tho ira, Yesu Jalarna;  
     Afoye dit mandha, Yesu Rwodha.

title: Ang’eyo Yesu mara
content:
1.  Ang’eyo Yesu mara,  
    Lembe pare wacu re;  
    Nyithindho de bin bang’e,  
    Kum emarugi mumbe. 
 
            Yesu emara, Yesu emara,  
            Yesu emara, lem pare wacu re. 
 
2.  Yesu m’umara etho,  
     Kar’ etera i polo; 
     Rimbe bende cwir pira,  
     M’ebelwoko ko cwinya. 
 
3.  Yesu Kristu m’umara,  
     Ebibedo ru bang’a;  
     Kum ayie ang’eyo  
     Abibed’ i bang’e nja. 
 
4.  Yesu mara m’a nyathin,  
     Ejola kum ayie; 
     Egwoka ku ba rupiny,  
     An a nyathin pare de.

title: Yesu wacu iwa wa der mi ng’om
content:
1.  Yesu wacu iwa wa der mi ng’om, 
     Wan wa calu thala, waketh der mwa rieny,  
     I ng’om mudho nuti, der mwa de binen,  
     Maku der mwa rieny ber i wang’ dhanu. 
 
2.  Yesu yenyo dit ya warieny ire, 
     Kum eneno tic mwa, tek watime dre;  
     En enuti kindwa, en eng’eyowa, 
     Wawek der mwa rieny ber wang’ juwadwa. 
 
3.  Eyenyo der mwa kony jumange de,  
     Ju ma can ni bang’gi pi lembe pare;  
     Dubo ene mudho man ecidojo,  
     Wawek der mwa rieny ber, wakonygi kpo. 
 
4.  Cil nyathin jung’eye ni tic pare,  
      Tek etimo ber, man en atira de;  
      Ju m’uyio Yesu copo timo cu,  
      Ento ju m’ukwere birwinyo kpo.

title: Anyong’a nega kum Mungu Wegwa
content:
1.  Anyong’a nega kum Mungu Wegwa  
     Wacu emaruwa dhanu mumbe;  
    Emio Yesu ma Wode kulong’,  
    Kara ebodhwa wa ju m’uyie.  
 
            Afoyo dit kum Yesu mara,  
            Yesu mara, Yesu mara;  
            Afoyo dit kum Yesu mara,  
            Rwoth Yesu mara dit. 
 
2.  Nyo tek juwinga ku lembe mi ng’om,  
     Ketho akier, awek lembe mandha,  
     Kan abipoi pi mer pare ma dhe,  
     Adok i kore, ejola bang’e. 
 
3.  E dong’ nyanok ka Jalarna biwok,  
     Ebino coko jupare m’uboth;  
     Anyong’a saga m’aneno wang’e,  
     Man nja ku nja abibed’ i bang’e.

title: Der ma nok ma para e
content:
1.  Der ma nok ma para e,  
    Abiketh’ erieny; 
    Der ma nok ma para e,  
    Abiketh’ erieny, keth’ erieny,  
    Keth’ erieny, keth’ erieny. 
 
2.  Der para bipandre ngo,  
     Abiketh’ erieny; 
     Der para bipandre ngo,  
     Abiketh’ erieny, keth’ erieny,  
     Keth’ erieny, keth’ erieny. 
 
3.  Won ndra copo nege ngo,  
     Abiketh’ erieny; 
     Won ndra copo nege ngo,  
     Abiketh’ erieny, keth’ erieny,  
     Keth’ erieny, keth’ erieny. 
 
4.  Ka ceke derne binen,  
      Abiketh’ erieny; 
      Ka ceke derne binen,  
      Abiketh erieny, keth’ erieny,  
      Keth’ erieny, keth’ erieny. 
 
5.  Maku Yesu nwang’ arieny,  
     Abiketh’ erieny; 
     Maku Yesu nwang’ arieny,  
     Abiketh’ erieny, keth’ erieny,  
     Keth’ erieny, keth’ erieny.

title: Wan wa nyithindho ma fodi
content:
1.  Wan wa nyithindho ma fodi  
     Wang’eyo lembe dit ungo;  
     Tic ma Yesu yenyo watim,  
     Watim tije ku mutoro. 
 
2.  Dong’ wawek kothwa ma rac cen,  
     Wakwany koth Yesu Kristu Rwoth;  
     Lembe ma Yesu cikowa 
     Wawinj lembe, watime pio. 
 
3.  Ndra ma jucwayu de rac dit,  
     Ku kwalo piny mi dhanu de;  
     Man coko lembe kum dhanu,  
     Wacwelu cen waweku e. 
 
4.  Ayany ku camuco de rac,  
     Umaku ju pa Mungu ngo;  
     Ku wang’wa, dhogwa, ithwa de  
     Wanyuth ni dhanu lem ma ber.

title: Yesu emaru nyithindho
content:
1.  Yesu emaru nyithindho, emaruwa mumbe;  
    Eyenyo dit ya wamare ku ba rupiny ceke. 
 
              Jumutoro, jumtutoro, 
              Yesu yenyo jumutoro;  
             Jumutoro, jumutoro,  
             An a jamutoro pare. 
 
2.  Yesu yenyo wabed ming’ de,  
     Wabed ku dhanu ber;  
     Wanyuth anyong’a mwa igi,  
     Ma wan wabedo ko 
 
3.  An abipenjo ekonya,  
     Elonya leng’ ma njwa;  
     Kara anyuth de ni dhanu,  
     An a nyathin pare 
 
4.  An abitimo tic ire,  
     Kan ani i ng’om mae;  
     Ka ceng’ ma Yesu bidwogo,  
     Egama i bang’e.

title: Ka jukwac ma gini thim
content:
1.  Ka jukwac ma gini thim,  
    Gibekwayu rombe, 
    E malaika wok bang’gi, m’utuco lembe  
    Ya junyolo Yesu Rwoth kuca i Bethlehem,  
    E wawero k’anyong’a kum ewok i ng’om.  
 
              Noel, Noel, Noel, Noel, 
              Yesu Ubimo mir Israel. 
 
2.  E gineno der ma dit 
     Kan erieny ku diewor, 
     Lworo negogi ento juyero kumae, 
     Kwiocwiny ni dhanu yu, ku mutoro mandha,  
     Kum junyolo Rwoth Yesu, Jalar mi ng’om yu. 
 
3.  Juadek ma gi jurieko gineno cero;  
     Ya enyutho kakare m’evuto i ot; 
     E girwo ni Rwoth Jalar ku gin ma pire lwar,  
     Mo, ku mola, udok de ma ng’wice ng’wi ng’ar. 
 
4.  Dong’ wapak nying’ Yesu dre, e wathiera ire,  
     Man warwo ire Rwoth mi polo ku ng’om de,  
     Rimbe oi niwaruwa kan emire piwa, 
     Dong’ wafoyo Wod Mungu kum E Jalar mwa.

title: Tek iweko yo ma pwe
content:
1.  Tek iweko yo ma pwe,  
     Man ipodh’ i dubo de;  
     Kud imung’ ituce be,  
     Ebiweko dubone. 
 
           Were kendo ira do,  
           Yesu jolo dhanu kpo,  
           Yere ngbeng’ ewinjre cu,  
           Yesu jolo judubo. 
 
2.  Bin ku tic m’imuli ko,  
     Man ku ter m’unuri kpo;  
     Bin e ibinwang’u yom,  
     Ponji pare ber mandha. 
 
3.  Tek atuco dubona,  
     Ene pwe, man E mandha;  
     Ceke ebiwekona,  
     Ebilonyo gondrina. 
 
4.  Yesu jola ber mandha,  
     Man eruco dubona;  
     Rimbe lwoka dwoka leng’,  
     Kar’ amond i polone.

title: Yesu Kristu wacu ebitelo yo
content:
1.  Yesu Kristu wacu ebitelo yo, 
    Ebiyiko kabedo, 
    Kara wa julubne ebigonjowa,  
    Kuca i kabedo mwa. 
 
            Yesu, abilubo toke ndhu, 
            En E wang’ayo mi kwo; 
            Abiwotho ndhu atira, kud akier i yo,  
            Abilubo toke cu. 
 
2.  Kuca mal’ i polo en e ka ma ber;  
     In iyenyo cidho de? 
     Dong’ iai kawono, bin ilok cwinyi, 
     Irony bedopwe pare. 
 
3.  Lem mi ng’om de dupa bibebidhoi;  
Ibisendri dit i yo, 
Dong’ inen Ba Yesu, ebikuroi,  
Ebivoyo abidhe.

title: Jalar Yesu tel wia
content:
1.  Jalar Yesu tel wia,  
    Kum ang’eyo yoje ngo;  
    Won abidhe nuti ndhu,  
    En eriek, ewonda du.  
    In I Yesu Kristu Rwoth,  
    Tek alubi abiboth. 
 
2.  In ing’eyo juka in, 
     Nwang’u cwinya dieng’ ku can;  
     Nam ku yamu cungo ti, 
     Man wavuvu bedo si,  
     In ing’eyo telo wic. 
     In I Mungu ma Rucwic. 
 
3.  In I Rwoth mi kwo ku tho  
     Keth icopo juka yo, 
     Man i ceng’ ma kuma voc,  
     Ibinyutho ira yo; 
     Ibilwong’a k’i polo,  
     “Kud ilwor, anuti do.”

title: Ei! Winj lembe ma wabeyero
content:
1.  Ei! Winj lembe ma wabeyero,  
    Lem ma con juwinjo ngo;  
    Yesu weko dwong’ne i polo,  
    Kar’ ebin elar ko jo. 
 
            Ng’a laruwa k’i can ma nja?  
            Wod Mungu wi yen m’athara,  
            Etim ang’o? Etho piwa.  
            Anege ke? Dong’ wun wuyi 
            En n’i polo erwo piwa. 
 
2.  Kadok malaika ma ni polo  
     Copo tho ka kawa ngo;  
     Jamer ma Mungu de jukuno,  
     Kor yen ma wi Kalvari. 
 
3.  Lembene fodi jubeyero  
     M’ubewang’u ijo li; 
     Kuca i polo Rwoth bekwayu  
     Piwa m’E jalam mi nja. 
 
4.  Dong’ wumiru ni Jalar Yesu,  
     Man wurum the tiende tin,  
     Wun de wubinwang’u mugisa,  
     Ebilaruwu de tin.

title: Lembe besendi, e cwinyi dieng’
content:
1.  Lembe besendi, e cwinyi dieng’?  
    Mungu bigwoki en; 
    Cor ceng’ni bang’e i vute dri,  
    Mungu bigwoki en. 
 
             Mungu bigwoki en, 
             Ku ba rupiny, ku diewor de,  
            Ekengo wi jupare, 
            Mungu bigwoki cil nja. 
 
2.  Tek wonabidhe bebidhi dit,  
     Mungu bigwoki en; 
     Man tek iol, e ivoc de ngi,  
     Mungu bigwoki en. 
 
3.  Ni canpiny Mungu bikonyi be,  
     Mungu bigwoki en; 
     Pi can m’utimi eng’eyo de,  
     Mungu bigwoki en. 
 
4.  Gin meno peke bivoyi ngo,  
     Mungu bigwoki en; 
     Dong’ igene cil i cwinyi kpo,  
     Mungu bigwoki en.

title: Yesu wacuna kumae,  I ng’ic, iromo ngo
content:
1.  Yesu wacuna kumae,  
     “I ng’ic, iromo ngo;  
     Ento tek irwo ira  
     Ibinwang’u tegona.”  
 
              Yesu culo kpo,  
              Ku rimbe m’ucwir; 
              Dub m’adubo dit mandha,  
              Elwoke, dwoke tar. 
 
2.  Tego peri kende, Rwoth,  
     M’ucopo dwoka tar; 
     Dubo nyotho cwinya kot,  
     Dong’ ilony adundena. 
 
3.  An ambe ku bedopwe,  
     Akoc ku kisa de; 
     Ento rimbi cwir pira,  
     M’ebilwoka dwoka tar. 
 
4.   Kan atund i vuti Rwoth,  
      Ma con abedo bor; 
      Abifoyo kum aboth, 
      Beroni upong’a thur.

title: Rwoth, gwok cwinya ku ba rupiny
content:
1.  Rwoth, gwok cwinya ku ba rupiny, 
    The rimoni, the rimoni; 
    Kab lworo ku dubona de in,  
    The rimoni ma ber. 
 
            The rimoni, rimo ma ber,  
            Rimo mi lwok ma lwokojo;  
            Gwoka Yesu Jalarna ndhu  
            The rimoni ma ber. 
 
2.  Kapondo pa jadubo e  
      The rimoni, the rimoni;  
      Inyutho yo mi kwo bende  
      The rimoni ma ber. 
 
3.  Yesu dong’ iroma ndhu nja  
     The rimoni, the rimoni;  
     Keth atim ru ka cwinyi kwa  
     The rimoni ma ber. 
 
4.  Kwiocwiny ma ber ni i ia  
     The rimoni, the rimoni;  
     Tic peri timbre ber iwa  
     The rimoni ma ber.

title: Ju ma jusendogi pi yioyic
content:
1.  Ju ma jusendogi pi yioyic,  
    Gineno can, jutimogi rac;  
    Jumulogi ku goc ma lith,  
    Ju moko de juwang’u ku mac.  
 
          Yioyic ma giciro ko,  
          Wan de wacir ko cil i tho. 
 
2.  Jucanyugi ku kidi de,  
     Palamularu negogi le,  
     Mange jutwiogi de ku kol,  
      Yioyic migi lokre de ngo. 
 
3.  Kadok ju moko sendowa,  
      Wan wabed yo ku mer mandha,  
      Dong’ wanyai lem mi kwo asu,  
      Ku bedopwe, ku lembe ma cu.

title: Rwoth Yesu ayenyo abed leng’ ma njwa
content:
1.  Rwoth Yesu ayenyo abed leng’ ma njwa,  
    Ayenyo ibed i cwinya nja ku nja;  
    Bai gin ma wilo wia i kumi do,  
    Lwok ia keth abed tar sagu vulo.  
 
           Sagu vulo, ma sagu vulo, 
           Lwok ia keth abed tar sagu vulo. 
 
2.  Rwoth Yesu par pira kawono akwei,  
     Gin m’uwilo wia konya ku kwere;  
     An amira iri ku ng’eyong’ec kpo,  
     Lwok ia keth abed tar sagu vulo. 
 
3.  Rwoth Yesu kum eni akwei mandha,  
     Akuri the tiendi ku cwinya ma lwe;  
     Aneno rimoni m’ilwoka ko do,  
     Lwok ia keth abed tar sagu vulo. 
 
4.  Rwoth Yesu akwei, arum iri dwe,  
     Mi ira adunde mi dhanu ma nyen;  
     Kum ju ma gikwei, ikwerogi ngo,  
     Lwok ia keth abed tar sagu vulo.

title: Ka tic ku can para ceke bithum
content:
1.  Ka tic ku can para ceke bithum,  
    An abibedo yo dhu wath ma leng’;  
    Bedo i vut Rwoth m’amaru mumbe,  
    Bibed’ anyong’ana ma nja ku nja.  
 
           Anyong’a kwa, anyong’ana, (2)  
           Kan abineno Yesu Jalarna  
           Meno bibedo anyong’ana kwa. 
 
2.  An abibedo jamerne ma dhe,  
     Yesu bitera ayom bang’e dre;  
     Bedo ma wabibedo ku mer kwa,  
     Bibed’ anyong’ana ma nja ku nja. 
 
3.  Juwada moko m’amaru mumbe,  
     An abinwang’u vut Jalarna be;  
     Bedo ma wabibedo kugi de  
     Bibed’ anyong’ana ma nja ku nja. 
 
4.  I polo abipaku ru Yesu, 
     Kum tho m’etho ko abimondo be;  
     Bedo m’abibedo kwo i bang’e,  
     Bibed’ anyong’ana ma nja ku nja.

title: Wang’wa ku wang’ Yesu Kristu
content:
1.  Wang’wa ku wang’ Yesu Kristu,  
     Gibinendri ceng’ mange, 
     Abinene ku mutoro, 
     Yesu en m’etho kuma.  
 
            Abinene, abing’eye, 
            Kan akadhu polo gwei;  
            Abineno lonyo pare,  
            Abinene ceng’ mange. 
 
2.  Ang’eyo kucel kawono,  
     Abenene va ku kieu;  
     Ento ka Yesu bidwogo,  
     Abineno wang’e cu. 
 
3.  Kud i vute abifoye,  
     Nwang’u ndiri ringo bor;  
     Lem m’usenda de bikadhu,  
     Ka ma col bilero her. 
 
4.  Wang’ Yesune abineno,  
     Abing’eye, ebinen; 
     Abineno wang’ Jalarna,  
     Yesu en ku kite dho.

title: Bed i kuma Tipo Mungu
content:
1.  Bed i kuma Tipo Mungu,  
     Ko iyik wang’ cwinya tin;  
     Rom i ia Tipo Mungu,  
     Bin kawono, roma tin.  
 
              Roma tin, roma tin,  
              Yesu bin, iroma tin;  
              Rom i ia Tipo Mungu,  
              Bin kawono, roma tin. 
 
2.  Tin icopo roma, Rwodha,  
     Ram iroma ko loya;  
     Pidoicna yenyo voya,  
     Bin kawono, roma in. 
 
3.  Tekra mbe, a yereyere,  
     Dong’ arum the tiendi dwe;  
     Tiponi ma nja ku nja de,  
     Mina tego, roma tin.

title: Ku rambana m’anuti ko
content:
1.  Ku rambana m’anuti ko  
    Ageno rimoni m’ucwir,  
    Ilwong’a in, abin beng’i,  
    E Jalarna awok, awok. 
 
2.  Ku rambana, agalu ngo,  
     Nikabu dubo m’i cwinya;  
     Rimbi ulwoko dubna kpo,  
     E Jalarna awok, awok. 
 
3.  Ku rambana, jacan eni, 
     Kab dubona, kwi cwinya de;  
     Gin kpo ayenyo i beng’i,  
     E Jalarna awok, awok. 
 
4.  Ku rambana, ikwera ngo,  
     Ijolo a, ilwok’ ia; 
     Lembe m’ing’olo an ajolo,  
     E Jalarna awok, awok. 
 
5.  Ku rambana, merni ma dhe,  
     Ukabu gin m’ucera ndhu;  
     A peri in ikendi Rwoth,  
     E Jalarna awok, awok.

title: Yesu I jarimona
content:
1.  Yesu I jarimona,  
     Wek ajeng’ i kori in;  
     Kinde ma jubidha hai,  
     Ka Satani senda dit,  
     Kura in, I Jalarna,  
     Cil m’abidhene bithum;  
     Yabna polo peri ngbeng’,  
     Ijol cwinya beng’i do. 
 
2.  Ka m’aring i ie mbe,  
     Cwinya jengre ndhu kumi;  
     Kud ikuna abed rwa,  
     Gwoka, juka in asu.  
     An ageno para in,  
     Konyna kpo ai i beng’i;  
     Um wia m’ubedo ngbeng’  
     Ku tipo mi bombi in. 
 
3.  In I Kristu, iroma,  
     Anweng’i isagu kpo;  
     Bodh judubo, ju ma rwa,  
     Kei kumjo, gwok ju ma kic.  
     Nyingi leng’, man e mandha,  
     A jadubo ma andre; 
     I won bero mandhandha,  
     An acido, a jandra. 
 
4.  Bero kpo ai i beng’i, 
     Mak eum dubona kpo;  
     Rimbi ene yath mandha,  
     Dwoka leng’, igwoka ndhu.  
     In I kwo ma dhenyni nja,  
     Wek agam dru i beng’i;  
     Dhenjri ru yor i cwinya,  
     Meu i ia nja ku nja.

title: Yesu, imara dit, keth ameri
content:
1.  Yesu, imara dit, keth ameri,  
    Winj, aberwo iri, in I Yesu; 
    Apenjoi kumae, keth ameri mandha,  
    Keth ameri, keth ameri. 
 
2.  Yang’ con amaru gin mi ng’om ceke,  
     Meni aweke kpo kar’ ameri;  
     Imara dit ma swa, keth ameri mandha,  
     Keth ameri, keth ameri. 
 
3.  Ka can bisenda dit ku lem mi tho,  
     Gin ma ioro ri, akwero ngo;  
     Konya awer asu, keth ameri mandha,  
     Keth ameri, keth ameri. 
 
4.  Ceng’ moko abitho m’aweco kwe,  
     Lembe m’ayeroni bed ndhu kumae,  
     In ma ilara ri, keth ameri mandha,  
     Keth ameri, keth ameri.

title: Tic atimo ku mutoro ni Jalar
content:
1.  Tic atimo ku mutoro ni Jalar,  
     An atimo ku mutoro; 
     En eketho ia poto, dwoka tek,  
     Kan atimo ni Jalar. 
 
             Kan atimo ni Jalar abitimo ticne cu,  
             Abinwang’u lem ma ber kwa 
             Kan atimo ni Jalar. 
 
2.  Tic atimo ku mutoro ni Jalar, 
     An atimo ku mutoro; 
     Kum ecikukonya ku ba piny m’uru,  
     Kan atimo ni Jalar. 
 
3.  Tic atimo ku mutoro ni Jalar 
     An atimo ku mutoro; 
     Lem m’usenda lund udwoko cwinya tek,  
     Kan atimo ni Jalar.

title: Winj lem mu’uai ku ba jakwac
content:
1.  Winj lem mu’uai ku ba jakwac, 
    M’ubedo woko ka macol; 
    Elwong’o rombe dong’ gibin, 
    Gibin i bang’e, ju m’uol.  
 
             Kelgi pio, kelgi pio, 
             Bin ku ju m’urwinyo ba Yesu;  
             Kelgi pio, kelgi pio,  
             Kel judubo ndhu ba Yesu. 
 
2.  Ng’a yeny’ ekony jakwac mae,  
     Rombe m’ulal i thim ma bor;  
     Ng’a ma bikelogi i dwol,  
     Gibed ma ber i ka ma mor. 
 
3.  Woko i langa giywak tin,  
     Malu wi got ma mudho kwa;  
     Winj Mungu kan epenjo in,  
     Icidh iyeny ka rombena.

title: Ka jukudh’ agwara kuca
content:
1.  Ka jukudh’ agwara kuca e wawinjo dwal ma dit,  
    Rundi meni thum e wan wacer k’i tho, 
    Ku juwadwa ceke wabirieyo kuca ka ma leng’,  
    Ka julwong’o nyinga kuca abiyi. 
 
            Ka julwong’o nyinga kuca, (3)  
            Ka julwong’o nyinga kuca abiyi. 
 
2.  Wabimothra ku mutoro ka wanendra ka ma leng’,  
     Wa ku jumange m’ugeno Yesu de, 
     Ma juloko kumwa ceke e wanwang’u kum ma nyen,  
     Ka julwong’o nyinga kuca abiyi. 
 
3.  Dong’ watim ni Yesu Kristu tic m’eng’olo iwa cu,  
     En efoyo ju m’ucung i ie ki, 
     Ka wadaru tije ceke wabicokra kuca kpo, 
     Ka julwong’o nyinga kuca abiyi.

title: Yesu tela i yo ceke
content:
1.  Yesu tela i yo ceke,  
    An ayenyo mange ngo: 
    Yesu tho pi dubna bende,  
    Man edoko jatel yo. 
    Lembe pare e m’ujuka  
    Kud i can m’asendra ko,  
    An ang’eyo kan asendra,  
    Yesu E m’utelo yo. 
    An ang’eyo kan asendra,  
    Yesu E m’utelo yo. 
 
2.  Yesu tela i yo ceke,  
     Kud i yo m’ugondre swa,  
     Tek atagu mina bero,  
     In I Yesu kwen mi kwo;  
     Kan aol, m’ayenyo voc de,  
     Rieu pi talu dwanda kau,  
     Abinwang’u pi i cana,  
     Yesu E m’utelo yo. 
     Abinwang’u pi i cana,  
     Yesu E m’utelo yo. 
 
3.  Yesu tela i yo ceke,  
     Yo m’ucidho ka ma leng’,  
     Abinwang’u yom i bang’e,  
     Man anwang’u can de mbe.  
     Abifoyo jatel wia, 
     Kum etelo wia ber, 
     Abipaku Yesu Kristu, 
     Kum etelo wia ber, 
     Abipaku Yesu Kristu, 
     Kum etelo wia ber,

title: Cil i can para
content:
1.  Cil i can para, wabiwotho ku Jalar,  
    En m’eng’eyo canne mak’ etel wia en,  
    Abilubo Yesu Kristu cil i ceng’ mi tho,  
    Abitund’ i polo kar’ anen Jalar.  
 
             Lube, lube, abilubo Yesu, 
             Ka ceke, ceng’ ceke, ebitelo yo;  
             Lube, lube, abilubo Yesu,  
             Abitund’ i polo kar’ anen Jalar. 
 
2.  Cil i can para wabiwotho ku Jalar,  
     Ka wavuvu koto mudho de cido yo;  
     Ka Yesu betelo wia lworo nega ngo,  
    Abitund’ i polo kar’ anen Jalar. 
 
3.  Cil i can para wabiwotho ku Jalar,  
     Got ma dit aidho, Yesu nyuth’ ira yo,  
     Abilubo ng’eye abiweke ki ungo,  
     Abitund’ i polo kar’ anen Jalar.

title: An a peri Rwoth
content:
1.  An a peri Rwoth, dwendi winjre mit,  
     Kum iweco pi merni; 
     An ayeny’ inyai yioyic ira,  
     Keth acor i kumi dri. 
 
            Tela ceng’ni, ceng’ni vuti Rwoth  
            Keth apoi pi tho peri; 
            Tela ceng’ni, ceng’ni, ceng’ni vuti Rwoth,  
            Ceng’ni ka ma rimbi cwir. 
 
2.  Dong’ ikoya tin ya atim iri,  
      Konya Rwoth ku beroni; 
      Keth ageni ndhu, wang’a nen beng’i,  
      Man atim ru ka cwinyi. 
 
3.  Tek abino Rwoth, in ikwera ngo,  
     Kan arum i weng’i dwe; 
     Wec mwa bedo mit, man ekonya dit,  
     Kum inyayu bedopwe. 
 
4.  Karamb ng’eyo merni uvoya Rwoth,  
     Ma k’aneno weng’i ngo; 
     Man anyong’ani sagu ng’eyong’ec,  
     Ebing’eire beng’i cu.

title: Yesu ni bang’wa
content:
Yesu ni bang’wa, ng’a ma cung i wang’wa? 
Ng’a ma cung i wang’wa, (2) 
Yesu ni bang’wa, ng’a ma cung i wang’wa? 
Ng’atu—moko—mbe—ba!

title: Yang’ con wi got ma Golgotha
content:
1.  Yang’ con wi got ma Golgotha, 
    Wi yen m’atharane, 
    Juguro Yesu ma Jalar, 
    M’utho pi dhanu pet. 
 
              Emaruwa ku mer mandha, 
              E wan wamare de; 
              Wang’eyo rimbe waruwa,  
              Watimo ire de. 
 
2.  Masendi pare ng’eire ngo,  
     M’esendre ko piwa; 
     Ku ter ma pek m’eyeyo no,  
     Kum kier ku dubo mwa. 
 
3.  Etero dubo mwa bor cen,  
     Eculo banja mwa; 
     Ekelo iwa genogen,  
     Wanwang’u kwo ma nja. 
 
4.  Jalar mwa Yesu romo ndhu, 
     Nikabu kwir mi tho; 
     Eyabu polo iwa ku  
     Rimbe m’ulwokojo.

title: Ka iwa pido pi Yesu
Abiwero lem pa Kristu
content:
1.  Abiwero lem pa Kristu,  
    Yesu en m’etho pira;  
    Con eweko Won i polo,  
    Kar’ etho, ebodh ko wa.  
 
            Abiwero lembe pare,  
            Lem pa Yesu ma Jalar;  
            Wabiwero ku jupare, 
           Nja ku nja ku wer mandha. 
 
2.  Kan arwinyo Yesu nwang’a,  
     Con arwinyo swa i ng’om;  
     Yesu bino de i bang’a,  
     En emio ira kwo. 
 
3.  Woth ubedo tek dit ira,  
     En edaru tegona; 
     Wang’a tho, e ndiri nega,  
     Yesu wodha kud i can. 
 
4.  Wang’a cido dit ku mudho,  
     Lworo nega de mandha;  
     Tego pare riemo lworo  
     Ka Yesu wok i bang’a. 
 
5.  Ka tho nega ebikura,  
     Kan aweko ng’om mae;  
     Ebibedo ndhu i bang’a,  
     Keth atund’ i polone.

title: Wabinendra ndhu i tiend Jalar
content:
1.  Wabinendra ndhu i tiend Jalar,  
     Ka warum nirwo i bang’e  
     The komker mi bero pare;  
     Wabinendra ndhu i tiend Jalar.  
 
             Mungu kur kindwa, ekur kindwa,  
             Cil i ceng’ m’warombo tiend Jalar;  
             Mungu kur kindwa, ekur kindwa,  
             Wabinendra ndhu i tiend Jalar. 
 
2.  Wabinendra ndhu i tiend Jalar,  
     Bed museme ku the bombe,  
     Ebikuri calu rombe; 
     Wabinendra ndhu i tiend Jalar. 
 
3.  Wabinendra ndhu i tiend Jalar,  
     Ebiyeyi ndhu ku bote,  
     Ibibedo yo i kore; 
     Wabinendra ndhu i tiend Jalar. 
 
4.  Wabinendra ndhu i tiend Jalar,  
     Nindo peri kpo ni cinge,  
     Cil m’ecoki ko i bang’e;  
     Wabinendra ndhu i tiend Jalar.

title: Mi kwiocwiny
content:
1.  Mi kwiocwiny i ng’om mi dubo e,  
     Rimb Yesu Kristu kuro cwinywa leng’. 
 
2.  Mi kwiocwiny ka tic ucwaluwa, 
     Wayenyo ndhu watim yeny pa Jalar.  
 
3.  Mi kwiocwiny ka ndiri saguwa,  
     Lem juk pa Mungu sagu mange swa.  
 
4.  Mi kwiocwiny pi juwadwa ceke,  
     The bombi, Mungu, gin gibedo ber. 
 
5.  Mi kwiocwiny pi gin ma bitimbre,  
     Ing’eyo ceke man ibime de. 
 
6.  Mi kwiocwiny ka tho bemwonyowa,  
     Idaru voyo tho ku kwo ma nja. 
 
7.  I Munguna, ageno beroni,  
     I polo wabinwang’u kwiocwiny.

title: Dong’ ku wulwor ki
content:
1.  Dong’ ku wulwor ki, esendre piwu  
     Eai kud i tho, emondo i kwo;  
     Tego kpo mi ng’om, ku mi polo de,  
     Umire ire, ni udul ma pare.  
 
             Yie kende, yie kende, 
            Gin ceke coprene, yie kende;  
            Yie kende, yie kende,  
            Gin ceke coprene, yie kende. 
 
2.  Dong’ ku wulwor ki, etelo wiwu,  
     Jakwac mwu enyutho yo’ma wukwany;  
     Pi mu ma kec de, ebidwoko mit,  
     Emadhu ma kec pet pi Gethsemane. 
 
3.  Dong’ ku walwor ki, tek cwinywa dieng’ hai,  
     Ekunowa ngo, E ni bang’wa nja;  
     Diewor ku dieceng’, e ceke acel,  
     Eng’eyo cwinywa, kadok lembamung’a.

title: Wer nuti m’awer ni Jalar
content:
1.  Wer nuti m’awer ni Jalar,  
     Ugambre ceng’ m’aboth;  
     Jamer ma Yesu jawarna,  
     Ugambre ceng’ m’aboth. 
 
              Ugambre ceng’ m’aboth, (2)  
              Abilula ku nyinge; 
              Ugambre ceng’ m’aboth,  
              Abilula ku nying’ Jalarna. 
 
2.  Jalar ukwio cwinya lwe,  
     Ugambre ceng’ m’aboth;  
     Afoyo kayeny mi cwinye,  
     Ugambre ceng’ m’aboth. 
 
3.  Atuco lembe pare ndhu,  
     Ugambre ceng’ m’aboth;  
     Lembe ma jiji rwinyo kpo,  
     Ugambre ceng’ m’aboth. 
 
4.  Kabedona juyiko cu,  
     Ugambre ceng’ m’aboth;  
     Abedo kuca nja ku nja,  
     Ugambre ceng’ m’aboth.

title: Wer ma mit ‘wok i cwinya tin
content:
1.  Wer ma mit ‘wok i cwinya tin,  
     Wer ma yang’ con embe; 
     Yesu Jalar kabu dubna cen,  
     Anyong’a mandha. 
 
             Anyong’a benega dit, (2) 
             Yesu bibino, anyong’ana kwa, 
             Anyong’a mandha. 
 
2.  Tek can uwok i adundena,  
     Merne ukonya dit; 
     Weja bibedo i cwinya nja,  
     Anyong’a mandha. 
 
3.  Ribri ma ber nuti kindwa tin,  
     Wan waku Jalar mwa; 
     Bedo i Yesu eber jufwa,  
     Anyong’a mandha. 
 
4.  Wubin i bang’e ku can mwu kpo,  
     Man ebilaruwu; 
     Wun wubiwero pi merne nja,  
     Anyong’a mandha.

title: Mungu maruwa kanisa
content:
1.  Mungu maruwa kanisa, 
     Ma Rwoth Yesu tho piwa;  
     Pak jamic mi giramia, 
     Ma e lwok ku dwokrileng’. 
     Wan wa leng’ kum Mungu Wegwa, 
     Man kum Wode Rwoth Yesu, 
     Tipo Mungu ma E leng’ de, 
     Juadek, Mungu acel. 
 
2.  Dwokrileng’ kayeny pa Yesu, 
     Elonywa ku Tipone;  
     Wegwa fodwa kud ukede,  
     Ketho waceg nyingwa dre.  
     Man ku lembariba pare  
     Ku rimo m’ucwir piwa, 
     Yesu cer e tego pare 
     Konywa de wabed leng’ njwa. 
 
3.  Ebilonyo ii ceke, 
     Kumi, cwinyi, ku kwoni  
     Bed pwe cil i dwogo pare,  
     M’edwogo ku dwong’ pare.  
     Jukristu gileng’ i wang’e.  
     Gin gimer ku dubo ngo;  
     Poyo kadi bel embe ko,  
     M’e kanisa pa Kristu.

title: An afoyo rimo Jalar
content:
1.  An afoyo rimo Jalar, 
     M’ucwir con pi dhanu mi ng’om 
     Dubona m’ubedo kwar ngbo, 
     Rimone udwoke tar pu. 
     Con acayu lem peri ceke, 
     Man masendi nyayu can mumbe. 
     En elwoko kier para cen, 
     Man edwoka tar sagu pei. 
 
               Tar ma sagu pei, (2) 
               Rimoni bidwoka tar pu, 
               Edwoka tar ma sagu pei. 
 
2.  Yesu yeyo kier para kpo, 
     Yen m’athara nure mandha; 
     Lak ukudho cobe de lith, 
     An acangu kum goc pare dit; 
     Dong atuco kier para ceke, 
     An ayio Yesu ma Jalar. 
     En elwoko kier para cen, 
     Man edwoka tar sagu pei. 
 
3.  Vwa, akier mandha con i lum, 
     Kum akwanyu yo para an; 
     In ijuko yamu ku nam, 
     Bed ibim wi adundena. 
     Tek awoth atira alubi, 
     Abilula ku kuhaya rac; 
     Jwiga Yesu the rimoni, 
     Ebidwoka tar sagu pei.

title: Yesu nyutha wang’ayo
content:
1.  Yesu nyutha wang’ayo, 
    Lworo kud unega do; 
    Tek amok i kumi ki, 
    Abibedo i merni. 
 
           Yesu, Yesu, dong’ inyutha wang’ayo, 
           Kud awoth ariri swa, 
          An ayeny’ alubi nja. 
 
2.  Abibedo museme, 
     Cil i ndiba ceke de, 
     Cwinya bed i vuti dri, 
     Kum abedageno in. 
 
3.  Yesu E Jakwac ma ber, 
     Rombene eng’eyo kpo; 
     Ebelwong’o nying’gi de, 
     Man giwinjo dwande cu. 
 
4.  Yesu nyutha wang’ayo, 
     Cil ma kwona maku ai; 
     Yo m’akwanyu yo mi kwo, 
     Bitera i poloni.

title: Mungu ng’olo i lem pare
content:
1.  Mungu ng’olo i lem pare, 
     Ya elingo tek warwo; 
     Ebiwinjo ywak mwa ceke, 
     Kud adieng’acwiny mwa kpo. 
 
            Mungu winjo rwo mwa do, 
            Ebidwoko wang’e kpo; 
            Yie kum eromo ceke, 
            Ebitimo, yie ndhu. 
 
2.  Ku wakwai ku cwiny ma jiji, 
     Maku ya wagene ndhu; 
     Tipo gire kwayu piwa, 
     Kara rwo mwa winjre cu. 
 
3.  Mungu winjo penji ceke, 
     Dok enok, kadok elwar; 
     Tek wakwayu ndhu ku nyinge, 
     Kwayukwac m’areri kwa. 
 
4.  Gin m’urany ku gin m’unyothre, 
      Tere ndhu, iyer ni Rwoth; 
      Ebijuki ber i canne, 
      Kum eng’eyo lembe kpo.

title: Wunen Yesu, ebebino
content:
1.  Wunen Yesu, ebebino, 
    Yang’ evoyo iwa tho; 
    Ju ma leng’ rubanga dupa, 
    Gibebino kude ndhu. 
    Haleluya, Haleluya, ebibimo dhanu yu. (2) 
 
2.  Kwond wang’ ceke gibinene, 
     Ku jamker i cinge de, 
     Ju ma yang’ gicaye bende, 
     Man ku ju m’ugure de. 
     Gin de gibiywak ku can kwa, 
     Kum gikwero Yesu Rwoth. 
     Gin de gibiywak ku can kwa, 
     Kum gikwero Yesu Rwoth. 
 
3.  Dhanu ceke yungo nyingi, 
     Kum i Rwoth mi rwothi kpo, 
     Dong’ ibin ijol ker peri, 
     Man ku dwong’ m’ivoyo ko, 
     Haleluya, Haleluya, wan wakio dwogoni. (2)

title: Tek alworo Jok uloya
content:
1.  Tek alworo Jok uloya, 
     Yesu kura en; 
     Yioyicna voc i ia, 
     Yesu kura en do. 
 
              Yesu kura en, Yesu kura en, 
              Kum Jalarna mara sagu, 
              Yesu kura en. 
 
2.  An aponjo mok’ i kume, 
     Mak ekura en; 
     Merna kwio, wang’a cido, 
     Mak ekura en do. 
 
3.  An a lonyo dit i wang’e, 
     Keth’ ekura en; 
     Ebegwoka kum ebodha, 
     Keth’ ekura en do. 
 
4.  Yesu ng’iewa en ku rimbe, 
     Dong’ ekura en; 
     Ebigama be i bang’e, 
     Dong’ ekura en do.

title: Yesu Jalarna wodha k’i dubo
content:
1.  Yesu Jalarna wodha k’i dubo, 
     Emara dit etho de nibodha, 
     Ewara ndhu ku rimbe m’ucwir, 
     Adoko pare nja. 
 
             Adoko piny pa Yesu, 
             Emio kwo ira; 
             Kwone e gin mi ng’om re ngo, 
             Ere ma nja ku nja. 
 
2.  Con kan arwinyo dubona senda, 
      Meni elwoko dubona woko; 
      Lewic uai amondo i kwo, 
      Adoko pare nja. 
 
3.  Anyong’a nega kum Yesu lara, 
      Nyoro mi ng’eca gony kud i kuma, 
      Elonya ndhu ku rimbe m’ucwir, 
      Adoko pare nja.

title: An aol ku lem dubo
content:
1.  An aol ku lem dubo ayeny’ adok leng’, 
     Ajoli i cwinya Jalar. 
     Awek lembe ma con dong’ akwany yo ma nyen, 
     Ajoli i cwinya Jalar. 
 
              Ajoli i cwinya Jalar, (2) 
              Kum inyayu anyong’a afoyo mandha, 
              Ajoli i cwinya Jalar. 
 
2.  Dong’ awotho ngo swa kum itelo wia, 
      Ajoli i cwinya Jalar. 
      Cilo ai, yweire cen cwinya lonjre mandha, 
      Ajoli i cwinya Jalar. 
 
3.  Lem ma jiji de mbe wang’a lero ku der. 
     Ajoli i cwinya Jalar. 
     Piny ulero de her keth awoth i derne, 
     Ajoli i cwinya Jalar. 
 
4.  Dong’ awinjo pi polo kabedo ma ber, 
      Ajoli i cwinya Jalar. 
      An anen Rwoth Yesu m’edoko won ker, 
      Ajoli i cwinya Jalar. 
 
5.  Dong’ aloyo abidhe ku dubo mi ng’om, 
     Abedo ku Yesu Jalar. 
     Ku ba ceng’ ebekonya ku tegone dwong’, 
     Abedo ku Yesu Jalar.

title: Jubiting’o terna kpo i ka ma leng’
content:
1.  Jubiting’o terna kpo i ka ma leng’,  
     Jubijola kuca cu i ka ma leng’;  
     Abiwero wer kwa ku kendi ma tar cwe,  
     Abipaku Yesu i ka ma leng’. 
 
            I ka ma leng’, i ka ma leng’,  
            Can mwa birwinyo ceke,  
            I ka ma leng’. 
            I ka ma leng’, i ka ma leng’,  
            Can mwa birwinyo ceke,  
            I ka ma leng’. 
 
2.  Mudho mbe m’ucido wang’a ka ma leng’,  
     Der ma kuca sagu ceng’ i ka ma leng’,  
     Kuni de ekonya, yoje de emenyo,  
     Ebitelo wia cil ka ma leng’. 
 
3.  Abineno wang’ Jalar i ka ma leng’,  
     Abifoyo rimbe de i ka ma leng’, 
     Wang’e abineno, nyinge abipaku,  
     Nja ku nja i bang’e i ka ma leng’.

title: Wadaru paku nyingi Mungu mwa
content:
1.  Wadaru paku nyingi Mungu mwa,  
     Man warwo iri ku nying’ Rwoth Jalar;  
     Meni wapokra mi mugisani, 
     Warum the tiendi miwa kwiocwiny. 
 
2.  Ka wan walal ma ceng’ uyenyo mwony,  
     Konj kwiocwiny i wiwa, I Jadwong’;  
     Gwokwa pi wec tek dhogwa yenyo kier,  
     Cimwa pi dubo kara wawoth ber. 
 
3.  Kwi cwinywa tek ruvwa wok ku diewor,  
     Ineno ceke, gwoka, ku walwor; 
     Wan wa nyithindho ma inyolo in,  
     In ibikurowa cil i rupiny. 
 
4.  Kwo mwa de ceke peri in I Rwoth, 
     Romwa ku tego wacir lembe kot; 
     Ka tic bithum ma rundi mwa bijik, 
     Ku kwo ma nja wamond i kwiocwiny.

title: E mudho mbe!
content:
1.  E mudho mbe! E mudho mbe! 
     Haleluya, kum mudho mbe! 
     Kum Yesu Ene der i polo ka ma ber, 
     Haleluya, kum mudho mbe! 
 
2.  Eyikre kpo, Eyikre kpo! 
     Haleluya, Eyikre kpo! 
     Ayio Yesu Rwoth, e yicne keth aboth, 
     Haleluya, Eyikre kpo! 
 
3.  Edwogo rek, Edwogo rek! 
      Haleluya, Edwogo rek! 
      Warombo kude kpa! Wabedo kude nja!

title: B-i-b-l-i-a, ene kitabuna
Ndhu Tipo peri kende, Rwoth
content:
1.  Ndhu Tipo peri kende, Rwoth, 
     M’ecopo loko cwiny; 
     E tego peri kende Rwoth 
     Belwokowa ma leng’. 
 
                In Tipo mi yic, mi mer, 
                Tim tic i hindwa do; 
                Idwok adundewa dok leng’, 
                Tin romwa ku tegoni. 
 
2.  Ndhu Tipo peri kende, Rwoth, 
     Binyayu mer iwa; 
     Man Tipo peri calu mac, 
     Eyepo cwinywa pet. 
 
3.  Ndhu Tipo peri kende, Rwoth, 
      Bikonyowa i tic; 
      E dwande copo jukowa, 
      Ekabu pidoic. 
 
4.  Ndhu Tipo peri kende, Rwoth, 
      M’emio beroni; 
      Ka wabekuro Tiponi, 
      Romwa, dwok iwa leng’.

title: Yep cwinywa Rwoth Jalar
content:
1.  Yep cwinywa Rwoth Jalar,  
    Wakuro dwendi ling’; 
    Ng’ol iwa gin m’iyenyo ri, 
    Wayenyo wawoth leng’, 
 
             Yep cwinywa, Rwoth Jalar, 
             Keth tic utimbre ber: 
             Wek Tipo peri romwa kpo, 
             Miwa mugisa do. 
 
2.  Yep cwinywa Rwoth Jalar, 
     Yung nyingi edok dwong’; 
     Rom cwinywa kpo ku lem mi mer, 
     Wang’ iwa li ve mac. 
 
3.  Yep cwinywa Rwoth Jalar, 
     Nyuth lembe peri ngbeng’; 
     Keth thelembe ma ng’eyo tek 
     Ung’eire iwa ber. 
 
4.  Yep cwinywa Rwoth Jalar, 
      Ku Tiponi ma leng’; 
      Icer k’i tho wayere cu, 
      Wa jumulembene.

title: Cana mwa ma tek mi nja
content:
1.  Cana mwa ma tek mi nja, 
     Ma jung’enyo pira dra; 
     Rimoni ma yang’ ucwir, 
     Ecwir hau pi dhanu kpo; 
     Rimbe ruco dubona, 
     Man edwoka leng’ ma njwa. 
 
2.  Kadok can unega dit, 
     Kadok tic atimo dit; 
     Meni ruco dubo ngo, 
     In I kendi ‘larujo; 
     An aroma both de ngo, 
     Mak’ amok i kumi do. 
 
3.  Rundi para calu lum, 
     Kadhu pio e kwona thum; 
     Abicidh’ i polo ndhu, 
     Abineno weng’i bu. 
     Cana mwa ma tek mi nja, 
     Ma jung’enyo pira dra.

title: Rwo areri kum Mungu tie
content:
1.  Rwo areri kum Mungu tie, 
     Rwo areri, elingo i; 
     Lembang’ola elokre ngo, 
     Mungu winjo lem peri kpo. 
 
2.  Rwo areri tek can de tie, 
     Rwo areri, epoi piri; 
     Nyo iweng’i kit canne mbe, 
     Ebikonyi i canne be. 
 
3.  Rwo areri abidhe tie, 
     Wonabidhe bisendi de; 
     Yang’ esendo Jalar mwa dit, 
     En d’evoye ku lem pare. 
 
4.  Rwo areri kum dieng’ocwiny, 
     Rwo areri de kum canpiny, 
     Mungu neno gin ceke en, 
     Gene ndhu, bed ku yioyic. 
 
5.  Rwo areri ka kumi lith, 
     Ebijengi i ndiba pet; 
     Tek iyio ku cwinyi kpo, 
     Lem ma tek de bidoko yot.

title: Rimo Yesu Kristu kende
content:
1.  Rimo Yesu Kristu kende, 
     Yang’ m’udaru cwir, 
     Ni judubo mi ng’om ceke, 
     Ecwir piri. 
 
              Rimo Yesu Kristu kende, 
              Yang’ m’udaru cwir, 
              Dong’ iyie, dong’ ijole, 
              Ecwir piri. 
 
2.  Rimo Yesu Kristu kende, 
     Dong’ elwok ii, 
     Cwinyi, ng’eyong’ec, ku kumi, 
     Tipo romi. 
 
3.  Kadok dubo peri dupa 
      Sagu ceke ngi; 
      Tek igeno rimo Yesu, 
      Elwoko ii. 
 
4.  Ni kum rimone maeni 
     Ecopre iwa, 
     Wan wamond’ i polo bang’e, 
     Wanen Yesu.

title: E Mungu in I jakony mwa
content:
1.  E Mungu in I jakony mwa, 
    Wageno beroni; 
    In I kapondo mwa ma tek, 
    Kabedo mwa mi nja. 
 
2.  Wabedo the tipopinyni 
     Ma I Jategokpo; 
     Kapondo nuti the bombi, 
     Igwokowa de cu. 
 
3.  Ma fodi got juwodho ngo, 
     Man ng’om ku piny de mbe; 
     Ugambre rondo ku rondo, 
     In I Mungu ma kwo. 
 
4.  Rundi rubanga i weng’i, 
     E calu ceng’ acel; 
     Ekadhu pio man ene nok 
     Calu kur mi diewor. 
 
5.  Kum nindo mwa becidho pio, 
     E wan wakadhu ndhu; 
     Erwinyo calu leko lek 
     Ethum ka piny uru.

title: Wayung Ubimo mwa
content:
1.  Wayung Ubimo mwa, 
    Ebedo wi komker; 
    Winj wer ma ju ma leng’ wero, 
    Wer ma gipake ko. 
    Wapake de ku wer, 
    Kum etho piwa kpo, 
    Wadode Rwoth mi rwodhi kwa 
    Ubimo mwa mi nja. 
 
2.  Wayung ubimo mwa, 
     Jacwic m’uronyo kum; 
     Junyole de i Bethlehem, 
     Wod Mungu wok i ng’om. 
     Etho pi dubo kpo, 
     Elaruwa k’i tho, 
     Wafoyo kisa pare dwong’ 
     M’umio iwa kwo. 
 
3.  Ene ukungo mer, 
      Nen ng’ete, cinge de; 
      Wang’ rem unen m’unyuthowa 
      Esendre dit piwa. 
      Malaika ceke de 
      Giyungo Yesu Rwoth, 
      Gikulo wigi niyungo 
      Ubimo mwa mi nja.

title: Ka waparu gin ma Mungu miowa
content:
1.  Ka waparu gin ma Mungu miowa, 
    Par ma tek gin ceke ma emiowa; 
    Gin m’emio bang’wa e m’unyuthowa, 
    Mungu E m’umaru dhanu dit andha. 
 
             Yesu Kristu Mungu mio re, 
             Lembe pare de eoro re; 
             Ka wayio, wabinwang’u kwo, 
             Kwo ma Mungu mione bithum de ngo. 
 
2.  Ka kec nut’ i pacu, koth ucwi de ngo, 
     Tek wapenjo Mungu ebiwinjowa; 
     Mungu mio kata, ku rabolo de, 
     Kwen de, bel de, kal de Mungu mio re. 
 
3.  Mungu mio Yesu en m’etho piwa, 
      Yesu lor’ i ng’om, esendre dit andha; 
      Rimbe ceke cwir yang’ con nibodhowa, 
      Ka wayio Yesu wabiboth andha.

title: Yesu ang’olo iri nilubo ng’eyi ndhu
content:
1.  Yesu ang’olo iri nilubo ng’eyi ndhu; 
    Bed i bang’a akweyi, jalarna, jamerna. 
    Alworo lwiny mi ng’eta tek in ibang’a ngo; 
    Dong’ jatel wia nuti abikier tak de ngo. 
 
2.  E, keth ang’ei inuti, ng’om ubevoya do, 
     Kum aneno gin dupa, abidhe woi itha. 
     Jukwoja ni i vuta ku yor i ia de, 
     Jalar cor ceng’ni bang’a, ilar cwinya Rwodha. 
 
3.  Yesu keth awinj dwendi i wec ma cu ma leng’, 
     Kud awinj lem m’ucido, lembe m’uketh akier; 
     Yik wecna Rwoth akwei do, ikura, ibima, 
     Yer ira, keth awinji, in I jagwok cwinya. 
 
4.  E Yesu, in ing’olo ni ju m’ulubo in, 
      Ka ma jumiru cokri ya in I kindgi de. 
      E Yesu an ang’olo atim iri awe, 
      Konya nilubo toki, Rwodha ma jarimba. 
 
5.  Yesu keth akwany kothi, anen ba tiendi de; 
     Ageno abilubi kum tegoni kende. 
     Ilwong’a, tela, peya, gwoka i rundi kpo, 
    Jola malu i polo Jalarna, jamerna.

title: Ng’om maeni bedo ber
content:
1.  Ng’om maeni bedo ber, 
    Ku yen ku thiu pinyne; 
    Gin mange m’ukonyowa 
    Ruoth Mungu cwio kpo. 
 
2.  Man thiu piny m’uyepo, 
     Ku winyo m’uwero; 
     Eketho rangi misi, 
     Ecwio bombe kpo. 
 
3.  Ecwio got m’udongo, 
     Ku kulo pi ma thuth. 
     Ku ceng’ ma mwony uthieno, 
     Ku der ka piny uru. 
 
4.  Nying’ wang’wa Mungu cwio 
     Ya wanen piny pare; 
     Dend dhogwa de emio 
     Nipaku dwong’ pare.

title: Yesu nuti!
content:
1.  Yesu nuti! Tho ku liel, 
    Ndirine umbe kawono; 
    Liel ucero Yesu ngo, 
    Ebicopo twiowa ngo, 
 
    Haleluya! 
 
2.  Yesu nuti! Genogen 
     Dwoko tho dhugang’ mi polo; 
     Meni juko cwiny mi can 
     Ka waai ki ng’om mi ndiba; 
 
3.  Yesu nuti! Dong’ wami 
     Kwo maeni bed ndhu ire; 
     Cwinywa bed leng’ kara wa 
     Bed ni dwong’ ire ceng’ ceke; 
 
4.  Yesu nuti! Mer pare 
     Voyo ndiba, ku ragedo, 
     Ndru, muneru, both dhu tho, 
     Wodhowa ngo kud i cinge. 
 
5.  Yesu nuti! M’E won ker 
     Wi ng’om yu ku gin m’i ie; 
     Wabibimo wakugi, 
     Rondo ku rondo i polo.

title: Wayungi man wapeki
content:
1.  Wayungi man wapeki 
    Jawar m’Ubimo mwa, 
    Nyithindho yang’ giwero 
    Hosana iri kwa. 
 
2.  In I nyakwar Rwoth Daudi, 
     Ravor pa Yuda de: 
     Ibino ku nying’ Mungu, 
     Idok’ ubimo de. 
 
3.  Ku piny ceke m’icwio, 
     Ku dhanu yu m’i ng’om, 
     Giribri ku malaika 
     Nipaku nyingi dwong’. 
 
4.  Pak migi de ijolo, 
     Ko ijol rwo mwa de do, 
     Ubimo mir ubimo 
     Bim wiwa ndhu rondo.

title: Tipo Maleng’, iyep cwinywa
content:
1.  Tipo Maleng’, iyep cwinywa, 
    Nyai mac i iwa mac ma leng’, 
    I mo m’awira pa Mungu, 
    Man giramia imio. 
 
2.  Ikonyowa ku tegoni, 
     Man de ku der imenyo yo, 
     Ilero wang’wa m’ucido, 
     Nineno lembe peri cu. 
 
3.  Jukwa ku bero peri do, 
     Mi kwiocwiny nikonyowa; 
     Riem ju m’udaguwa bor cen, 
     Tel wiwa in I jatelyo. 
 
4.  Keth wang’ei Wego, Wod kulong’, 
      Tipo Maleng’: Gitie acel; 
      Rondo ku rondo wapeki 
      Ku wer ma leng’ ma thum de ngo. 
      Foyofoc iri kum iromo, 
      Wego, Wod, ku Tipo Maleng’.

title: Wun ma wuyio Yesu ni Jalar mu
content:
1.  Wun ma wuyio Yesu ni Jalar mu, 
     Yer ni ng’om ngung’ ya Mungu ene der; 
     Ecwio ng’om ku ceke ma ni ie, 
     Eyenyo ngo ya ng’atu moko rwiny. 
 
            Yer lembanyong’a, 
            Lem keuiocwiny, 
            Lembe pi Yesu ma 
            E Jawar mandha. 
 
2.  Nen dhanu lwar ma gin girwiny’ i dubo, 
     Jutwiogi ku kol ma pa won ndra; 
     Giwinjo ngo ya Yesu tho pi dubo, 
     Giwinijo ngo pi kwo ma nja ku nja. 
 
3.  Waci, wayer, wa jumulembe pare, 
     Rwoth Yesu tho milaru dhanu yu; 
     Kudi wagal, nyap bende kud ecerwa, 
     Ento wanyebgi ndhu ba lokocwiny. 
 
4.  Maku wumi wotwu ku nyigu bende, 
     Piny mu ma le wumi niorogi; 
     Rwo de areri, Mungu winjo ceke, 
     Man gin m’itimo Yesu foyo kpo.

title: Jakwac mwa ene Rwoth mi mer
content:
1.  Jakwac mwa ene Rwoth mi mer, 
    Afoyo bero pare; 
    Abedo yo i cinge en, 
    Gin moko mbe m’urem ira. 
 
2.  Edwoko ng’eyong’ecna ndhu, 
     Dhu kulo ma museme, 
     Avuto ka m’arusi loth, 
     Nicamu cam mi polo. 
 
3.  Man lworo copo nega ngo 
     I kulo tho ma longro; 
     Itie kuda karacelo, 
     Cwinya ikwio m’I jajuk. 
 
4.  Ipedho mesa i wang’a, 
     Iwiro mo i wia; 
     Kopo para pong’ perere, 
     Gin moko mbe m’urem ira. 
 
5.  Mer ku bero biluba de 
     I nindo para ceke; 
     Maram amondo i beng’i, 
     Ma nja ku nja i polo.

title: Wu dhanu pa Mungu m’upondo the bombe
content:
1.  Wu dhanu pa Mungu m’upondo the bombe, 
     Wupoi ya lem pare usagu mange. 
     Wuketh yioyic mu wi lembe pa Rwoth, 
     Wuketh yioyic mu wi lembe pa Rwoth, 
     Wuketh yioyic mu wi lembe pa Rwoth. 
 
2.  Wanuti wakudi, e cwinyi kud ung’abre 
     Kum A Mungu peri, abikonyi be; 
     Amioni tego, akonyi ku yioyic, 
     Amioni tego, akonyi ku yic, 
     Amioni tego, akonyi ku yic. 
 
3.  Kinde ma jumuli ikadhu kud i kulo, 
    Jalarni bijuki, ibimwony ungo; 
    Ewacu kumae, “Wabibedo wakudi, 
    Alwong’i ku nyingi, ini nyathin para, 
    Alwong’i ku nyingi, i nyathin para.” 
 
4.  “Kum berona romi,” Jalarna uwacu, 
     “Kum tegona doko ndhu cu kud i ng’ic”, 
     I lembe mi ndiba ajengra kum Rwodha, 
     E tego pa Kristu bibedo i kuma, 
     E tego pa Kristu bibed’ i kuma.

title: Tel wiwa Jawipiro
content:
1.  Tel wiwa Jawipiro 
    Wamondu ndhu i lwiny, 
    Wakiedo mony wakudu, 
    Wacir ku tegocwiny. 
    Iponjowa ku rieko, 
    Imio tego peri; 
    Kawono Jawipiro 
    Cak wer, waci kudu. 
 
2.  Tel wiwa Jawipiro 
     Wakied ku dubo kpo; 
     Wavoye ku leng’cwinywa, 
     Cil ma ng’om bikwio. 
     Anyego mwa kum kum ungo, 
     Ento ku rwoth mi mudho, 
     Ku yioyic ku rwo de 
     Wavoyo jakwor mwa. 
 
3.  Tel wiwa Jawipiro, 
     Waci ma lworo mbe; 
     Tek wan waneno weng’i, 
     E cwinywa doko tek; 
     I wiwa yen m’athara, 
     Der pare menyowa 
     Jamkermiwic wanwang’u 
     Ba jadit mi wiwa.

title: Ng’om yu cido bi
content:
1.  Ng’om yu cido bi, dubo nyothe mandha, 
    Re der mi ng’om yu e Yesu; 
    Emenyo yo iwa ka Jalar uwok 
    Kum der mi ng’om yu e Yesu. 
 
          Bin ba derme, emeny iri yo, 
          Edoko derna m’awotho ko; 
          Con an abinga, dong’ wang’a kei, 
          Kum der mi ng’om yu e Yesu. 
 
2.  Lub ng’eye e mudho bisendi de ngo, 
     Kum der mi ng’om yu e Yesu; 
     Lem pare e thala m’unyuthowa yo, 
     Kum der mi ng’om yu e Yesu. 
 
3.  Tek cudho becwenyi isendri i yo, 
     Jol der mi ng’om yu e Yesu; 
     Rimbe copo keyi tek weng’i ucor, 
     Kum der mi ng’om yu e Yesu. 
 
4.  I polo juywagu der mange de ngo, 
     Kum Yesu e der mi polo; 
     Adhura mi mola ebedo leng’ njwa, 
     Kum derne e Nyathi Rombo.

title: Ka piny uru i wia
content:
1.  Ka piny uru i wia 
    Afoyo Rwoth ma dwong’, 
    Pak Yesu Kristu dit; 
    I tic m’atimo kpo, ka cwinya de berwo, 
    Pak Yesu Kristu dit. 
 
2.  Mungu ma malu ngbir 
     Wegwa ma I won mer, 
     Pak Yesu Kristu dit; 
     Wapeki ku wer kwa, mutoro negowa, 
     Pak Yesu Kristu dit. 
 
3.  Tek can usendowa, 
     Jajuk mwa nuti nja, 
     Pak Yesu Kristu dit; 
     Kadok ambe ku piny, emio kwiocwiny, 
     Pak Yesu Kristu dit. 
 
4.  Ka fodi wa ni ng’om, 
     Wawero wer ma dwong’, 
     Pak Yesu Kristu dit; 
     Kuca i kwo mandha, wer mwa bibedo nja, 
     Pak Yesu Kristu dit.

title: Anyong’a pong’o cwinya
content:
Anyong’a, anyong’a pong’o cwinya, 
Anyong’a, Emaru dit andha. 
Elwoko dubna woko, akwanyu yo mi polo, 
Mutoro pong’o cwinya kud anyong’ane.

title: Wan wa jumutoro kwa, mutoro kwa
content:
Wan wa jumutoro kwa, mutoro kwa, (2) 
Yesu Kristu, Jalar mwa, 
Weko woko dubo mwa, 
Wan wa jumutoro kwa mandha ndha.

title: Twa, twa sagu nam ma dit
content:
Twa, twa sagu nam ma dit, 
Kaborne tund’ i polo; 
Thuth, thuth sagu nam ma dit, 
Mer pa Jalarna. 
An, tic para romo ngo, 
Ento Emara asu; 
Lem pare ponjowa, 
Merne uromowa dhanu yu.

title: Yesu maruwa nyithindho
content:
Yesu maruwa nyithindho, 
Nyithindho mi ng’om ceke, 
Ju ma kwar ku ju ma col, 
Ju ma landu ku ma tar, 
Yesu maru nyithindho mi ng’om ceke.

title: Giramia eni m’amio ni Rwoth
content:
