Giramia eni m’amio ni Rwoth, 
Kar’ etim tic pare, jole ceke do! 
Ngle, Ngle, Ngle, Ngle, 
Winj maram eywak, 
Amio ni Mungu, afoyo wang’ dak.

title: Wegwa, wafoyi kum Ikurowa
content:
Wegwa, wafoyi kum Ikurowa, 
Iketho piny uru i wiwa ber, 
Wafoi kum cam, kum yom, man kum mer, 
Man kum gin ceke m’Imio iwa.

title: Wegwa m’ubed i polo
content:
Wegwa m’ubed i polo 
Winj ka warwo iri; 
Wamira giwa i cingi, 
Ko Ikurwa tin ceng’ du. Amen.

title: Jurumi thek apar
content:
Jurumi thek apar, ma thindho abung’wen 
Uwacu ya waboth tek watuco nying’ Yesu. 
Wayio cil i iwa ya Yesu tho piwa, 
Jurumi thek apar.

title: En eai, en eai, en eai
content:
En eai, en eai, en eai; 
Ter ma pek m’unura dit dong’ eai; 
En eai, en eai, en eai, 
Ter ma pek m’unura dit dong’ eai. 
Dubona Elwoko ku rimbe m’ucwir, 
Haleluya! 
En eai, en eai, en eai, 
Ter ma pek m’unura dit dong’ eai.

title: Kum Mungu maruwa Emio Rwoth Yesu
content:
Kum Mungu maruwa Emio Rwoth Yesu, 
Etho kum dubo mwa, Emio kwo ma nja; 
Edwogo gamuwa, Anyong’a dit mandha, 
Wabibedo kude nja.

title: Rwoth afoyi kum Ibodha
content:
Rwoth afoyi kum Ibodha, 
Afoyi m’Icangu cwinya, 
Kwo m’Imio ma nja ku nja, 
E gin m’upore ngo, lonyo kwa!

title: Ira, Ira, Egomo ot ira
content:
Ira, Ira, Egomo ot ira, 
Malu kuca, i ng’om ma ber, 
Kum Emaruwa ku mer ma dit, 
Wubin, waci, kum wadwogo kendo ngo, 
Tek ng’atu moko bedo ku mutoro kuca 
Ene an, an, an, an, an.

title: An a nyathi cero
content:
An a nyathi cero, an a nyathi cero, 
An acopo rieny ni Yesu; 
An a nyathi cero, anyong’a nego cwinya, 
Kum ku ba ceng’arieny ni Yesu.

title: Aka! Kierna sagu ve gudi
Mungu rucogi pet
content:
Mungu rucogi pet, anyong’a benega dit, 
Mungu rucogi pet, asom i Isaya anen; 
Pier ang’wen k’ang’wen, pier ario k’ario, 
Erucogi pet, afoye mumbe, kum Ebodha.

title: Yesu dhugola ma wang’e tie ario
content:
Yesu dhugola ma wang’e tie ario, 
Woko ku ie, nyo ing’eyo ngo? 
Yesu dhugola ma wang’e tie ario, 
An ayi amondo ka in itim ang’o?

title: Lok cwinyi ba Yesu
content:
Lok cwinyi ba Yesu Ebelwong’i do, (3) 
Yi Yesu Kristu tin.

title: Yi Yesu Rwoth
content:
Yi Yesu Rwoth, Yi Yesu Rwoth, 
Dong’ iyi Yesu m’utho piri; 
Yi Yesu Rwoth, Yi Yesu Rwoth, 
Yi Yesu do.

title: Yesu, Yesu, Yesu
content:
Yesu, Yesu, Yesu, Nying’ Yesu mit dit, 
Ene nying’ Jalar mwa, 
Wabipaku nyinge nja.

title: Ang’eyo Yesu tho pi dubona
content:
Ang’eyo Yesu tho pi dubona, 
Ang’eyo Yesu mio kwo iwa; 
Ekonyowa de, ku ba ceng’ ceke, 
Tego pare romowa, man Enuti nja ku nja.

title: Wafoyo Yesu, Yesu Jalar mwa
Yesu lwong’owa, jupare
content:
1.  Yesu lwong’owa, jupare, 
    Ejuk cwinywa wabed yo; 
    Ku ba ceng’ wawinjo dwande, 
    Ebewacu, “Luba do”. 
 
2.  Yesu lwong’owa, jupare, 
     Wawek lem mi ng’om mae; 
     Mungu mange de m’araga 
     Wakwer ceke, wabed leng’. 
 
3.  Lem mi can, ku lembanyong’a, 
     Ka watimo, ka wayom, 
     Wiwa kud uwil pi Kristu, 
     Wamare ma sagu kpo. 
 
4.  Yesu lwong’owa ku kisa, 
     Wawinj dwand Jalar mwa cu; 
     Wor lem pare, tim tic ire, 
     Yunge hai ma sagu kpo.

title: Biblia pa Mungu sagu
content:
1.  Biblia pa Mungu sagu, (2) 
     Tek isome ceng’ ku ceng’, 
     Ebikonyi dit mandha, 
     Ei, Biblia pa Mungu sagu. 
 
2.  Jarimba ma ber Ene Yesu, (2) 
     Ebiwinjo ywak para, 
     Ebigwoka nja ku nja, 
     Ei, Jarimba ma ber Ene Yesu.

title: Bin ba Yesu
content:
1.  Bin ba Yesu, bin ba Yesu, 
     Bin ba Yesu Jalar. 
     Kawono bin ba Yesu, bin ba Yesu Jalar. 
 
2.  Yesu meri, Yesu meri, 
     Yesu meri andha, 
     Kawono bin ba Yesu, En Emeri andha. 
 
3.  Dong’ iyie, dong’ iyie, 
     Dong’ iyie andha, 
     Kawono bin ba Yesu, Dong’ iyie andha. 
 
4.  Ebiruco dubo peri, 
     Ebiruco andha; 
     Kawono bin ba Yesu, Ebiruco andha.

title: O Worship the King
content:
1.	Ubimo ma Rwoth, m’Edwong’ i polo,
    Wer ire pi mer ku tego pare.
    E ban mwa ku pala, asi ku tong’ de,
    Dong’ wapak nying’ Mungu ku tego ceke.

2.	Pak bero pare, ku riekone de,
    Derne romo ng’om, elero wang’wa.
    Kum kwinyo m’Edagu ko dubo ma rac,
    Ng’ecwiny pare opo kum lembe ma swa.

3.	Ipido piwa, Igwokowa dre,
    I Wegwa mi kwo, m’Ikonyowa le.
    Waneno kony peri i koth ku ceng’ de,
    Icego cam iwa, wafoyi awe.

4.	Wa dhanu ma ng’ic, jubidhowa dit,
    Lem kum ku lem ng’om, Jok sendowa de.
    Wageni Rwoth Yesu m’Ivoyo mandha,
    Rucwic, ku Jalar mwa, jarimbwa mandha.

5.	Mugisa iri kum tegoni lwar, 
    Ku mer peri de m’lmaru kowa.
    Wameri, wadodi wapeki Mungu!
    Jol wer mwa ku pak ma wapeki kudo.

title: Majestic Sweetness
content:
1.	Tel wiwa Mungu ku ba ceng’, ka fodi wa n’i ng’om.
    I lembe ma watimo kpo, In m’Itelo wiwa ri, Itelo wiwa ri.

2.	Tek wabeyenyo cora swa, i yo ma ber ungo,
    Itirwa, Rwoth i wang’ayo kum ::wayenyo ngo wakier::

3.	Tek wabewotho kudi ndhu, i tic ku ba rupiny,
    Lembe mwa ceke cungo cu kum ::Itelo wiwa ri::

4.	Ka lem ma tek uwok iwa, de lembe moko mbe,
    Kum lworo negowa ungo, kum ::Itelo wiwa ri::

title: Holy, Holy, Holy
content:
1.	Mungu Rwoth ma leng’ kwe, m’l jatego ceke;
    Pir kugweno wer mwa de idho i beng’i tin.
    Mungu Rwoth ma leng’ kwe, jatego, jakisa.
    Mungu acel m’unyuthre i adek.

2.	Mungu Rwoth ma leng’ kwe, ju m’uboth gipeki.
    Gin girwo i beng’i ku the komker m’uberieny.
    Malaika mi polo, de girum i weng’i,
    M’ltie ku kwong’a, tin de, nja ku nja.

3.	Mungu Rwoth ma leng’ kwe, kadok mudho geng’i
    Kadok ju m ‘dubo gibeneno dwong’ni ngo.
    In I leng I kendi, ng’a mange rom kudi?
    Tegoni, merni, leng’ni sagu kpo.

4.	Mungu Rwoth ma leng’ kwe, m’l jatego ceke;
    Ju mi ng’om ku polo de gipaku nyingi tin.
    Mungu Rwoth ma leng’ kwe, jatego, jakisa,
    Mungu acel, m’unyuthre i adek.

title: Lord of Glory
content:
1.	Ubimo ma dwong’ wapeki, Yesu Kristo Wod Mungu.
    Wan ceke warum i weng’i In i dwong’ ma sagu kpo.
    In i kendi m’Iromo, kum tic peri ceke cu.

2.	Ubimo ma dwong’ wapeki, yang’ jukweri, juguri.
    Ento tho Ivoyo ceke, tin In i jacampacu.
    In i kendi m’Iromo, kum Itho pi dhanu yu.

3.	Ubimo ma dwong’ wapeki, Mungu m’umeri ketho
    Kwong’ mi dubo mwa i wii, dwoki lam mi dubo kpo.
    In i kendi m’Iromo, kum Ivoyo tho iwa.

4.	Ubimo ma dwong’ wapeki, kum lcer kind ju m’utho.
    Kristo pa Mungu wayungi, Ibibimo dhanu yu.
    In i kendi m’Iromo, kum i Rwoth mi rwodhi kpo.

title: Like a River Glorious
content:
1.	Kwiocwiny pa Mungu calu pi ma mol,
    Mondo ndhu i cwinywa, kwio racne kpo.
    Ceng’ ku ceng’ enyai m’emedre iwa cu,
    Man edoko thuth ketho wabedo yo.

              Mungu mwa Yehova kwio cwinywa ndhu,
              Gin ma dhoge wacu en e lemandha.

2.	Wapondo i cinge kum lembe ma rac
    Yenyo nyayu ndiri, pidoic mi ndra.
   Kud ipid lem ng’om ku gin ma galu ngo.
   Bed yo, Mungu kuri, kum Eol ungo.

3.	Kud ilwor masendi, Mungu yie En,
    Mer pare bikuri Ebirieme cen.
    Gene nindo ceke, Ebikonyi de,
    Kwiocwiny pa Mungu, kwiocwiny ma dhe.

title: Come Thou Almighty King
content:
1.	Wapeki Mungu Wegwa, In i won Lembe mandha.
    Wabepeki! In i Wegwa ma leng’ Mungu ma piri dwong’,
    Wamio yung iri, Wegwa mi nja.

2.	Wapeki Yesu ma Wod, Lembe m’uloro i ng’om.
    Wabepeki! Rombo m’utho ni lam m’Isendri dit ku can,
    Jalar m’ubodhowa, Yesu Kristo.

3.	Wapeki Tipo Maleng’, Tipo ma jajuk mandha.
    Wabepeki! Itelo wiwa cu, wakwei Iromwa do,
    Man bed japonji mwa, Tipo Maleng’.

4.	Wapeki Mungu acel, m’Inyuthri i yo adek.
    Wabepeki! Mungu, Wegwa, ku Wod, Tipo ma juko jo,
    Wapeki ku cwinywa ma nja ku nja.

title: What a Wonderful Saviour
content:
1.	Con Yesu lor’i ng’om mae, Yesu ma Jalar mwa.
    Eweko lonyo ma pare, Yesu ma Jalar mwa.

             Yesu ma Jalar mwa, wa dhanu wameri.
           	 Yesu ma Jalar mwa, warwo i beng’i.
         	 (Versi 2, 3, 4 wer Yesu ma Jalar mwa)

2.	Esendre ya Elar kowa,--
    Ekwero ngo nitho kumwa, --.

3.	Ka Yesu tho Eai k’i liel,--
    Elund Eidho ka maleng’,--

4.	Ka Yesu ai kud i polo,--
    Bidwogo kar’ Ecokwa kpo,--

title: All Hail the Power
content:
1.	Pak nying Rwoth Yesu, nying’ ma dwong’,
    Malaika rum ire. ::Jamkermiwic waroi wie,
    Wayunge Rwoth mi rwodhi!::

2.	Wu piny pare ma piwu tek i wang’ Jawar ma Rwoth.
    ::Ekoyowu pi tic ma pwe, wuyunge Rwoth mi rwodhi!::

3.	Wu suru ceke, dhanu yu, m’ubedo kwo i ng’om.
::Wudode ni ubimo mu, wuyunge Rwoth mi rwodhi!::

4.	Ka wabitundo kuca ma wajwigra the tiendi,
    ::Wapeki dit ku wer ma nja,
    Wayungi Rwoth mi rwodhi!::

title: Blest be the tie
content:
1.	 Wafoyo Jalar mwa, m’utho pi dhanu yu.
     Kum yioyic m’uribowa wadoko thek acel.

2.	 Wacokra the komker, pa Rwoth mi bedopwe.
     Wang’eyo Ebewinjowa ka waberwo ire.

3.	 Ka can unegowa, enurowa de dit,
     Juwadwa konyowa ku juk m’udwoko cwinywa tek.

4.	 Ka kindwa pokre dra, enyayu can iwa.
     Ere i polo ka ma njwa wapokra ngo mi nja.

title: Bring them in
content:
1.	Winj lem m’uai ku ba Jakwac m’ubedo woko ka ma col.
    Elwong’o rombe dong’ gibin, gibin i bang’e ju m’uol.

               ::Kelgi pio:: bin ku ju m’urwinyo ba Yesu.
               ::Kelgi pio:: kel judubo ndhu ba Yesu.

2.	 Ng’a yeny’ ekony jakwac mae, rombe m’ulal i thim ma bor.
     Ng’a ma bikelogi i dwol? Gibed ma ber i ka ma mor.

3.	 Woko i langa giywak tin, malu wi got ma mudho kwa.
     Winj Mungu kan Elwong’o in, Icidh iyeny ka rombene.

title: Safely through another week
content:
1.	 Mungu kurowa ma ber, yenga acel m’ukadhu bo.
     Dong’ wayenyo cwinywa ler ka waparu merni tin.

                 ::Ceng’ pa Mungu sagu kpo,
                 Yom ma tin ku yom ma nja::

2.   Dong’ warwo ku nyingi tin, Yesu lwok lem dubo mwa.
      Iriem iwa lem mi ng’om, keth wapar lem peri kwa.

3.   Ceng’ pa Mungu, ceng’ mi yom, Mungu mio iwa con.
      Ka wadaru tic mi ng’om wabiyom ku kwo ma nja.

title: Take the Name of Jesus
content:
1.	 Tek ikicri kawono yer nying’ Yesu nying’ ma ber.
     Ebijuki ndhu k’anyong’a kan iyero nying’ Jalar.

              :::Nyinge mit::: m’usagu kpo. Nyinge mit,
              Nyinge mit dit, nyinge mit m’usagu kpo.

2.	  Ka jadegi bin’ i beng’i man eyenyo bidhoi,
      Yer nying’ Yesu kud i cwinyi Ebilworoi ndhu.

3.	 Ka wacokra mal’ i polo wabineno wang’ Yesu.
     Wabiwero kanga pare Ebibed’ Ubimo mwa.

title: Praise the Saviour
content:
1.	Yesu Jalar dong’ wapake, gin m’Etimo ng’a ma ng’eyo?
    Ang’o ma waculo ire? Ndhu gin mwa ceke.

2.	 Yesu, nyinge mir anyong’a, En Ubimo ma jabang’wa,
     Nyinge mio tego iwa, tek warwo kude.

3.	 Wagen Yesu wa Jukristu, kum Ewaruwa ku rimbe.
     Ebikurowa ceng’ ceke kum Elokre ngo.

4.	 Gwokwa Yesu, wa juperi, watim iri kum wameri.
     Tek wacung i lembe peri Ibijolowa.

5.	 Ceng’ ma wabitund’ i beng’i wabibedo leng’ i weng’i.
     Wabipeki de ndhu rondo kuca i polo.

title: Revive us again
content:
1.	Wafoyo Mungu, En m’Emaruwa dit,
    Kum Yesu ma Wode m’Emio iwa.

           Wan wafoyo Yesu Kristo, wan wafoyo Yesu.
           Wan wafoyo Wod Mungu, wafoyo Yesu.

2.	 Wafoyo Jalar kum Etho piwa con
     En Emio kwo pare ni ju m’uyie.

3.	 Wafoyo Jajuk, En m’Ebedo bang’wa,
     En m’Enenowa ceke, Emaruwa dit.

title: Happy Day
content:
1.	::Anyong’a kwa!:: kum Yesu tho Elaruwa.
    Mutoro pong’o cwinywa dit,
    Wafoyo Rwoth ku foc mandha.

                 ::Lem ma dit:: kum Yesu lwoko dubo mwa.
                 Dong’ warwo ire, wabed leng’
                 Wacir abidhe ku ba ceng’
                 ::Lem ma dit:: kum Yesu lwoko dubo mwa.

2.	 Amira ceke ni Rwodha, atim tic ire, tic mandha.
     Enyayu wer i dhoga kwa, adundena bepake nja!

3.	 Dong’ tic mi both m’Etimo thum, adoko pare piny ma dhe.
     Ku dwal ma mit Elwong’a
     “Bin, lub toka ndhu i yo ma pwe.”

title: O How I Love Jesus
content:
1.	Nying’ Yesu winjre ber ira, e mit ma sagu ceke;
    Kum nying’ mange wi ng’om ngung’, uromo ngo calu en.

               ::: An amaru Yesu::: kum Elar Emara dit.

2.	 Epoya pi rimbe m’ucwir, m’ulwoko dubo ceke.
     Epoya de pi mer pare, m’Emaru ko dhanu pet.

3.	 Epoya de k’i can para, ya can m’utime sagu,
     Eng’eyo yeyo can para, ma sagu jumange.

title: My Redeemer
content:
1.	Waweru wer ma wafoi ko Yesu
    Kum mer ma dit m’Emaru kowa.
    Keth’ Etho piwa wi yen m’athara,
    Elwokwa ceke wabed leng’ njwa.

                 Wawero wer ma wafoi ko Yesu,
                 Kum pi lem tho m’Etho ko kor yen.
                 Rimbe m’ucwir elwoko ko kier mwa,
                 Ewaru dubo ceke cen.

2.	 Waweru wer ma wafoi ko Yesu, con aba para jukabu cen.
     Eculo banja para ku kisa, bero m’Etimo kaporne mbe.

3.	 Waweru wer ma wafoi ko Yesu abidhe ceke voyowa ngo,
     Kum tego pare En e aloci m’Evoyo dubo ku tho de kpo.

4.	 Waweru wer ma wafoi ko Mungu, wadoko wote ku yioyic.
     Ebilund cokowa ndhu i bang’e, e wabidoko cal kude de.

title: Glory to his Name
content:
1.	The yen m’athara pa Jalarna an aywak kum lem dubona.
    Yesu lwok ia dwoke tar, dong’ afoi Jalar.

             ::Dong’ afoi Jalarna:: Rimb Jalarna
             Yang’ ucwir pira, dong’ afoi Jalar.

2.	 Afoyo Yesu ma Jalarna kum En Esendre, Etho kuma.
     En de ekura, bikura nja, dong’ afoi Jalar.

3.	 Ni dub m’adubo aboth mumbe, Yesu de bedo i ia lwe,
     An ke abedo i ie de, dong’ afoi Jalar.

4.	 Iko ibin de ba Jalarna, En de bileri ku rimbe nja.
     Ilund ifoye ku foc mandha, dong’ ifoi Jalar.

                  ::Dong’ ifoi Jalarni:: Rimb Jalarni
                  Yang’ ucwir piri, dong’ ifoi Jalar.

title: Blessed Assurance
content:
1.	Meni ang’eyo Yesu Rwodha, 
    Berone bedo nja i cwinya.
    Tipone nyolo dhanu ma nyen
    Anyong’a nega ceng’ ku ba ceng’.

             Both ma juboth ko ai i bang’e,
             Lembe m’Eng’olo etimbre be.
             Mungu m’araga kud iyeny ki
             Kum Yesu kende e m’ubodhi.

2.	 Konya ku yero lem peri ber, 
     Gin ma Iyenyo e ma ayer.
     Ayeny awoth i yo peri cu, 
     Lembe mi ng’om abiweko kpo.

3.	 Yesu ameri, tel wia nja, 
     Akuro dwogo peri mandha.
     Ang’ayu wang’a yor i polo, 
     Kum Ibigamu juperi kpo.

title: Blessed be the Name
content:
1.	Wapak nying’ Mungu m’ubimo, E Mungu ma Won yung.
    Emio Wode ya Etho nilaru dhanu yu.

               ::Yesu bodhowa! Yesu bodhowa!
               Yesu bodhowa ku rimbe::

2.	 Nying’ Yesu sagu nying’ mange, wayunge ku wer mwa.
     Ejany malu jatego kpo, wayunge ku wer kwa.

3.	 Jawar, Jalar, jarimb dhanu, ma yang’ girwinyo swa.
     Eyabu yo mi both iwa m’utundo i polo.

4.	 Julwong’o nyinge Wang’uic, Japorlembe ma ber;
     Jaditmawijo, Kwiocwiny, Jatego ma wi ker.

title: Bringing in the Sheaves
content:
1.	Lembe mi mutoro wok i yo pa Mungu
    Ni kum Yesu Kristu ma Wod Mungune.
    Yesu Kristu tho kum kier mi dhanu ceke,
    Yesu Jalar nuti, dong’ ifoi Yesu.

         ::Dong’ ifoi Yesu, dong’ ifoi Yesu,
         Yesu Jalar nuti, dong’ ifoi Yesu::

2.	 Foyofoc unyay’ anyong’a kud i cwiny jo,
     Kum eriemo can m’ubedusendowa.
     Tek mutoro nuti can ke bilund ringo,
     Yesu Jalar nuti, dong’ ifoi Yesu.

3.	 Lem ma rac m’i ng’om umulowa wa dhanu,
     En esendowa i woth mi kwo ma nyen.
     Ento tek wafoyo Yesu kud i cwinywa,
     Lem m’usendowa dong’ Mungu kabu cen.

4.	 Jok ma en e won ndra thoko dit ewingwa,
     Yenyo corowa cen ku ba Mungu mwa.
     Dong’ wabed ku tego wanen ru ba Mungu,
     Yesu Jalar nuti, dong’ ifoi Yesu.

title: Jesus Saves
content:
1.	Wan wawinjo lemandha, Yesu kende Jalar.
    Lembene mutoro kwa! Yesu kende Jalar.
    Rimone belwokowa, rimbe copo lonyowa,
    Yioyic m’unyuthowa, Yesu kende Jalar!

2.	 Mungu wacu iwa kpo Yesu kende Jalar.
     Dong’ wuwinj kathere do, Yesu kende Jalar.
     Dhanu yu wung’eye be, co ku mon, nyithindho de.
     Wucik ithwu kume ki! Yesu kende Jalar!

3.	 Dong’ wu dhanu wuwinj cu, Yesu kende Jalar.
     En Ekwero mire ngo, Yesu kende Jalar.
     Tek wayie wabiboth, lembe pare wacu do.
     Keth jung’ei kathere cu, Yesu kende Jalar.

title: The Solid Rock
content:
1.	 Ageno bero para ngo, ajengra kum lem ng’om de ngo.
     Ndhu rimb Yesu m’uoi pira, ku berone m’agenona.

               Yesu ma kidi mi gundot,
               ::Jukwere con, m’Ekelo both::

2.	 Tek mudho cido wang’a de, ageno bero peri be.
     Tek dubo voya, cida bi, Elwoka tek atucogi.

3.	 Lewic umbe ni jupare m’ugene i masendi de.
     Eng’olo lembaribane m’ulokre ngo, jugene dre.

4.	 I ceng’ mi lieu tic binyuthre, ceng’ne biwodhe ka ma leng’.
     Rwoth konya atim iri cu, mac kud uwang’ tic para do.

title: And Can it Be
content:
1.	Ecopre andha abinwang’u rue mi dubo para
    I rimo pa Jalar? Emio kwo pare ndhu pira,
    M’uketho Etho wi Kalvari?

                 Imaruwa, wang’uic sagu dit mandha,
                 Ya In i Mungu para dong’ ldaru tho pira, 
                 Imaruwa, ndhu wang’uic, i Munguna in Itho pira. 

2.	 Eweko dwong’ ma pare yo ba Won,
     Bero ma pare sagu pidoic.
     Eweko ceke kum En e mer, Etho pi kodhi Adamu.

3.	 Alworo pokolembe kendo ngo
     Kum an abedo bong’ pa Rwoth Yesu.
     Kwona ni ie ma En e Wic,
     Eronya ku bedopwe pare.

title: Victory through Grace
content:
1.	En e Ubimo mir aloci, En e Ubimo ma dwong’
    Etelo yo wi ju ma gi pare ka gicimondo i lwiny.
    Nen gibekiedo ku tego, Rwoth migi gwokogi En.
    Dre gibeyunge Ubimo, kum En e Jategokpo.

              I lwiny maeni ju ma giloyo en e ni kum yioyic,
              Rwoth migi ng’olo jumandha ma gibiloyo ma gwei

2.	 Ubimone e Rwoth ma nenedi ma wubeyunge kumae?
     Udul ma ng’a m’Etelo yo igi, ju ma gipake ku wer?
     En e Jalar mwa ku Rwoth mwa, Ubimo, Jawar mandha.
    Ju ma gipake gi ju ma rimb Nyathi Rombo lwoko.

3.	 En e Ubimo mir aloci Yesu Jadit mi ng’om yu.
     Polo ku ng’om de copo kadhu, jubim mi ng’om ceke de.
     Ento jupare giloyo cil ma gicidho’ bang’e
     I pacu pare giyom de jamkermiwic kurogi.

title: The Old Time Religion
content:
1.	: ::Lem ma dit lem pa Yesu::: Lembe roma dit andha.

2.	 :::Ebitela ba Yesu::: Lembe roma dit andha.

3.	 :::Kum ekonya ceng’ ceke::: Lembe roma dit andha.

4.	 :::Kan avoc ebijuka::: Lembe roma dit andha.

5.	 :::Ebitera i polo::: Lembe roma dit andha.

title: Crown Him with Crowns
content:
1.	Wayung ubimo mwa, Ebedo wi komker, 
    Winj wer ma jumaleng’ wero, wer ma gipake ko.
    Wapake de ku wer, kum Etho piwa kpo. 
    Wadode Rwoth mi rwodhi kwa Ubimo mwa mi nja.

2.	 Wayung ubimo mwa, Jacwic m’uronyo kum. 
     Junyole de i Bethlehem, Wod Mungu wok i ng’om. 
     Etho pi dubo kpo, Elaruwa k’i tho, 
     Wafoyo kisa pare dwong’ m’umio iwa kwo.

3.	 En e ukungu mer, nen ng’ete, cinge de, 
     Wang’ rem unen m’unyuthowa Esendre dit piwa. 
     Malaika ceke de giyungo Yesu Rwoth, 
     Gikulo wigi niyungo Ubimo mwa mi nja.

title: When Morning Gilds
content:
1.	Ka piny uru i wia afoyo Rwoth ma dwong’,
    Pak Yesu Kristu dit. I tic m’atimo kpo,
    Ka cwinya de berwo, pak Yesu Kristu dit.

             (Versi 2, 3, 4 wer “Pak Yesu Kristu dit” kumeno).

2.	 Mungu ma malu ngbir, Wegwa ma I won mer, ---
     Wapeki ku wer kwa, mutoro negowa. ---

3.	 Tek can usendowa, Jajuk mwa nuti nja, ---
     Kadok ambe ku piny, Emio kwiccwiny. ---

4.	 Ka fodi wani ng’om, wawero wer ma dwong’ ---
     Kuca i kwo mandha, wer mwa bibedo nja. ---

title: Count your blessings
content:
1.	Ka waparu gin ma Mungu miowa,
    Par ma tek gin ceke ma Emiowa.
    Gin m’Emio bang’wa e m’unyuthowa,
    Mungu e m’umaru dhanu dit andha.

            Yesu Kristu Mungu mio re, Lembe pare de Eoro re.
            Ka wayio wabinwang’u kwo, kwo ma Mungu mione bithum de ngo.

2.	 Ka kec nut’i pacu, koth ucwi de ngo,
     Tek wapenjo Mungu Ebiwinjowa.
     Mungu mio kata, ku rabolo de,
     Kwen de, bel de, kal de Mungu mio re.

3.	 Mungu mio Yesu En m’etho piwa,
     Yesu lor’ i ng’om, Esendre dit andha.
     Rimbe ceke cwir yang’ con nibodhowa,
     Ka wayio Yesu wabiboth andha.

title: How Great Thou Art
content:
1.	Rwoth Munguna, ka ia maku paru
    Pi gin ceke ma In Icwio ri,
    Cero ku dwi, ku ceng’ m’urieny i polo
    Ginyutho ya In i Jategokpo.

               ::Apeki Rwoth ma In i Jalarna,
               I dwong’ ma gwei, I dwong’ ma gwei::

2.	 Kan abewotho ku the yen mi luli
     Awinjo winyo paku In ku wer.
     Gudi ma dongo nyutho pi dwong’ peri
     Ku giracwia kpo m’Icwio ri.

3.	 Kan abeparu pi Wodi m’loro, 
     Etho pira, E ia uwang’ li. 
     Wi Kalvari Eyeyo ter mwa ceke
     Rimone cwir nilonyo dubona.

4.	 Ku dwal ma dit ka Kristu dwogo gama
     Anyong’ana bisagu dit andha.
     E abirum e abijwigra ire, e abipake,
     “Munguna, I dwong!”

title: To God be the Glory
content:
1.	Wami dwong’ ni Mungu kum tic pare dit,
    Emio Wode kum Emaru ng’om yu.
    Wode mio kwo - adunya pi kier mwa,
    Eyabu dhugola mi kwo iwa kpo.

              ::Dwong’ ni Rwoth:: Wek ng’om winj dwande do!
              ::Dwong’ ni Rwoth:: Wek anyong’a mwa pong’!
              Bin ceng’ni ba Wego ni kum Yesu Wod,
              Wami foc ni Mungu, kum tic pare dwong’.

2.	 Eyabu yoj both, rimb Jalar Yesu cwir,
     Ni dhanu m’uyie Mungu ng’olo de,
     Jadubo ma rac dit m’eyio andha,
     Dubo pare rucre pet i saa nica.

3.	 Enyutho dwong’ pare ku lembe, ku tic,
     Wafoye, wayunge, ku Nying Yesu Wod.
     Andha wabipake ku wang’uic dit,
     Ka waneno Yesu, Jalar, Rwoth Mungu.

title: Jesus the very Thought
content:
1.	Ka iwa pido pi Yesu mutoro negowa,
    Ento ma sagu ceke re, wanen ru wang’ Jalar.

2.	 Awinjo ngo, ang’eyo ngo, man de aparu kwe,
     Nyinge mit sagu mange kpo, Jalar mi dhanu yu.

3.	 Wageno En ku kwiocwiny, Yesu m’ubedo mol.
     Ejukowa weg pidoic, Ekonyo ju m’uol.

title: Jesus Shall Reign
content:
1.	Yesu bibimo wi ng’om ceke de,
    Gambre i nam cil i tung’ ng’om.
    E Rwoth mi rwodhi mi ng’om ngung’,
    Ubimo mwa, nyalwo mandha.

2.	 Mungu bidode malu kpo, 
     Cong’ ceke rum dwe the komker.
     Kara leb ceke pak nyinge, 
     Yesu Wod Mungu ma Jalar.

3.	 Haleluya! Jategokpo! 
     Mutoro nego cwinywa kpo.
     Dong’ wami dwong’ ni Jalar mwa, 
     Wapake dre, wayunge nja.

4.	 Thek ceke cokri nipake, 
     Ku girajoka dupa de.
     Winj jumalaika gipake, 
     Ng’om de bipake nja ku nja.

title: Love found a Way
content:
1.	Pokri ma rac i kindwa con waku Jalar,
    Lembene wang’u ia li, Yesu bodha.
    Kinde ma genogen umbe, e ceng’ ma dwong’,
    Mer ting’o cwinya kud i tho, mer pa Jalar.

                  Mer nwang’u yo m’ewar ko cwinya, 
                  Mer nwang’u yo m’udwoka ndhu bo.
                  Mer oro Rwoth, Etho kakara, 
                  Mer nwang’u yo apaku Nying Jalar.

2.	 Mer kelo Jalar kar’ Etho wi Kalvari pira m’adubo rac ma gwei,
     Wang’uic dit. Mer tadu kindwa ku polo, ponja nirwo.
     Yesu ulara, gonya de, dwong’ ni Jalar.

3.	 Mer ting’a kud i ka ma thuth, longro pa Jok.
     Kara acung wi cana.
     Ma En e Jalar. Mer yabu polo ira de, ndhu genogen.
     Ka mir anyong’a nja ku nja ku Yesu Rwoth.

title: Peace, perfect peace
content:
1.	Ndhu kwiocwiny, i ng’om mae ma rac,
    Rimb Yesu mio cwiny ma kwio ndhu.

2.	Kwiocwiny de kind tic ma tek ceng’ du.
    Nitimo yeny pa Mungu mio yom.

3.	 Kwiocwiny de kind can ma dit mi ng’om,
     Ku geno Yesu kwiocwiny juyic.

4.	 Kwiocwiny de nwang’u jumer ni bor.
     Gigwokri calku wan i Yesu Rwoth.

5.	 Kwiocwiny de kadok tho wok bang’wa.
     Rwoth Yesu sagu tho ku tegone.

6.	 Eni romo, ceng’ mange can bithum,
     Man wabibedo nja ku nja ba Rwoth.

title: Jesus is a Friend of Mine
content:
1.	Yesu En e :::Jarimba:::
    En Esagu utumira ceke do, Yesu En e Jarimba
    (versi 2 ujik i 9 wer kumeni,ento)

2.	 Yesu En e Jabodhna

3.	 Yesu En e Jagwokna

4.	 Yesu En e Jakonyma

5.	 Yesu En e Jakwacna

6.	 Yesu En e Jajukna

7.	 Yesu En e Jalarna

8.	 Yesu En e Jamerna

9.	 Yesu En e Jawarna

10. Yesu wan wafoi dit ::wafoi::
      Kum Iwaruwa ku rimoni m’ucwir,
      Wan wamio foc ni Rwoth.
english_name: Jesus is a Friend of Mine

title: Let Him in
content:
1.	A wufoi Yehova do, k-u-m e ber.
    Mer mi bero pare de be--do mi nja.
    Wafoi Rwoth mi rwodhi kpo, warum ire kum e dwong’.
    Mer mi bero pare de be- -do mi nja, (dar versi ceke kumeno).

2.	 Cinge cwio polo de, dwo--ng’ ire.
     Ng’om de tic mi cinge re, dwo--ng’ ire.
     Ceng’ ku dwi ku cero kpo cwic ma Rwoth ucwio En ---

3.	 En m’Egoyo Misiri, alo--ci, man
     Ewodho Israel, dwo--ng’ ire.
     Cinge tek ku bote de, cil m’Epoko Nam Makwar ---

4.	 Dhanu pare kadhu nam, dwo--ng’ ire,
     Ku wi ng’om m’uthwo ma gwei, dwo--ng’ ire.
     Farao kud udulne de, Eredho, Enyotho pet ---

5.	 Woth ma bor i langa re, dwo--ng’ ire.
     En Etelo Israel ku cin--ge.
     Ng’om m’Emio ni aba, en e ng’om ma ber mandha --

6.	 Mungu poi pi ju ma pwe, dwo--ng’ ire.
     Aba nuti igi de i ba--ng’e.
     Both de nuti kind abdhe, wafoi Mungu dit mandha ---

title: A Toi la Gloire
content:
1.	Kristu uloyo, dwong’ ubed ire nja, pak uromo Kristu,
     Yunge nja ku nja. Digidi ma dit ubino,
     Malaika pa Rwoth ng’ielo kidi bor cen, bedo de i wie.

             Kristu uloyo, dwong’ ubed ire nja,
             Pak uromo Kristu, yunge nja ku nja.

2.	 Nen Yesu Kristu! En m’Eloyo tho, En Etho kakawa
     En Ubimo mwa. Ju m’uyie ceke wurwei lembene,
     Lembe pi Rwoth Yesu kum En m’Eloyo tho.

3.	 Kum Yesu nuti lworo binega ngo, an agene kende
     Rwoth mi kwiocwiny. An a kwo ru kude ndhu ku tegone,
     Kwona bed’i cinge, pirang’o alwor?

title: My Faith Looks Up
content:
1.	Wang’a benonoi, Rombo mi Kalvari, Mungu Jalar.
    Winja kan aberwo, wek dubo para kpo,
    Ia m’ubedo col, lwoke dok tar.

2.	 Mungu Jakisa dit, ang’ic, dwoka bed tek,
     Mungu para. Itho pi dubona, kum mer m’imara ko,
     Mer ma bithum ungo ndhu nja ku nja.

3.	 Ka yo bedoko col, an de amaku ol, nyuth ira yo.
     Lok mudho dok va ceng’, ler cwinya dwoke leng’,
     Kura, m’ageno In, kud akier do!

4.	 Ka can udoko lic, ka cwinya yenyo voc, konya Rwodha.
     Kum gwok m’Igwoka ko, lworo binega ngo,
     Ting’a i kori, abed beng’i nja.

title: Sun of my Soul
content:
1.	Der mi kwo para e Yesu Rwoth, imenyo ira yo mi both.
    Lem mi ng’om an ayenyo ngo, egeng’o weng’i ira do.

2.	 Ka tic m’atimo ola mandha iting’o ira ter ma pek.
     Apoi pi yom m’Imio ri, kan abibedo i beng’i.

3.	 Bed i bang’a ku ba rupiny kpo, kum tek Itie Ikwio cwinya.
     Ikura Yesu dieceng’ du, In i Mungu, Inindo ngo.

4.	 Ka tho bisenda ku can mandha, dong’ Ibed bang’a Rwoth mi nja.
     Yesu Jalar, jol cwinya do, abed i beng’i i polo.

title: It is Well with My soul
content:
1.	I nindo ma woth para bebedo miero,
    I can ma lic Rwoth nuti de.
    I woth para ceke Eyero ira:
    “Kwiocwiny para romi, woda.”

               ::Kwiocwiny pa Rwodha:: Abejukra i Rwoth ku ba saa.

2.	 Ka Jok ubebidha, masendi nuti de,
     Wia kud uwil pi mae: ya Kristu beneno ba ng’ic
     Para kpo, bero pare de romo ira.
     ::Bero pa Yesu Rwoth:: Bero pare de romo ira.

3.	 Ka Kristu tho pira Eyeyo gondrina,
     Ayio tho pare ira. Abedo museme i cing’ Jalarna,
     Mak’ afoi Yesu Rwoth nja ku nja.
     ::Foyofoc ni Jalar:: Mak’ afoi Jalarna nja ku nja.

4.	 Kawono akio kum Rwoth bidwogo rek,
     Jupare biwinjo dwande. Rwoth Yesu biloro
     Nicoko juyic, “Maranatha” bin pio, Rwodha.
     ::Bin Rwodha:: “Marantha” bin pio, Rwodha.
english_name: It is Well with My soul

title: Break the Bread of Life
content:
1.	Rwodha, ng’wek kwen mi kwo, ng’wek ira tin,
    Calu Ing’weko ninde con dhu nam.
    Lembe m’ubedo kwo, ayenyo In,
    Andha Yesu avani nega dit.

2.	 Rwodha, nyai lemandha, nyai ia tin,
     Calu inyayu kwen ni dhanu con.
     Ebilund gonya k’i mudho ma bi,
     Lembe biketh’ abed ma cwinya kwi.

3.	 In de i kwen mi kwo, ira Rwodha.
     Lembe peri ma leng’ e m’ulara,
     M’uketh abedo kwo de nja ku nja,
     Yesu Kristu ma lem mi kwo, Rwodha.

title: Guide me O Thou Great Jehovah
content:
1.	Mungu In Itelo wia kan awoth’i ng’om keni.
    An a ng’ic, In i won tego, gwoka ndhu ku tegoni.
    ::Kwen mi polo, Yesu En e kwen mi kwo::

2.	 Pi mi kwo de ai i beng’i, rieu binega kendo ngo.
     I yo ceke Yesu kura, Ebitera i polo.
     ::I Jalarna, uma ndhu ku beroni::

3.	 Kan akadhu kud i longro meni tipopiny mi tho,
     In i karacelo kuda ketho lworo nega ngo.
     ::Rwoth mi bero, abipaku nyingi nja::
english_name: Guide me O Thou Great Jehovah

title: O Lord, Remember Me
content:
1.	Andha Jalar Rwoth Yesu tho, Ubimo sendre dit
    Jutong’o lero i kume junyayu rem de dit

2.	 Esendre ni kum gondri mwa, kier mwa Eyeyo re.
     Ni kum goc pare wacangu, wan ma waromo nyoth.

3.	 Ka Yesu tho kakawa con, Ealu dhoge ngo.
     Jukabe woko kud i ng’om kum kier mwa ni wie.

4.	 Ebedo ber ni Mungu ya Enyai rem i Wode.
     Enyayu can i kume re, Wod woro cil i tho.

5.	 Wa rombe pare m’Ebodho, watim ang’o ire?
     Wamira ire, wabed leng’, watim yeny pare cu.

title: Tell it to Jesus
content:
1.	Ceng’ ma pidoic udieng’o cwinyi ::kwai Yesu konyi::
    Cwinyi ringo rr kum lembe moko kwai Yesu konyi, gene.

                ::Kwai Yesu konyi:: e Jamer mandhandha.
               Jakony mange mbe ma ro ku Yesu, kwai Yesu konyi, gene.

2.	 Can unegi, man piweng’i oi brr, ::kwai Yesu konyi::
     Kud ilwor ki, ento yie kende, kwai Yesu konyi, gene.

3.	 Cwinyi miel e lworo de benegi, ::kwai Yesu konyi::
     Dubo nyayu lewic dit i weng’i, kwai Yesu konyi, gene.

4.	 Tek ilworo tho ma ibitho ko, ::kwai Yesu konyi::
     Ko ilar iyie kud i cwinyi, kwai Yesu konyi, gene.

5.	 Tek ithoko voyo lem mi dubo, ::kwai Yesu konyi::
     Som lem pa Rwoth Yesu, ebijuki, kwai Yesu konyi, gene.

title: I Do Believe
content:
1.	Athang’u cinga beng’i Rwoth dieceng’ ku diewor bu!
    Aywak ba ng’a tek Ikuna, Yehova won tego?

             :: Ayio do:: ya Yesu tho pira.
             Rimbe m’ucwir wi Kalvari belonyo gondrina.

2.	 Juthumo nyathi romboni m’Ing’olo iwa con.
     Apoi pi kadhukuwijo ketho waboth ni tho.

3.	Iwinjo ywak mi dhoga de kum can m’utima dit.
    Imia calku lonyoni ni kum Jalar Yesu.

title: Even me
content:
1.	Mungu lembe tuc i bang’a pi mugisa peri de.
    Ma Imio ni juperi, ko Imie ira le.
    ::Ira le:: ko Imie ira le.

2.	 Kud ikuna Mungu Wegwa, an a rac, akier de swa.
     Bed ku kisa dit i kuma kan atuco dubona.
     ::Dubona:: kan atuco dubona.

3.	 Jalar Yesu kud Iweka, an ajengra kumi ki.
     An ayenyo bero peri, kum Itho wi Kalvari.
     ::Kalvari:: kum Itho wi Kalvari.

4.	 Mer pa Mungu, mer ma leng’ kwe,
     Rimb Jalar ma pire tek.
     Bero peri nen i wothna, kan alubo toki pwe.
     ::Toki pwe:: kan alubo toki pwe.

title: Jesus Keep Me Near
content:
1.	Yesu abed ceng’ni In, ceng’ni rimbi keca,
    M’ucwir con ni dhanu yu, kulo mir alwoka.

                ::Ceng’ni In:: abed ndhu the tiendi,
                Cil i ceng’ m’atugo woth m’aci ko i beng’i.

2.	Piny i ng’om a jawirok, kisa peri nwang’a.
In m’i cero jobi Iwok In Irieny i wang’a.

3.	 Ceng’ni In i rombona. In m’ltho kakara.
      Kony awoth ma ber andha, cil i ceng’ tho para.

4.	 Yesu, abed ceng’ni In kara In Ikonya.
     Awoth ber ku ba rupiny, ram atund ko kuca.

title: There Shall Be Showers
content:
1.	Mungu biyepo cwiny dhanu, Eng’olo lembene con.
    Ju ma gigalu bipoi ndhu, e calu koth m’ubeton.

                 Koth Ebicoro, kum cwinywa tal calu ng’om.
                 Ng’om m’uthwo kau man ekak de,
                 Eketho cwinywa dok yom.

2.	 Mungu biyepo cwiny dhanu, nyinge m’ucidre bilony,
     Man Ebidwokowa leng’ njwa, ni cilo m’ucidowa.

3.	 Mungu biyepo cwiny dhanu, nyo Ebicore ndhu tin.
     Tipo ma nyen Ebimio, kier mwa juguro kor yen.

title: No Not One
content:
1.	Jarimbwa mbe ro ku Jalar Yesu ::tak de mbe::
    Ng’atu mange mbe m’ulwoko cwinywa, ::tak de mbe::
    (ku ba versi ceke wer: ::tak de mbe::)

                 Yesu ng’eyo pi can mwa ceke, 
                 Ebikonyowa i rundi kpo.
                 Jarimbwa mbe ro ku Jalar Yesu 
                 ::tak de mbe::

2.	 Jarimbwa mbe ro ku En ma leng’ kwe ---
     Jarimbwa mbe ro ku En ma ming’ de, ---

3.	 Jakristu moko de mbe m’Ekuno, ---
     Ng’atu m’uyie de mbe m’Eriemo, ---

4.	 Gin moko mbe ro ku Jalar Yesu, ---
     Mer moko mbe ro ku mer pa Mungu, ---

title: I Must Tell Jesus
content:
1.	Dong’ akwai Yesu kum lembe para,
    A kenda e bicoprena ngo.
    Ka ng’om usaga Yesu bilara, 
    Yesu bilara Yesu Kristu.

             ::Dong’ akwai Yesu:: a kenda e bicoprena ngo.
             ::Dong’ akwai Yesu:: Yesu bilara, Yesu Kristu.

2.	 Dong’ akwai Yesu pi can m’unega, 
     En e jarimba. Eriemo can. 
     Tek an apenje, En de bikonya.
     Yesu ni bang’a Ebijuka.

3.	 Con a jadubo, ketho arwinyo,
     Jok de ebidha ku lem mi ndra.
     Dong’ akwai Yesu, e jatel wia, 
     Yesu bikura, Yesu Kristu.

title: Take My Life
content:
1.	 An amio iri Rwoth jukupiny m’abedo ko,
     An ku lonyo para kpo gam maeni, jole do.

2.	 Tic m’atimo iri de, tiend’ ario ku cinga de.
     Dwanda bende, yike do, keth apak Jalarna cu.

3.	 Nindo para m’ani ng’om, kud anyothe calu con.
     Atuc lembanyong’a ber keth anyeb juwada lwar.

4.	 Cal ku yeny m’ayenyo ngo, ento cal’ Iyenyo ri.
     Pidoicna dwoke nyen, cwinya de bed ot maleng’.

5.	 Kwona ceke peri Rwoth, rimbi dwoka lonyoni.
     Kwona ceke peri Rwoth, a jamiru peri do.

title: Higher Ground
content:
1.	Ayeny awoth i yo ma cu ku ba rupiny wakudi Rwoth.
    Acidh i wang’a ndhu ku rwo, Ikura kara kud avoc.

                  Rwoth peya malu ceng’ni In acung i ng’eti ka maleng’.
                  Ka ma mugisa sagu kpo, ayenyo aidh malu do.

2.	 Ayenyo ngo adong’ kakae, abidhe dit, masendi kwa.
     Jumoko foyo ng’om mae, andre ayeny aidh malu.

3.	 Ayeny’ acir abidhe kpo, atim tic ber avoi dubo.
     Gin ma tek Mungu nyolo nyen, eloyo ng’om k’awanyane.

4.	 Ayeny’ atund i ng’om ma nyen kar’ anen dwong’ pa Rwoth maleng’.
     Atundo ngo kum berona, endre kum kwo m’Emiona.

title: Yield Not to Temptation
content:
1.	Kud iyi abdhe pa jadegini, gut ni wonabali, ebiringoi.
    Cor ndhu i vut Yesu Ecor i vuti, 
    Wukude wuvoyo abidhene vi.

                  Kwai Jalar ya Ekonyi ivoi ng’atu m’ubidhi.
                  Yesu nuti bigwoki, ndhu ku tegone En.

2.	Der ribre nenedi ku mudho mi ng’om?
    Man bedopwe ribre ngo ku camuco.
    Bed ku kweri giri ni lem mi tarwang’,
    Yung Mungu i kumi, woth i lemandha.

3.	 Ni ng’atu m’uloyo Rwoth mio jamker,
     Man ke jubiyunge ku jamkermiwic.
     Nen ndhu yo ba Yesu, gen tegone ndhu,
     Aloci ni bang’wa wan waku Yesu.

title: What a Friend
content:
1.	Yesu Kristu e jarimbwa, dubo mwa Eyeyo re.
    Mungu wacu ya wakwaye, gin m’wayenyo i bang’e.
    Kwiocwiny urwinyo iwa, can usendowa mumbe,
    Wiwa wil nirwo ni Mungu ma waparu pire ngo.

2.	Ndiba kud abidhe nuti ku masendi dit mandha.
    Ento Mungu julko cwinywa tek warwo i bang’e nja.
    Ng’atu ma e rom ku Yesu nwangre ngo i ng’om mae,
    En Eng’eyo ng’ic mwa ceke, wakwai tego i bang’e.

3.	Ter ma pek unuro cwinywa, tego mwa dong’ nok ma gwei.
    Tipo pare e jajuk mwa, mak’ Etel wiwa i rwo.
    Tek jurimbwa wanjri kumwa
    Dong’ waywak ni Mungu mwa.
    Ebigwakuwa ku bote, Ebijuko cwinywa nja.

title: Have Thine own way
content:
1.	Tim ve Iyenyo, Mungu Rwodha! 
    An a ulobo m’lcwio ri.
    Winya, Icwia ku bodhoni, 
    Kan arum dwe the tego peri.

2.	Tim ve Iyenyo Mungu Rwodha! 
    Nen yor i ia, mul ia do.
    Kan Ilwok ia adok tar pu, 
    Arum ajwigra the cingi do.

3.	Tim ve Iyenyo Mungu Rwodha!
    Nen ram a ng’ic ko, ko Ikonya do.
    Tegona ceke ai i beng’i, 
    Keth cwinya dok tek ku tegoni.

4.	Tim ve Iyenyo Mungu Rwodha! 
    Bima i kendi an a jendi.
    Roma ku Tiponi ma jajuk, 
    Nen abekuro the tiendi yo.

title: God is here & that to Bless
content:
1.	Mungu nuti kindwa eni ndhu ku tego Tipone.
    Tek wakwaye Ebiketho polo cor koth wiwa tin.

           Wek ebin wakweyi Mungu, cor mugisa wiwa tin.
           ::Wabekuro:: Mungu mwa yep cwinywa do.

2.	Mungu nuti kindwa eni, i kind cokri mwa mae.
    Ava yepocwiny ni kumwa, kud Iwek ya cwinywa ai.

3.	Mungu nuti kindwa eni, dong’ wakwai ku ripocwiny.
    Mac mi mer uwang’ i iwa, ketho gin ma rac urwiny.

4.	Jalar winjwa ka wakweyi, ka warum the tiendi ling’.
    Wan wayio Tipo romwa, ya Edwokwa wadok leng’.
english_name: God is here & that to Bless

title: Rock of Ages
content:
1.	Cana mwa ma tek mi nja ma jung’enyo pira dra.
    Rimoni ma yang’ ucwir, ecwir hau pi dhanu kpo.
    Rimbe ruco dubona, man edwoka leng’ ma njwa.

2.	Kadok can unega dit, kadok tic atimo dit,
    Meni ruco dubo ngo In i kendi ‘laru jo.
    An aromo both de ngo, mak’ amok i kumi ki.

3.	Rundi para calu lum, kadhu pio e kwona thum.
    Abicidh’ i polo ndhu, abineno weng’i bu.
    Cana mwa ma tek mi nja ma jung’enyo pira dra.

title: Whiter than Snow
content:
1.	Rwoth Yesu ayenyo abed leng’ ma njwa, 
    Ayenyo Ibed i cwinya nja ku nja
    Bai gin ma wilo wia i kumi do, 
    Lwok ia keth abed ma tar sagu pei.

                  (ku ba versi ceke dar: Lwok ia keth abed ma tar sagu pei)

                 Tar sagu pei, ma tar sagu pei, 
                 Lwok ia keth abed ma tar sagu pei.

2.	Rwoth Yesu par pira kawono akwei, 
    Gin m’uwilo wia konya ku kwere.
    An amira iri ku ng’eyong’ec kpo, ---

3.	 Rwoth Yesu kum eni akweyi mandha, 
     Akuro the tiendi ku cwinya ma lwe.
     Aneno rimoni m’llwoka ko do, ---

4.	Rwoth Yesu akwei, arum iri dwe, 
    Mi ira adunde mi dhanu ma nyen,
    Kum ju ma gikweyi, Ikwerogi ngo, ---

title: Take Time to be Holy
content:
1.	Kur yo i wang’ Yesu, inwang’ bedopwe,
    Rwo ire areri som Lem pare dit.
    Mar bende jupare, kony ju ma gi ng’ic,
    Kwai Rwoth mi mugisa man wii kud uwil.

2.	Kur yo i wang’ Yesu wek lembe mi ng’om, 
    Rwo nyalwe i bang’e Ebiwinjoi.
    Iribri ku Yesu ibed cal kude, 
    I tic peri ceke ayine binen.

3.	Kur yo i wang’ Yesu Etel iri yo, 
    Kud iring i wang’e m’Etelo wii ngo.
    I anyong’a, can de, ilub ng’ei Rwodhi 
    Man, nen tel ba Yesu, gen lem pare cu.

4.	Bed yo i wang’ Yesu, kur yo i cwinyi, 
    Wek pidoic ceke the ng’ol pare do.
    Tipone biteri i thuth mi merne, 
    Iyikri pi bedo cil i polo de.

title: Lead on O King
content:
1.	Tel wiwa Jawipiro wamondu ndhu i lwiny,
    Wakiedu mony wakudu, wacir ku tegocwiny.
    Iponjowa ku rieko, Imio tego peri,
    Kawono Jawipiro, cak wer, waci kudu.

2.	Tel wiwa Jawipiro, wakied ku dubo kpo.
    Wavoye ku leng’ cwinywa, cil ma ng’om bikwio.
    Anyego mwa ku kum ungo, ento ku Rwoth mi mudho,
    Ku yioyic ku rwo de, wavoyo jakwor mwa.

3.	Tel wiwa Jawipiro, waci ma lworo mbe.
    Tek wan waneno weng’i e cwinywa doko tek.
    I wiwa yen m’athara, der pare menyowa,
    Jamkermiwic wanwang’u ba jadit mi wiwa.

title: He will Answer Prayer
content:
1.	Mungu ng’olo i lem pare ya Elingo tek warwo.
    Ebiwinjo ywak mwa ceke kud adieng’acwiny mwa kpo.

                 Mungu winjo rwo mwa do, Ebidwoko wang’e kpo.
                 Yie kum Eromo ceke, Ebitimo, yie ndhu.

2.	Ku wakwai ku cwiny ma jiji maku ya wagene ndhu.
    Tipo gire kwayu piwa kara rwo mwa winjre cu.

3.	Mungu winjo penji ceke dok enok kadok elwar.
    Tek wakwayu ndhu ku nyinge kwayukwac m’areri kwa.

4.	Gin m’urany ku gin m’unyothre tere ndhu iyer ni Rwoth.
    Ebijuki ber i canne kum Eng’eyo lembe kpo.

title: Fill Me Now
content:
1.	 Bed i kuma Tipo Mungu, ko Iyik wang’ cwinya tin.
     Rom i ia Tipo Mungu, bin kawono roma tin.

                 ::Roma tin:: Yesu bin, Iroma tin.
                 Rom i ia Tipo Mungu, bin kawono roma tin.

2.	 Tin Icopo roma, Rwodha, ram Iroma ko loya.
     Pidoicna yenyo voya, bin kawono roma In.

3.	 Tekra mbe, a yereyere, dong’ arum the tiendi dwe.
     Tiponi ma nja ku nja de, mina tego, roma tin.

title: More about Jesus
content:
1.	 Keth ang’ei mange pi Yesu kar’ anyai lem mi berone.
     Mange pi lem m’ubodho jo, mange pi mer m’uketh’ Etho.

                 ::Lem Mange pi Yesu:: 
                 Mange pi lem m’ubodho jo
                 Mange pi mer m’uketh’ Etho.

2.	 Keth ang’ei kendo pi Yesu, mange pi yeny m’Eyenyo re.
     Japonjina, Tipo Maleng’, Nyuth ira lembe pi Kristo.

3.	 Keth ang’ei mange pi Yesu, wabed wawec ru wakude.
     Awinjo lembagorane, adwoko lembene ire.

4.	 Ang’ei pi Yesu Rwoth ma dit lonyo mi polo pare pet.
     Mange pi dwogo pa Yesu, man bim m’Ebimo ko ng’om yu.

title: Close to Thee
content:
1.	In Iroma ceng’ ku ceng’ kpo I Jarimba ma ber dit.
    Man i yo m’ucidh’ i polo abilubona toki.

                ::::Ceng’ni In:::: I yo ma cidho i polo abilubona toki.

2.	 Kadok can de wok i bang’a Yesu nuti ceng’ni an.
     Abifoyo In i kendi, wabiwotho wakudi.

3.	 Kadok tho de wok i bang’a Yesu nuti ceng’ni an.
     Lworo ceke ringo bor cen, jagwokna ni vuta En.

title: Don’t Stop Praying
content:
1.	Rwo areri kum Mungu tie, rwo areri Elingoi.
    Lembang’ola elokre ngo, Mungu winjo lem peri kpo.

2.	Rwo areri tek can de tie, rwo areri Epoi piri.
    Nyo i weng’i kit canne mbe, Ebikonyi i canne be.

3.	Rwo areri abidhe tie, won abidhe bisendi de.
    Yang’ esendo Jalar mwa dit, en d’Evoye ku lem pare.

4.	Rwo areri ka cwinyi dieng’, rwo areri de kum canpiny.
    Mungu neno gin ceke En, gene ndhu bed ku yioyic.

5.	Rwo areri ka kumi lith, Ebijengi i ndiba pet.
    Tek iyio ku cwinyi kpo, lem ma tek de bidoko yot.

title: Saviour Lead Me
content:
1.	Yesu nyutha wang’ayo, lworo kud unega do.
    Tek amok i kumi ki abibedo i merni.

                 ::Yesu:: dong’ Inyutha wang’ayo.
                 Kud awoth ariri swa, an ayeny’ alubi nja.

2.	Abibedo museme, cil i ndiba ceke de.
    Cwinya bed i vuti dri kum abibegeno In.

3.	Yesu e Jakwac ma ber, rombene Eng’eyo kpo.
    Ebelwong’o nying’gi de man giwinjo dwande cu.

4.	Yesu nyutha wang’ayo, cil ma kwona maku ai.
    Yo m’akwanyu yo mi kwo, bitera i poloni.

title: Just for Today
content:
1.	Rwoth, pir urwo ku lem pare akwei ngo,
    Cera, kara kud adubi - pi tin kende.

                 ::Pi tin kende:: Rwodha, gwoka,
                 Tel wia, pi tin kende.

2.	Keth atim tic kud amora, ku rwo bende
    Mi ira berocwiny bende - pi tin kende.

3.	Kud atim yeny m’ayenyo ra, keth abed wor.
    Konya nimira gira dho - pi tin kende.

4.	Kud ayer lembe moko swa m’uromo ngo,
    Cer dendhoga ku wec ma rac - pi tin kende.

title: Pass Me Not
content:
1.	Kud ikuna Jalar Yesu, winj lem para do.
    Kan Ikonyo jumange Rwoth, kud ikuna do!

                    Jalar, Yesu, kud ikuna do!
                    Kan Ikonyo jumange, Rwoth, kud ikuna do!

2.	Ia pido kum lem dubo dong’ atuce kpo.
    Can unego cwinya ceke, Yesu lara do!

3.	Tipo peri copo konya ku ng’ic para do.
    Etel wia yor i beng’i, Eyik rwona cu.

4.	Yesu In Ijuko cwinya sagu jumange.
    Dong’ ageno In i kendi, ng’atu mange mbe.

title: Open My Eyes
content:
1.	Yab wang’a Rwoth kara anen lembe mandha m’Inyutho ri
    Iketh ang’ei thelembene de kara aboth ni dubona.
    Cwinya bed yo i weng’i Rwoth, abed ayika niworo
    Yab wang’a do mi ira der, Tipo Maleng’.

2.	Yab itha Rwoth kara awinj dwendi m’lyero ira ngbeng’.
    Man kinde ma awinjo dwendi lembe ma swa birwinyo pet.
    Cwinya bed yo i weng’i Rwoth, abed ayika niworo.
    Yab itha do mi ira der, Tipo Maleng’.

3.	Yab dhoga do kara ayer lembanyong’a ni dhanu yu.
    Keth Lembe peri pong’ i cwinya ayer ngbeng’ ni jumange.
    Cwinya bed yo i weng’i Rwoth, abed ayika niworo.
Yab dhoga do, mi ira der, Tipo Maleng’.

title: Nearer my God to thee
content:
1.	Ceng’ni ba Munguna i ng’eti ki,
    Tek can binega re, dong’ lem moko mbe.
    Werna bibed’ asu, ceng’ni i ng’et Mungu,
    Ceng ni ba Munguna, ceng’ni beng’i ki.

                 (versi ceke dar: Ceng’ni ba Munguna, ceng’ni beng’i ki)

2.	Wothna ariri swa i ng’om ma rac,
    Piny ceke mudho kwa ayom the cana.
    Lekna bibed’ asu ceng’ni ng’et Mungu, ---

3.	Keth yo maeni nyang’ i wang’a tin.
    Gin kpo ioro ri ndhu ku kisani.
    Malaika gwela ku ceng’ni i ng’et Mungu, ---

4.	Ka cwinya maku ai, tic para thum,
    Ceng’, dwi, ku cero de rwiny i wang’a ndhu.
    Weja bibed’ asu, ceng’ni i ng’et Mungu, ---

title: Holy Spirit Faithful
content:
1.	Tipo Mungu tel wiwa, In m’lkonyo dhanu nja.
    Peiwa yo yo ku cingwa, wa juwoth i ng’om ma ngbeng’.
    Ju m’uvoc gifoyo dit ka giwinjo dwendi mit,
    “M’umung’ kwe kwe, jawoth bin! Luba, abikobo in.”

2.	Jarimbwa m’i ber mandha In m’lkonyo dhanu nja.
    Kud Iwek cwinywa bed mbwang’ ka wawira swa i ng orn’m.
    Won abidhe sendowa, cwinywa voc ma geno jwik.
    “Dong’ imung’ yo, jawoth bin! Luba, abikobo in.”

3.	Ka tic mwa bedhingo thum, wabekuro yom ma nja.
    Gin m’udong’ ndhu genogen ma wageno kwo mandha.
    Ka wakadhu yo mi tho, wan wajengra kum Jalar.
    “Dong’ imung’ yo, jawoth bin! Luba, abikobo in.”

title: Walking in the King’s Highway
content:
1.	Yesu Kristu wacu Ebitelo yo, Ebeyiko kabedo 
    Kara wa julubne Ebigonjowa, kuca i kabedo mwa.

                 Yesu, abilubo toke ndhu, En e wang’ayo mi kwo. 
                 Abiwotho ndhu atira, kud akier i yo abilubo toke cu.

2.	 Kuca mal’ i polo en e ka ma ber, in iyenyo cidho de? 
     Dong’ iai kawono bin ilok cwinyi, irony bedopwe pare.

3.	 Lem mi ng’om de dupa bidebidhoi, ibisendri dit i yo. 
     Dong’ inen ba Yesu, Ebikuroi, ibivoyo abidhe.

title: More Love to Thee
content:
1.	Yesu, Imara dit, keth ameri. Winj, aberwo iri,
    In i Yesu. Apenjoi kumae keth ameri mandha,
    ::Keth ameri:: (dar versi ceke kumeno)

2.	Yang’ con amaru gin mi ng’om ceke, 
    Meni aweke kpo kar’ ameri.
    Imara dit ma swa, keth ameri mandha, —

3.	Ka can bisenda dit ku lem mi tho, 
    Gin ma Ioro ri, akwero ngo.
    Konya awer asu, keth ameri mandha, —

4.	Ceng’ moko abitho m’aweco ngo, 
    Lembe m’ayeroni bed ndhu kumae,
    In ma Ilara ri, keth ameri mandha, —

title: Bed i bang’a In i Rwoth Munguna
content:
1.	Bed i bang’a In i Rwoth Munguna, 
    Ka ceng’ umwony e piny uyutho bi.
    Ka jukony mange mbe, jajuk de mbe, 
    In i jajuk ma cu, bed i bang’a.

2.	I saa ma kwo mi kum mae bithum, 
    Yungri mi ng’om ku dwong’ne bikadhu.
    Lokri ma swa mi ng’om ku nyothne de, 
    In ma Ilokri ngo bed i bang’a.

3.	Rwoth bed i bang’a ku ba ceng’ ceke, 
    Mi ira tego, acir abdhe.
    I jatel wia kara awoth pwe, 
    Dieceng’ ku diewor Rwoth bed i bang’a.

4.	Rupiny biwok, dhanu ceke bicer, 
    Anyong’a nuti i polo ma ber.
    Der peri rieny, mudho ceke bithum, 
    I kwo, i tho, Mungu, bed i bang’a.

title: Jesus Saviour Pilot Me
content:
1.	Jalar Yesu tel wia, kum ang’eyo yoje ngo.
    Won abidhe nuti ndhu, en e riek, ewonda du.
    In i Yesu Kristu Rwoth tek alubi abiboth.

2.	In Ing’eyo juka In, nwang’u cwinya dieng’ ku can.
    Nam ku yamu cungo ti, man wavuvu bedo si.
    In Ing’eyo telo wic, In i Mungu ma Rucwic.

3.	In i Rwoth mi kwo ku tho keth’ Icopo juka yo.
    Man i ceng’ ma kuma voc, Ibinyutho ira yo.
    Ibilwong’a k’i polo, “Kud ilwor, Anuti do.”

title: Thy Holy Spirit
content:
1.	Ndhu Tipo peri kende, Rwoth, m’Ecopo loko cwiny.
    E tego peri kende Rwoth belwokowa ma leng’.

                 In Tipo mi yic, mi mer, tim tic i kindwa do.
                 Idwok adundewa dok leng’ tin romwa ku tegoni.

2.	 Ndhu Tipo peri kende, Rwoth, binyayu mer iwa,
     Man Tipo peri calu mac, Eyepo cwinywa pet.

3.	 Ndhu Tipo peri kende, Rwoth, bikonyowa i tic,
     E dwande copo jukowa, Ekabu pidoic.

4.	 Ndhu Tipo peri kende, Rwoth, m’Emio beroni,
     Ka wabekuro Tiponi, romwa, dwok iwa leng’.

title: Revive Thy Work
content:
1.	Yep cwinywa Rwoth Jalar, wakuro dwendi ling’.
    Ng’ol iwa gin m’lyenyo ri, wayenyo wawoth leng’.

            Yep cwinywa, Rwoth Jalar, keth tic utimbre ber.
            Wek Tipo peri romwa kpo, miwa mugisa do.

2.	 Yep cwinywa Rwoth Jalar, yung nyingi edok dwong’.
     Rom cwinywa kpo ku lem mi mer, wang’ iwa li ve mac.

3.	 Yep cwinywa Rwoth Jalar, nyuth lembe peri ngbeng’.
     Keth thelembe ma ng’eyo tek, ung’eire iwa ber.

4.	 Yep cwinywa Rwoth Jalar, ku Tiponi ma leng’.
     lcer k’i tho wayere cu, wa jumulembene.

title: All for Jesus
content:
1.	Kpo bed iri In i Yesu tegona m’lwaru ri,
    Tic ku pidoia bende, nindo para ku saa de.
    ::Kpo bed iri In i Yesu, nindo para ku saa de::

2.	 Keth cinga tim tic m’lnyutho, Iketh tienda de ring pio.
     Wek wang’a nen In i kendi, man keth leba de peki.
     ::Kpo bed iri In i Yesu, keth leba bed upeki::

3.	 Por ma wang’a tal i beng’i gin kpo rwinyo i wang’a.
     Dwong’ peri de wok i cwinya m’aneno ram juguri.
     ::Kpo bed iri In i Yesu m’aneno ram juguri::

4.	 Ei ia wang’ li i kumi, In m’lbimo rwodhi kpo.
     Idwok ndhu ni jamerni, Iketh ayom the bombi.
     ::Kpo bed iri In i Yesu, Iketh ayom the bombi::

title: I Need Thee Every Hour
content:
1.	Cor ceng’ni bang’a Rwoth, kwi cwinya, dwoka mol,
    Kum tegona thum kot, a ng’ic e kuma ol.

             Bed ceng’ni, kud iweka, tego peri tieka.
             Konj bero peri roma, Rwoth para Yesu.

2.	 Bed ceng’ni bang’a Rwoth, jabidhe senda dit.
     Dwok ter mi cwinya yot, juka ku dwal ma mit.

3.	 Ling curna, Jajukna, Ing’eyo ndiba mwa,
     Ku pidoic mi ng’om, man tho m’usendowa.

4.	 A ng’eca peri Rwoth, amira iri dho.
     Keth rimbi lwoka cu ku pidoia kpo.

title: Search me, O God
content:
1.	Mungu yeny yor i cwinya kpo, nyuth ira gin ma rac.
    Tek an akier i weng’i Rwoth, konya atuce kpo.

2.	Keth der uwok i ka ma col, wek adag dubona.
    Keth giramung’a ceke de nyuthre ngbeng’ ira do.

3.	Yeny pidoia ceke de ka ma lemdubo wok.
    Kum In Idagu dubo dit, konya adage de.

4.	Yeny cil ma weng’i ma ve mac uketh’ der rom ia.
    Man tek der peri nyutho kier ayi aweke kpo.

5.	Tel wia i yo peri cu cil ma kwo para thum.
    Clì ma atundo i polo, arum the tiendi Rwoth.

title: Lord, Dismiss Us
content:
1.	Jalar wawinjo Lembe peri, kawono wabeyenyo dok
    Konywa wacidh ku pido piri, ku lembe ma Iweco ri.
    Watim tic iri kum wameri, wek wabed jumaleng’ mandha.

2.	Wafoyi Rwoth mwa Yesu Kristu, m’umio mugisa iwa.
    Wafoyi de kum Lembe peri ma en e thala ni yo mwa.
    Wabed jumandha i tic ceke, waruk lem ponji peri cu.

3.	Man ka Jalar mwa Yesu Kristu bilwong’owa i ka maleng’
    Wabed ayika waromb kude, anyong’a pong’ kum wawore
    Man nja ku nja de wapak Yesu, wan waku juwadwa mae.

title: Saviour like a Shepherd
content:
1.	Jakwac mwa ma Rwoth mi bero ceke
    Gwok rombeni ku ba ceng’.
    Mi cemo ni rombe peri ceke, miwa kwen ma nja ku nja.
    ::Jalar Yesu, Jalar Yesu, gwokwa rombe peri do!::

2.	Masendi ni bang’wa nindo ceke
    Wan wa ng’ic waromo ngo.
    Abidhe pa Jok de nuti bang’wa gwokwa yo ku beroni
    :: Jalar Yesu, Jalar Yesu, dong’ iwinj warwo iri::

3.	Nindo ceke bed i bang’wa Yesu, kony wacung i tegoni,
    Wan walubi calku yeny m’lyenyo man wayungi ku ba
ceng’.
    :: Jalar Yesu, Jalar Yesu, bed i bang’wa ku ba ceng’

title: Is My Name Written There?
content:
1.	An ayenyona lonyo ku jupiny dit ungo,
    An ayeny’ amond i polo ba Yesu Kristu.
    I kitabu pa Mungu, e kitabu mi kwo,
    Ko iyer ira Yesu, nyo Igoro nyinga?

            Nyo Igoro nyinga i kitabu mi kwo?
            I kitabu ma peri, nyo Igoro nyinga?

2.	Dubo para gi dupa calu kwio dhu nam,
    Ento rimo Jalarna uberucogi kpo.
    Lembe peri m’ukieure en e lembe mandha,
    Kadok dubo gi kwar ngbo, Ebilwokogi kpo.

3.	Pacu pare i polo, en e leng’ njwa mandha,
    Ju m’ubedo i ie kendo kendi ma tar.
    Dubo ceke mbe kuca man ke lem tho de mbe,
    Ka ma Yesu ni ie, nyo jugoro nyinga?

title: Nothing but the Blood
content:
1.	Ang’o lwoko cwinya kpo? Rimo Jalar Yesu kende.
    Ang’o keyo cwinya ndhu? Rimo Jalar Yesu kende.
    (Ku ba versi ceke: “Rimo Jalar Yesu kende”)

                Rimo Jalar m’ucwir m’ulwoko ia ceke.
                Mana gin mange mbe, rimo Jalar Yesu kende.

2.	Gin m’ulwoko cwinya pet, —
    Mungu e Jakisa dit, —

3.	 Cul m’Eculo pira kpo, —
     Berocwinya bodha ngo, —

4.	 Ang’o dwoka doko leng’? —
     Cwinya geno polo tin, kum rimb Jalar Yesu kende.

title: Are You Washed?
content:
1.	In iwok ba Yesu kara Elwoki?
    En Elwoki ku rimbe m’ucwir?
    Nindo nini in igeno berone?
    En Elwoki ku rimbe m’ucwir?
    (versi 2, 3 wer kumae: “En Elwoki ku rimbe m’ucwir?”)

                 Elwoki ku rimo? En Elwoki ku rimbe m’ucwir?
                 Cwinyi bedo leng’ ma sagu vulo kpo?
                 En Elwoki ku rimbe m’ucwir?

2.	In iwotho ku ba ceng’ ing’et Jalar? ---
    In ijengri ru kor Yesu Kristu Rwoth? ---

3.	Ceng’ ma Yesu dwogo, Ebinweng’i leng’? ---
    Ii doko tar ni kum rimb Jalarni? —

4.	Gin m’uwilo wii i kume, baye cen,
    Kar’ Elwoki ku rimbe m’ucwir.
    Koc ku dubo ceke woth i bedopwe,
    Kum elwoki ku rimbe m’ucwir.

title: Weeping Will Not Save
content:
1.	An amaru Mungu! 
    En ukungu mer mandha,
    Yesu bino yenyowa 
    Man Etho nilaruwa,
    Wa judubo ceke.

                  An a nyathin pa Mungu, 
                  Asikari pa Yesu.
                  Abiworo cik pare, 
                  Tegone bikonya.

2.	 An amaru Yesu! 
     Kum Emio kwo iwa,
     Kan Etho wi Golgotha, 
     Man Ebino ribowa,
    E jarimo mandha.

3.	 Jajuk para nuti, 
     Ayenyo Eroma de,
     E Japonji pare de,
     Etuco thelembene
     Mi lembe pa Mungu.

4.	 Ava gin m’unega, 
     Woth ma yor i polo re,
     Kaka dhanu mandhandha, 
     Wabitimo tic ma leng’
     Nja ku nja k’anyong’a.

title: The Cleansing Stream
content:
1.	Rimo m’akira pire wok bang’a m’a jadubo,
    Ya tek julwoka kude ngo dubna birucre ngo.

                 ::Elonyowa:: rimb Yesu cwir nilonyowa.
                 Wafoi Jalar mwa Yesu kum Elonyowa ma nja ku nja.

2.	 Awotho ngọ i mudho tin, kum Yesu der mi ng’om.
     Etelo wia ku ba ceng’ alubo toke ndhu.

3.	 Ia wang’ li kum berone m’uketh Etho piwa,
     Rwoth Yesu kende m’uromo niyeyo dubo mwa.

title: Egyptian Melody
content:
1.	Yesu Kristu En e yo, kajik yoje kamaleng’.
    Tek wakwanyu yoje dre wabitundo i bang’e.

                 ::Yesu Rwoth, Jalar mwa,
                 Wabifoye nja ku nja::

2.	 Yesu En e lemandha, En Edagu lem mi ndra
     Man e kwo ma nja ku nja terowa ndhu ba Wegwa.

3.	 Yesu En e kwen mi kwo kec binegowa de ngọ.
     Bed Imi kwen iwa do, kwen m’uai ndhu i polo.

4.	 Yesu En e der mi ng’om, der m’umio iwa kwo.
     Woth mi mudho rwinyo jo der pare benyutho yo.

title: Come to the Saviour
content:
1.	Yesu belwong’i bin bang’e tho, 
    Lem pare nyutho e yo mi kwo. 
    Ken’ i kindwa Ecungo tin, Ewacu, ‘Dong’ ibin.”

                 Wabinene kud anyong’a kwa
                 Ku juwadwa ma gicokri lwar.
                 Gidoko tar ma dubo de mbe rimb Yesu Iwokogi.

2.	 Wuwek nyithindho bin ba Jalar,
     Kum ker mi polo migi mandha.
     Elwong’ogi ku cwinye ma ber, “Kud wugal ki Wubin”

3.	 Par pire cu, Elwong’i asu,
     Man Ebijoli, bin bang’e pio.
     Wek dubo peri, lub tok Jalar En Ebinyoli nyen.

title: I am Coming
content:
1.	Dwand Rwodha mit ira m’ulwong’a bin bang’e
    Bilwoko ia ku rimbe, m’ucwir wi Kalvari.

                 ::Abebino Rwoth:: Ko Ilwok ia
                 Edok leng’, ku rimoni m’ucwir.

2.	 Kadok abedo ng’ic, mi ira tegoni.
     Lony gondrina ku rimoni, e poyone bithum.

3.	 Abino Yesu Rwoth, Iketh ageni ndhu.
     Ikwio cwinya cungo ti, dwok yioyicna cu.

4.	 Afoyo rimb Yesu, afoyo berone.
     Afoyo Rwoth Yesu Kristu, ku tegone ceke.

title: I am Coming to the Cross
content:
1.	An awok ba Kalvari, a jacan e kuma ng’ic.
    An ayenyo kwo ma nja, kum Iyeyo dubona.

                 Rwoth ageno beroni, kum Itho pi dubona.
                 Rimbi cwir nilonyo jo, lara Yesu lara do.

2.	 Dubo bimo tipona, nindo lwar awotho swa.
     Yesu weco yo ira, “Abibodhi ku rimba.”

3.	 Dong’ amira gira bo, an adoko peri ndhu.
     Kuma dho ku pinyna kpo an amio iri do.
english_name: I am Coming to the Cross

title: Just as I am
content:
1.	Ku rambana m’anuti ko, ageno rimoni m’ucwir.
    Ilwong’a In abin beng’i e Jalarna ::awok::

2.	Ku rambana agalu ngo nituco dubo m’i cwinya.
    Rimbi ulwoko dubna kpo e Jalarna ::awok::

3.	 Ku rambana, jacan eni, kab dubona, kwi cwinya de.
     Gin kpo ayenyo i beng’i e Jalarna ::awok::

4.	 Ku rambana, Ikwera ngo, Ijoloa, Ilwok’ ia.
     Lembe m’Ing’olo an ajolo e Jalarna ::awok::

5.	Ku rambana, merni ma dhe ukabu gin m’ucera ndhu.
    A peri In i kendi Rwoth, e Jalarna ::awok::

title: Wonderful Words of Life
content:
1.	Were kendo, e mit ira, Lembe ma dwong’ mi kwo!
    Yesu Kristu wok i bang’a, Lembe ma dwong’ mi kwo!
    Nwang’a swa i yamba, Lembene ugwela.

                (versi 2 kud 3, kumeno: “Lembe ma dwong’ mi kwo!”)
                ::Anyong’a kwa, lembe mandha,
                Lembe ma dwong’ mi kwo::

2.	 Yung Jalar kum Emiowa ---
     Kisa nege pi ju ma swa, ---
     Tek watuco dubo, En Ecopo ruco.

3.	 Keth ewinjre ni dhanu pet, ---
     Watund kugi i polo de, ---
     Wanen ba Jalar mwa, wapak nying Jalar mwa.

title: Only Trust Him
content:
1.	::Bin dhanu yu:: Wurwinyo dit andha.
    Jalar mu de belwong’owu winj dwand Jalar mu tin.

                 ::Bin ba Yesu:: Ebelwong’owu.
                 ::Bin ba Yesu:: Ebilaruwu.

2.	 Kum rimb Jalar yang’ con uoi nibodho dhanu yu,
     Tuc dubo mu m’ucidowu, rimbe bilwokowu.

3.	 Ewacu “An a lemandha, ku kwo, ku wang’ayo.”
     Kwany yoje ndhu m’igalu ngo, e ibinwang’u kwo.

4.	 Bin mond i kind Jukristo do m’ulubo bedopwe.
     Wakudu karacelo wabitundo ka maleng’.

title: Look to the Lamb
content:
1.	Tek in iyenyo inwang’ kwo ma nja, nen Rombo pa Mungu.
    Ndhu Yesu kende mio both mandha,
    Nen Rombo pa Mungu.

                 (versi 2 kud 3 wer “Nen Rombo pa Mungu”)

                Nen Rombo pa Mungu, rimbe ucwir piwa.
                Ecopo bodhowa En e kende, nen Rombo pa Mungu.

2.	 Bed kud anyong’a Yesu meri dit, ---
     Tin Ebilwoki ku rimbe m’ucwir, ---

3.	 Lok cwinyi tin, gen peri Yesu Rwoth, ---
     Yio Rwoth Yesu mio iwa kwo, ---

4.	 Ceng’ ma watundo malu ka maleng’, Yesu binen iwa,
     Man Ebidoko Rwoth ni dhanu pet, kerne bibedo nja.

title: St. Cuthbert
content:
1.	Kum Mungu maru ng’om mumbe Emio Yesu Wod.
    Tek ng’atu moko yie ndhu ebedo kwo.

2.	 Jupadu thenge mire ma! Lau dhoggi cide dit,
     Ukudho cobo wie de, wi Kalvari.

3.	 Ecer m’Eai kendo k’i liel, wuduny pire i ng’om,
     Ka mir ang’o ke cwinywa miel, nilworo tho!

4.	 Juting’e malu ka Jajuk uloro ndhu ve mac
     M’e jatel yo, Japonji de, Ejukowa.

5.	 Jalar bidowgo kendo ba, Emung’o iwa ngo,
     Ya Ebidwogo jolowa i polo nja.

title: Ring the
content:
1.	Tin mutoro nuti jubewero wer
    Kum jadubo dwogo ndhu ba won.
    Nen eai k’i langa nwang’u tiende kier,
    Won uringo gwaku ng’ute ndhu.


                Anyong’a n’i wang’ malaika de
                Kum jadubo loko cwinye tin.
                Maku jumange de giyi Rwoth Yesu
                Ebilwokogi ku rimbe ndhu.

2.	 Tin mutoro nuti jubicam’ agba,
     Wodwa meni kwo ma nwang’ etho.
     Piny edhenyo ceke, dubo voye ma!
     En etuco ma eweko kpo.

3.	 Tin mutoro nuti wabifoyo dwong’
     Kum jadubo dwogo tin ba Won.
     Korikori bongu wile ku ma nyen,
     Dong’ juronye tin ku bedopwe.

title: At the Cross
content:
1.	Lewic binega tak de ngo ni kum Rwodha Yesu.
    Apid pi tho m’Etho kor yen awor Lem pare ndhu.

                Kuca the yen m’athara aneno der ma dit,
                Ter ma pek m’unuro cwinya de ai.
                Ni kum yioyic wang’a yabre ndhu,
                Kawono mutoro para pong’.

2.	 Yesu e Mungu ku kite ageno nyinge ndhu.
     Aneno lewic tak de ngo ni kum ageno En.

3.	 Komker pa Yesu cungo tek ku lem m’Eng’olo de.
     Amira bo i cinge do cil m’abinene ko.

4.	 Ceng’ nica Ebikwera ngo wang’ komker pa Wegwa.
     I ng’om ma nyen m’Eyiko cu amond’ i yom ma nja.

title: All Taken Away
content:
1.	Nyo iwinjo gin m’Eyerona? “Yesu kabu dubna woko,
    Ya dubna Eweko, agonjra, Yesu kabugi kpo.”

                 :::E Yesu kabu dubna kpo:::
                 Yesu kabu dubna woko.

2.	 Berone ma dwong’ En Emio swa, Yesu kabu dubna woko.
     Kadok dubna kwar Edwoke tar, Yesu kabu dubna.

3.	 An apondo the rimone m’ucwir. Yesu kabu dubna woko.
     Man ia lony ni kum yioyic, Yesu kabu dubna.

4.	 Kawono Tipo benyutho ira Yesu kabu dubna woko.
     Eketho abedo agonya, Yesu kabu dubna.

5.	 Afoyo Rwoth kum Eweko dubna, Yesu kabu dubna woko.
     Kan abekukuni i yoje kwe, Yesu kabu dubna.

title: Precious Blood
content:
1.	Rimo Yesu Kristu kende yang’ m’udaru cwir,
    Ni judubo mi ng’om ceke, ecwir piri.

                 Rimo Yesu Kristu kende, yang’ m’udaru cwir,
                 Dong’ iyie, dong’ ijole, ecwir piri.

2.	 Rimo Yesu Kristu kende, dong’ elwok ii,
     Cwinyi, ng’eyong’ec, ku kumi, Tipo romi.

3.	 Kadok dubo peri dupa sagu ceke ngi,
     Tek igeno rimo Yesu, Elwoko ii.

4.	 Ni kum rimone maeni ecopre iwa,
     Wan wamond’ i polo bang’e, wanen Yesu.

title: Alas and did my Savior
content:
1.	Rimb Jalarna yang’ con ucwir, Jalarna tho kor yen?
    Emio kwo ma pire tek, ma an de arem ma gwei?

2.	 Ecur wi got ma Golgotha ni kum dubo mwa rac dit?
     E ngisi nege, bero de, ku mer ma porne mbe.

3.	 Ceng’ kandre dre, mudho yutho bi, dwong’ne de kud unen
     Ceng’ ma Jacwic ma dwong’ utho pi giracwia mi ng’om yu.

4.	 Piwang’a copo culo ngo an ma jabanja dit.
     E Rwoth amira gira bo gin mange de romo ngo.

title: Christ receiveth sinful men
content:
1.	Tek iweko yo ma pwe man ipodh’ i dubo de,
    Kud imung’ ituce be, Ebiweko dubone.

                Were ken… do ira do, Yesu jo... lo dhanu kpo.
                Yere ngbeng’ ewinjre cu, Yesu jolo judubo.

2.	 Bin ku tic m’imuli ko, man ku ter m’unuri kpo.
     Bin e ibinwang’u yom, ponji pare ber mandha.

3.	 Tek atuco dubona, En e pwe, man e mandha.
     Ceke Ebiwekona, Ebilonyo gondrina.

4.	 Yesu jola ber mandha, man Eruco dubona.
     Rimbe Iwoka dwoka leng’, kar’ abed i polo nja.

title: Would You Be Free?
content:
1.	Iyenyo dit ya juwek duboni?
    Juweko ni kum rimb Yesu Rwoth.
    Iyenyo dit ya iloi lem ma rac? Iloye ni kum rimb Jalar.

                 Tego nuti, tego nuti dit ni kum rimo pa Jalar.
                 Tego nuti, tego nuti dit, i rimb Nyathi Rombo Jalar.

2.	 Iyenyo dit kud itingri i ng’om?
     Icopo jwigri kum rimb Yesu.
     Bin ba Kalvari man Ebilwoki ka ma rimb Jalar Yesu cwir.

3.	 Iyenyo dit ibed tar sagu pei?
     Julwoki ni kum rimb Yesu Rwoth.
    Goc ma ni wiwa Eyeyo kor yen ka ma rimb Jalar Yesu cwir.

4.	 Iyenyo dit ya itim tic ni Rwoth?
     Inwang’ tegocwiny kum rimbe cwir?
     Iyenyo dit ya ipake ku wer ni kum tho m’Etho ko kor yen?

title: I am Praying for You
content:
1.	Jalarna nuti Erwo pira i polo,
    Emara ma ber sagu dhanu mi ng’om.
    Eneno i bang’a ku ngisi ma dit pare,
    Arwo piri dit Jalarna bodhi de.

                 ::Arwo ni Rwoth piri,::
                 Arwo ni Rwoth Yesu Kristu dit piri.

2.	 Vwa bende nuti m’Edaru mio ira
     Genogen mi nja man kwo ma thum ungo.
     Fodi Ebilwong’a abicidho i bang’e,
     Ber dit tek wacidho i polo kudi.

3.	 Kendi de nuti ma tar pu, ma leng’ sagu
     Ma Mungu bimia, akende kuca.
     Man tek akende birieny ma ber dit i wang’a.
     Ber tek iyikri inwang’ kendi bende.

4.	 Ka Yesu bodhi yer pire de ni dhanu,
     Keth gin de giyie giboth ni kume.
     Man kinde m’iyero irwo ba Yesu pigi,
     Rwo peri biwinjre ma ber ba Mungu.

title: What Did He Do?
content:
1.	E! winj lembe ma wabeyero, lem ma con juwinjo ngo.
    Yesu weko dwong’ne i polo, kar’ Ebin Elar ko jo.

                 Ng’a laruwa k’i can ma nja?
                 Wod Mungu wi yen m’athara.
                 Etim ang’o? Etho piwa. Anege ke?
                 Dong’ wun wuyi, e n’i polo Erwo piwa.

2.	 Kadok malaika m’i polo copo tho kakawa ngo.
     Jamer ma Mungu de jukuno, kor yen ma wi Kalvari.

3.	Lembene fodi jubeyero m’ubewang’u ijo li.
    Kuca i polo Rwoth bekwayu piwa m’e jalam mi nja.

4.	 Dong’ wumiru ni Jalar Yesu man warum the tiende tin.
     Wun de wubinwang’u mugisa, Ebilaruwa de tin.

title: Only Believe
content:
1.	Dong’ ku walwor ki, Esendre piwa,
    Eai kud i tho, Emondo i kwo.
    Tego kpo mi ng’om; ku mi polo de,
    Umire ire, ni ndul ma pare.

               ::Yie kende, yie kende, 
               gin ceke coprene yie kende::

2.	 Dong’ ku walwor ki, Etelo wiwa,
     Jakwac mwa Enyutho yo ma wakwany.
    Pi mwa ma kec de, Ebidwoko mit,
    Emadhu ma kec pet i Gethsemane.

3.	 Dong’ ku walwor ki, tek cwinywa dieng’ hai,
     Ekunowa ngo, Eni bang’wa nja.
     Diewor ku dieceng’, e ceke acel,
     Eng’eyo cwinywa, kadok lembamung’a

title: Since I Have Been
content:
1.	Wer nuti m’awer ni Jalar ugambre ceng’ m’aboth.
    Jamer ma Yesu Jalarna ugambre ceng’ m’aboth.

                ::Ugambre ceng’ m’aboth:: abilula ku nyinge.
                Ugambre ceng’ m’aboth, abilula ku nying’ Jalarna.

2.	 Jalar ukwio cwinya lwe, ugambre ceng’ m’aboth.
     Afoyo kayeny mi cwinye, ugambre ceng’ m’aboth.

3.	 Atuco lembe pare ndhu, ugambre ceng’ m’aboth.
     Lembe ma jiji rwinyo kpo, ugambre ceng’ m’aboth.

4.	 Kabedona juyiko cu, ugambre ceng’ m’aboth.
     Abedo kuca nja ku nja, ugambre ceng’ m’both.

title: In Tenderness He Sought Me
content:
1.	Ku cwiny ma mol Eyenya ka dubo voya ma!
    Ebiela de wi goke, Ekela ndhu i dwol.
    Malaika de giwero wer ram werne romo polo gbur.

                 Mer ma dit m’uyenya, rimone m’ung’iewa.
                 Bero pare kela ndhu i dwol,
                 Bero dwong’ m’ukela ndhu i dwol.

2.	 Elwoko rem mi dubo, Ewire ndhu ku mo,
     Enwang’a kan arwinyo, Evonj i bang’a mwa.
     E dwal ma mit va pare mbe Eketho cwinya kwio lwe.

3.	 Enyutho poyo gute, e rimbe cwir de le,
     Jamker ma mir ukudho, juroi i wie de.
     Enen’ ang’o i ia e m’Esendre ko kumeno e?

4.	 Abedo ndhu i vute, derne ucara cwe,
     Kinde m’aneno wang’e afoyo kisane.
     A rem nipeki Munguna, kadok apeki nja ku nja.

5.	 Ka nindona bekadhu, e cwinya kwio ndhu,
     Akuro piny m’uru ma bisagu wagi yu.
     Ka wa juyic, mugolene, wabed i ng’ete ka maleng’.

title: Blessed be the Fountain
content:
1.	An afoyo rimo Jalar m’ucwir con pi dhanu mi ng’om.
    Dubona m’ubedo kwar ngbo, rimone udwoke tar pu.
    Con acayu lem peri ceke, man masendi nyayu can mumbe,
    En Elwoko kier para cen man Edwoka tar sagu pei.

                ::Tar ma sagu pei:: rimoni bidwoka tar pu,
                Edwoka tar ma sagu pei.

2.	 Yesu yeyo kier para kpo, yen m’athara nure mandha.
     Lak ukudho cobe de lith, an acangu kum goc pare dit.
     Dong’ atuco kier para ceke, an ayio Yesu ma Jalar.
     Elwoko kier para cen man Edwoka tar sagu pei.

3.	 Vwa, akier mandha con i lum kum akwanyu yo para an.
     In Ijuko yamu ku nam, bed Ibim wi adundena.
     Tek awoth’ atira alubi, abilula ku kuhaya rac.
     Jwiga Yesu the rimoni, Ebidwoka tar sagu pei.

title: Since Jesus Came
content:
1.	An aol ku lem dubo ayeny’ adok leng’,
    Ajoli i cwinya Jalar.
    Awek lembe ma con dong’ akwany yo ma nyen,
    Ajoli i cwinya Jalar.

                   (versi 2, 3 kud 4, wer: Ajoli i cwinya Jalar)

                   ::Ajoli i cwinya Jalar:: kum Inyayu anyong’a
                   Afoyo mandha, ajoli i cwinya Jalar.

2.	 Dong’ awotho ngo swa kum Itelo wia, ---
     Cilo ai yweire cen cwinya lonjre mandha, ---

3.	 Lem ma jiji de mbe wang’a lero ku der, ---
     Piny ulero de her keth’ awoth i derne, ---

4.	 Dong’ awinjo pi polo kabedo ma ber, ---
     An aneno Rwoth Yesu m’Edoko won ker, ---

5.	 Dong’ aloyo abidhe ku dubo mi ng’om, Abedo ku Yesu Jalar.
     Ku ba ceng’ Ebekonya kum tegone dwong’, 
     Abedo ku Yesu Jalar.

title: Abundant Life
content:
1.	The ter mi dubo ku pidocwiny dhanu moko cur acura.
    Gicopo bedo kud anyong’a tek ginwang’u kwo ma rondo.

                :::Kwo::: ma mi nja, Yesu e kende jamicne.
                :::Kwo::: m’usagre, dwong’ ubed ire mi rondo.

2.	 I ng’atu ma dubo benuri ku can ma kwonde tung’ tung’ de.
     Lok cwinyi kawono man ijol kwo m’usagre i Rwoth Yesu.

3.	 A, pi tego pa Tipo Maleng’! A, pi yepocwiny m’apila!
     A, pir udul de m’umbe lworo, ayikra pi bino pare.

title: The Great Physician
content:
1.	Rwoth Yesu yenyo jumandha, Jukristu ma giwore.
    Ma cwinygi kpo ubedo tar, m’uripo ku pa Yesu.

                Ameri Yesu In ma Rwoth, ora e abicidho yot.
                Abituco lem mi both, Yesu ma Jakisa.

2.	 Rwoth Yesu yenyo jumandha niponjo Lembe pare.
     Ni ju m’urwinyo, ma Jalar usendre pigi bende.

3.	 Rwoth Yesu yenyo jumandha ma copo voyo dubo.
     Wa der mi ng’om, wapondo ngo, wawotho ngo i mudho.

4.	 Rwoth Yesu yenyo jumandha nikwayu rombe pare.
     Wating’ nyithindo migi de, wadwokgi de i dwonde.

title: When Morning Comes
content:
1.	Lem ma tek ubidhowa wa Jukristu ma ni ng’om,
    Can ma pek unurowa, lembe dupa sendowa.
    Wang’wa neno ber ungo, wang’wa umbre kud utor,
    Gibilero ka wacokra bang’e nja.

                  Ceng’ mange wabing’eyo cu, ka wacokra malu i polo.
                  Wabiwero wer kud anyong’a mandha,
                  Nwang’u lembe ceke wok kakare cu.

2.	 Kec unegowa i ng’om, tic de jonyo kumwa dwong’.
     Ng’om uti unyayu doi, piny mwa ceke de belui
     Kwaruwa gicayu cik ketho Mungu lamugi,
     Ebithum ceng’ ma wacokra bang’e nja.

3.	 Tho ma negowa i ng’om, ceng’ mange dong’ ebithum.
     Ceng’ ma Rwoth ugamuwa, wabed bang’e nja ku nja.
     Ju ma gibidong’ i ng’om gibinwang’u can ma dwong’.
     Wabineno ka wacokra bang’e nja.

title: Where He Leads Me
content:
1.	 :::Lem pa Yesu abiyio::: Abiyio lembe pa Yesu.

                    :::Yo m’Etelo abilube::: Abilubo ng’ei Yesu Kristu.

2.	 :::Ka can nuti abikwaye::: Abikwayu ru Yesu Kristu.

3.	 :::Lem m’Eyero abiwinjo::: Abiwinjo lembe pa Yesu.

4.	 :::Tic m’Emio abitimo::: Abitimo ni Yesu Kristu.

5.	 :::Ka tho senda abigene::: Abigeno ru Yesu Kristu.

title: Heavenly Sunlight
content:
1.	Walub tok Yesu kum En e der mwa, 
    Lworo mi mudho sendowa ngo. 
    Ka Yesu cidho Eng’olo iwa, 
    “Anuti kudu, cil nja ku nja.”

                ::Der mi polo:: Derne berieny tin yor i cwinya.
                Haleluya, anyong’a nega, afoyo Yesu e Jalarna.

2.	 Mudho betieka, ecido wang’a, 
     Ecopo geng’o wang’ Yesu ngo.
     Yesu e der mwa. Embe ku mudho, 
     Alubo toke, arwinyo ngo.

3.	 Jumoko rwinyo i yo mi mudho, 
     Ento kajikne longro ma lieng’.
     Kuca giywak dit, ku kayulak kwa, 
     Ka mi masendi ma nja ku nja.

4.	 Wawoth asu ku Yesu ma der mwa 
     Ma watund ko i Kabedo mwa.
     Mutoro negwa, wapak Jalar mwa, 
     Kum der m’uvoyo dubo mi ng’om.

title: More Holiness Give Me
content:
1.	Dwok cwinywa leng’ Yesu, pidoic mwa bende 
    Miwa mwonyolembe tek wacoro cen.
    Dong’ wagen Jalar mwa, man wabed ku rwo
    Kab adieng’acwinywa bim wi kumwa dho.

2.	 Mi dwokrileng’ iwa, walub bedopwe,
     Wayenyo Iromwa ku Tipo Maleng’.
     Wath kumwa tim iri, jumiru mandha,
     Keth can de unegwa tek watimo swa.

3.	 Wang’ei yeny pa Mungu m’e yire m’e cu,
     Man kothwa de lokre, wathier kumwa dho.
     Wang’ei lembang’ola, wawore awe,
     Wabed calu Yesu, kud ayine de.

title: Am I a Soldier?
content:
1.	Nyo an a jatic pa Jalar, akendo kendine?
    Lewic unega pi Rwodha, amung’o berone?

2.	 Nyo an ageno abed nyap, jumange sendri gin?
     Juyenya e aura ve, wek gin githo i lwiny?

3.	 Jakworna Jok ku dubo de, edoko jamerna?
     Amer ku ju m’udagu Rwoth, arogo juwada?

4.	 Dong’ awek amone ma rac m’atimo ba juwada!
     Mak’ akied lwiny ku tegocwiny atho ko ng’ei Rwodha!

title: Anywhere with Jesus
content:
1.	Yo ma Yesu telo iwa bedo ber, wa jukwenda pare
    Dong’ wawore tho. Ju ma wotho kude jumutoro kwa
    Ndhu niwotho ka ma Yesu orowa.

                 Lworo mbe, cac umbe, wawinj dwand Jalar,
                 Ka ma Yesu orowa wawore ba.

2.	 Tek wawotho kude, Ebigwokowa ka jumer mwa bende 
     Kindwa koc kugi. I masendi ceke kadi ndiba de,
     Yesu nyayu foyofoc i dhogwa re.

3.	 Tek wamaru Yesu dong’ wamare cu, gin ma ie yenyo
     Dong’ watime ndhu. Lem mi ng’om bikadhu
     Kud ayungane, ento wabibedo nja ku nja bang’e.

title: Stand Up for Jesus
content:
1.	Wukuru, wubed nger de, wu jutic pa Yesu.
    Wuting’ abera pare man wulub toke cu.

                  Jadegi, wonabali, m’uyenyo rwinyo dhanu,
                  Jalar mwa Yesu loye kor yen mi Kalvari.

2.	 Wukuru, wubed nger de ku tego pa Yesu.
     Wukoc ku dubo ceke ku lem pa Jok de ndhu.

3.	 Wukuru, wubed nger de, rony jamtho pa Mungu.
     Wugut ni wonabali, e ebiringowu.

4.	 Wukuru, wubed nger de, ceng’ moko lwiny bithum,
     E Yesu won aloci bibimo dhanu yu.

title: Sound the Battle Cry
content:
1.	Kudh agwara do, dong’ wacokra kpo! Jukwojwa gitie
    I wang’wa ca! Ting’ abera mwa wakur bang’e ba!
    Yesu Jawipiro mwa mandha!

                 Bed tek, wuting’ cingwu m’uoi jeble!
                 Bek ayika, wudwok cingwu tek!
                 Cidh i weng’wu lwiny ma dit bekiedre! 
                 Yesu Jawipiro mwa mandha!

2.	 Cung atira do, wuriei cu jufwa, lem mi bedopwe 
     M’esagu kpo. Aloci ku dwong’ en  e yioyic,
     Yesu Jawipiro mwa mandha!

3.	 Man ka lwiny uthum ka wavoyogi,
     Sukulia mwa jamkermiwic,
     In i mungu mwa wabipeki nja, wabilubo Jawipiro mwa!

title: Man of Sorrows
content:
1.	Yesu loro, jolo can kar’ Elar judubo wan.
    Aka! Edoko jacan. Haleluya! E Jalarna!

    (ku ba versi ceke dar kumeno)

2.	 Dhanu yanye, caye dit, julubne de weke pet.
     Jupade, jufode lith. ---

3.  Dubo cidowa col kuu, yo maleng’ waweko yu
      Yesu re E leng’ ma njwa. ---

4.	 Kan Etho ko mire ma! Tho ku liel Ekaku dra,
     Kan Eidho ba Wegwa. ---

title: Standing on the Promises
content:
1.	Cung i lembang’ola pa Rwoth Yesu mwa,
    Dong’ ipak nying Yesu, dong’ ifoye nja.
    Lembe pare cungo en e lemandha,
    Cung i lembang’ola pa Jalar.

                 ::Gene:: Dong’ igen gin ceke ma Rwoth Yesu ng’olo,
                 ::Gene:: Gen lembang’ola pa Rwoth Yesu mwa.

2.	 Cung i lembang’ola pa Rwoth Yesu mwa,
     Lembe pare nyothre ngo, ebedo nja, 
     Man lewic binego ju m’ugene ngo, 
     Cung i lembang’ola pa Jalar.

3.	 Cung i lembang’ola pa Rwoth Yesu mwa,
     Lembe ma bigonyowa e lemandha, 
     En e lem mi kwo ni ju m’uyie de, 
     Cung i lembang’ola pa Jalar.

title: Leave it There
content:
1.	Tek imbe ku piny mi ng’om ywak unyai i dhogi dwong’,
    Kec unegi dit aka; E kendi yec. 
    Mungu gwoko winyo kpo. Cwinygi ringo rr ungo, 
    Mi masendi peri ceke ba Yesu.

                  ::Mi bang’e:: Mi masendi peri ceke ba Yesu.
                  Kan isendri, man ivoc, rwo i bang’e kud ikoc,
                  Mi masendi peri ceke ba Yesu.

2.	 Tek tho remo kumi hai, congi mbe, i ng’ic ma gwei.
     Cwinyi de udoko rac e weng’i col. 
     Dong’ i ng’ei Yesu jakei. Ebiweki ngo Etie, 
     Mi masendi peri ceke ba Yesu.

3.	 Tek judegi doti rac e gilwong’o nyingi swa,
     li pido ya juwedu weki kpo. 
     Yesu nuti i beng’i nja, cir ku tegocwiny wada, 
     Mi masendi peri ceke ba Yesu.

4.	 Tek iol, imaku ti, tego mbe m’uromo tic,
     Lwar upodh i wii, ter iyeyo ngo. 
     Mungu maru ju m’uti, bed i kore, gwake ki, 
     Mi masendi peri ceke ba Yesu.

title: Faith is the Victory
content:
1.	Jukristu wuwek lem ma sai, wameku ban mi lwiny.
    Wugalu dwong’ i lem mi ng’om wunyayu ndhu ng’ecwiny.
    Kum Yesu neno dubo mwa kadok wasomo hai,
    Aloci mwa m’uloyo ng’om e yioyic mandha.

                 ::Rwoth voyo dubo kpo::
                 Aloci m’uloyo ng’om ndhu yioyic mandha.

2.	 Wating’ jamtho pa Mungu kpo, thungu mi yioyic.
     Waroi asi mi bedopwe ku rwo, ku kwayukwac,
     Mer pare en abera mwa, ku pala pa Jalar,
     Ma lake bith ma kun ku kun ma en e lemandha.

3.	 Judegi mwa gitiekowa gilibo tego mwa.
     Athero migi kilowa, gigom kum thungu mwa.
     Waketho sabu de mi both, walutho wara de.
     Aloci mwa m’uloyo ng’om ndhu yioyic mandha.

title: Trust and Obey
content:
1.	Ka wawotho ku Rwoth mberemberene yot,
    Wothne bedo ber dit emiero. 
    Rwoth ni bang’wa awe, dong’ walub toke dre 
    Man watimu kayeny pare cu.

                Gene, wore, yo mange moko mbe,
                Ma junwang’u k’anyong’a, ndhu i lembe pare.

2.	 Paru can moko mbe, yutho wang’jo de mbe
     Ma Jalar jukowa ngo ie. 
     Cwiny ma jiji de mbe, man piwang’wa ng’oi ngo 
     Kum Jajuk nuti, wagene ndhu.

3.	 Ter ma pek nurowa kud adieng’acwiny mwa,
     Yesu wacu wabol i kore. 
     Tho m’urubowa rek, yen m’athara ma pek,
    Ju m’ugene, Eyungogi dre.

4.	 Dong’ waribra kude, dong’ wabed the tiende,
     Wabiwotho waku Yesu dre. 
     Wabitimo ire wabifoye awe,
     Kud walwor, wagene, wawore.

title: Must I Go and Empty
content:
1.	Abicidho ma cinga nanu, aci rombo ku Yesu Rwoth?
    Rundi meni mi ponjo dhanu, gin mange mak’ acor cen.

                  Wabi cungo i wang’Jalar mwa, Ebikoro i tic mwa kpo.
                 Lewic ni ju ma cing’gi nanu, an ayenyo para ngo.

2.	 An alworo ngo tho m’unega kum aboth ni kum rimb Yesu,
     Ento cidho ma cinga nanu ebedieng’o cwinya dit.

3.	 Nindo dupa ukadhu iwa ma watimo tic moko ngo.
     Mak’ wacidhu kawono nini, wayer lembe pa Yesu.

4.	 Wa Jukristu wacidhu yau yau, nindo mi timo tije tin,
     Ma wapoi ie ju m’urwinyo nyo kajik mi ng’omne tin.

title: Work for the Night
content:
1.	Tim tic ni Yesu Kristu ka fodi kumi leng’,
    Tim ire tic ku tego, tim ku ba rupiny.
    Tim ticne ku mutoro ka fodi ceng’ urieny
    Kum diewor ubino ka tic mwa bithum.

2.	 Yesu utimo tic dit kinde m’Etie i ng’om.
     Ekeyo kum jo dupa cil ma ticne thum.
     Esendre dit apila, endre Ekwero ngo,
     Ceke Etimo iwa cil tho m’Etho ko.

3.	 Yesu beneno bang’wa lem moko kandre ngo.
     Eng’eyo lem m’i iwa, ku tic m’watimo.
     Ber ka walubo toke, ku tic m’Etimo En,
     Wanyuth ko ya wamare, wafoye kudo.

title: Leaning on the Everlasting
content:
1.	Cwinywa ripo ndhu waku Yesugi
    Ka wajengra kor Jalar Yesu.
    Wan wabedo ber, pidoic umbe
    Ka wajengra kor Jalar Yesu.

                (ku ba versi ceke: Ka wajengra kor Jalar Yesu)

                ::Jengri:: Ejengo ju m’ugene cu.
                ::Jengri:: dong’ wajengra kor Jalar Yesu.

2.	 Wan wawotho ber i yo pa Jalar ---
     Yo mwa lero ber kum Yesu m’e der, ---

3.	 Wan wayeny’ ang’o wan walwor ang’o ---
     Cwinywa kwio kpo, ndiri ringo bor ---

title: Auld Lang Syne
content:
1.	Wan wabepokra ken’ i ng’om, kabedo ma tung’ tung’,
    Re, Yesu neno bang’wa nja kadok wapokra bor.

                Mer pa Yesu m’uribowa ethum ungo cil nja,
                Rwoth Yesu maruwa jufwa Ewotho kudwa ndhu.

2.	 Kadok wanendra kendo ngo kud i ng’om kakeni.
     Wang’eyo wabinen kendo ba Yesu i polo.

3.	 Tek lembe wok m’ucori cen, icidho ka mange,
     Kud iwek lem pa Mungu ki, cung tek wi yioyic.

title: Thy Word have I Hid
content:
1.	Thala m’umenyo ira yo en e Lembe pa Mungu
    M’utelo wia atira i yo m’utund’ i polo.

                 Akanu Lembe ma peri i bang’a i adundena,
                 ::Kara kud adub:: akanu Lembe ma peri.

2.	 Lem peri Rwoth, bedo mi nja ecungo m’elokre ngo.
     Eponjowa dhanu m’i ng’om bedo mandha pa Yesu.

3.	 Kugweno, dieceng’ ku diewor apaku Rwoth Mungu nja.
     Iromo pira ku ba ceng’ cil i nindona ceke.

4.	 Jubila gigoro piri i Jalar Yesu ma Rwoth.
     Ikelo both ku kwiocwiny ni ju ma girwinyo swa.

title: Why I love
content:
1.	An amaru Yesu Kristu, Yesu En e Jalarna.
    Yesu culo dubo para kuca wi got Kalvari.

               An amaru Yesu Kristu, an ayio Yesune, 
               Lembapoka Yesu culo, an ayio rimone.

2.	 An amaru Yesu Kristu, Yesu En e Jalarna,
     An a leng’ de ni kum rimbe, rimone mi Kalvari.

3.	 An amaru Yesu Kristu, Yesu En e Jarimba,
     Tin Ebedo mal’ i polo karacelo ku Wego.

4.	 An amaru Yesu Kristu, En e Won aloci kpo.
     Ceng’ mi lwiny Yesu ni bang’wa Ebiwekowa de ngo.

title: The Light of the World
content:
1.	Ng’om yu cido bi dubo nyothe mandha, 
    Re der mi ng’om yu e Yesu. 
    Emenyo yo iwa ka Jalar uwok
    Kum der mi ng’om yu e Yesu.

                 Bin ba derne Emeny iri yo. 
                 Edoko derna m’awotho ko.
                 Con an abinga dong’ wang’a kei
                 Kum der mi ng’om yu e Yesu.

2.	 Lub ng’eye e mudho bisendi ungo
     Kum der mi ng’om yu e Yesu.
     Lem pare e thala m’unyuthowa yo,
     Kum der mi ng’om yu e Yesu.

3.	 Tek cudho becwenyi isendri i yo, 
     Jol der mi ng’om yu e Yesu. 
     Rimbe copo kei tek weng’i ucor,
     Kum der mi ng’om yu e Yesu.
