4.	 I polo juywagu der mange de ngo 
     Kum Yesu e der mi polo. 
     Adhura mi mola ebedo leng’ njwa,
     Kum derne e Nyathi Rombo.

title: I know Whom I Have
content:
1.	Ang’o m’uketho Mungu nyutho ira berone m’usagre kpo?
    Kadok adubo sagu jumange e rimbe lwoko dubona.

             Ento an ang’eyo andhandha, ayio mandha ya En
             Ecopo nigwoko gin ceke ira cil i ceng’ m’Edwogo ko.

2.	 Ang’o m’uketho Mungu mio ira yic m’ayie keth aboth?
     Man tek ayio Lembe pare cu, Ekwio cwinya lwe.

3.	 Ang’o m’uketho Tipo Mungu tuco i cwinya pi dubona?
     Enyutho ira Yesu i Lem pare kar’ abed ku yioyic.

4.	 Nyo lembang’o m’ubino i wang’a, Lembe ma ber kadi ma rac?
     Ma fod’ aneno wang’ Jalarna ngo masendi kadi anyong’a?

5.	 Ang’eyo ngo nindo ma Rwoth bidwogo, i diewor kadi dieceng’,
     Nyo abikadhu tipopiny mi tho, nyo wabirombo i lietho.

title: Moment by Moment
content:
1.	Atho ku Yesu, wakude kor yen, 
    Akwo ku Yesu, kwo m’ubedo nyen, 
    Aneno Yesu cil ma derne rieny.
    Ku ba ceng’ ceke Rwoth, an a peri.

                 Ku ba ceng’ ceke Egwoka ku mer, 
                 Ku ba ceng’ ceke amaku kwone. 
                 Aneno Yesu cil ma derne rieny,
                 Ku ba ceng’ ceke Rwoth, an a peri.

2.	 Kadok jubidha, Enut’i bang’a, 
     Ter para ceke Eyeyogi En. 
     Eribre kuda i can para kpo,
     Ku ba ceng’ ceke Egwoka ndhu cu.

3.	 Ka cwinya ng’abre m’acur ko ku can, 
     Piwang’a cwir dit, aywak de mumbe. 
     Kadok abedo ku lembe ma tek
     Ku ba ceng’ ceke Eparu pira.

title: Dare to be a Daniel
content:
1.	Cung ma tek wi lemandha, yung weg bedopwe.
    Bed wor de ni Rwoth Yesu, waporu ba Daniel.

                 Bed tek calu Daniel, bed tek yor i cwiny!
                 Cung tek wi lembe mandha, iyer ni jumange.

2.	 Ju ma tek girwinyo de kum gilworo dit.
     Mungu yenyo tegocwiny walubu tok Daniel.

3.	 Jurukara dupa de ma gihairi swa,
     Gibicungo tak de ngo i wang’ju pa Mungu.

4.	 Wayer lembanyong’a kwa Mungu telo yo!
     Wakied lwiny ma tek ku Jok, walub ko tok Daniel.

title: Let the Lower Lights
content:
1.	Kisa pa Mungu benen ber kud i ot pare mi nja,
    En Eyenyo ya warieny de wameny yo ni jumange.

                 Maku ya der mwa rieny ber ba ma wanyuth kudo Yesu.
                 Kara dhanu ma ginene, giyie giboth k’i tho.

2.	 Dubo kelo mudho keni piny i ng’om ni dhanu yu.
     Dhanu dupa gibekio mac menyo wang’ayo.

3.	 Dong’ watwor mac mwa wang’ dhanu wacwal malu
     Kar’ enen, walwong’ ko ju ma girwinyo.
     Dong’ gibin ba Yesu tin.

title: The Bible Stands
content:
1.	Biblia cungo ma tek ve cana i wavuvu ma rac dit.
    Lembe pare lokre ngo cil rondo man ebemenyo iwa yo.

               Biblia cungo ka ng’om bikadhu, ebicungo tek 
               Kadok gudi podho. Abicungo ki wi 
               Lembe pa Mungu, kum elokre ngo.

2.	 Biblia cungo ve got ma wiu man esagu tic mwa kpo.
     Jusayu yo ma jucopo nyothe ento Mungu begwoke nja.

3.	 Biblia cungo cil nja ku nja de cil ma ng’om bikadhu pet, 
     Kum Mungu yuyo wi lembe ceke mak’ awor ponji pare cu.

4.	 Biblia cungo ma pore de ngo kum Jagorne Rwoth Mungu. 
     Ageno acopo wore ceke ni kum bero pa Jagorne.

title: Now I Belong to Jesus
content:
1.	Yesu Jalarna wodha k’i dubo, 
    Emara dit Etho de nibodha, 
    Ewara ndhu ku rimbe m’ucwir, 
    Adoko pare nja.

                  Adoko piny pa Yesu, Emio kwo ira.
                  Kwone e gin mi ng’om re ngo, ere ma nja ku nja.

2.	 Con kan arwinyo dubona senda,
     Meni Elwoko dubona woko.
     Lewic uai amondo i kwo, 
     Adoko pare nja.

3.	 Anyong’a nega kum Yesu lara,
     Nyoro mi ng’eca gony kud i kuma.
     Elonya ndhu ku rimbe m’ucwir, 
     Adoko pare nja.

title: Never Give Up
content:
1.	Kud iyi cwinyi uvoc ki, tek in iyio Jalar,
    Tego m’uromo tic ceke Mungu bimio iri.

                 ::Kud ivoc ki:: kwai Yesu dit ya Ejuki
                 Cil i kind can ma lic dit. 
                 ::Gen Yesu Rwoth:: Pake kind muloic ceke, 
                 Gene Ebidwoki tek.

2.	 Ceng’ moko ter ma pek nuri, anyong’a peri de thum?
     Kwai Yesu Emeny yo iri, Ekonyi keth’ iwoth cu.

3.	 Kud iyi cwinyi uvoc ki, genogen nuti iri.
     Edong’ nyanok ibimond’ i pacu pa Rwoth i polo.

title: Will Your Anchor
content:
1.	Nyo igeno ng’a ma bikonyi ber 
    Tek inwang’u can ku ruvwa ma rac? 
    Kapondo binwangre iri ba ng’a?
    Saye ndhu ba Kristu Ebikweri ngo.

                 Kapondo nuti ma romowa
                 Kadok wasendra ku lem ma rac.
                 Cana mwa ma tek e Yesu Rwoth,
                 Ebigwokowa i mer pare cu.

2.	 Mer pa Mungu twii calu thol ma tek, 
     Nyo ibedo museme i cing’ Jalar? 
     Ka Jok bino didhi igut ire?
     Tek kumeno Jok biringoi bor cen.

3.	 Wabicidh’ i polo nineno Rwoth, 
     Wabiyunge kuca ku dwal ma mit, 
     Ni kum gwok m’Egwokowa ku ba ceng’
     Man de kum Eculo banja mwa ceke.

title: Down in the Valley.
content:
1.	Cil i can para wabiwotho ku Jalar,
    En m’Eng’eyo canne mak’ Etel wia En.
    Abilubo Yesu Kristu cil i ceng’ mi tho,
    Abitund’ i polo kar’ anen Jalar.
    (dar versi ceke kumeno)

                ::Lube:: abilubo Yesu, 
                Ka ceke, ceng’ ceke, Ebitelo yo, 
                ::Lube:: abilubo Yesu,
                Abitund’ I polo kar’ anen Jalar.

2.	 Cil i can para wabiwotho ku Jalar, 
     Ka wavuvu koto, mudho de cido yo. 
     Ka Yesu betelo wia lworo nega ngo ---

3.	 Cíl i can para wabiwotho ku Jalar, 
     Got ma dit aidho, Yesu nyuth ira yo, 
     Abilubo ng’eye abiweke ki ngo ---

title: I Gave my Life for Thee
content:
1.	Amio kwona dho piri rimona cwir kor yen.
    Awarui ku rimona, Alarui kud i tho.
   ::Amio kwo para dho piri, Ira imio ang’o?::

2.	 I ot pa Vwa der rieny ber dit etieko komkerne,
     Ento Awekogi ceke, Adoko jacan i ng’om.
     ::Aweko kpo Abino i ng’om, Pira iweko ang’o?::

3.	 Masendi dupa Ayio ma copo yere ngo, 
     Alworo ndiba ngo kara in kud isendri i mac.
     ::Ayeyo ceke abodhi ko, Ira iyeyo ang’o?::

4.	 Akelo iri gin dupa m’uai i ot pa Vwa
     Gi ruc mi duboni ceke, ku berocwiny man merna.
     ::Akelo ceke Acero ngo, Ira ikelo ang’o?::
english_name: I Gave my Life for Thee

title: I Need Jesus
content:
1.	Yesu kende canne nuti bang’a, 
    Jarimba mbe m’ukonya calu En. 
    Yesu kende man konyne nut’ andha,
    Jumoko yeyo can kendgi, an re ndhu Yesu.

                :::Yesu kende::: ku ba ceng’.
                Yesu saa mi masendi, Yesu saa mir anyong’a.
                Ku ba ceng’ i yo ceke, ndhu Yesu kende.

2.	 Yesu kende ayenyo ndhu Yesu, 
     Ka yo cido dong’ Etel wia En. 
     Yesu kende i saa mir abidhe,
     A kenda abipodh’ andha, ayenyo Yesu.

3.	 Yesu kende canne n’i bang’a nja, 
     Japorne mbe, E Jarimb judubo, 
     Yesu kende jumange romo ngo,
     Elokre ngo, Jategokpo, ayenyo Yesu.

title: All to Jesus
content:
1.	An amira dho ni Yesu, 
    Lembe ceke amio.
    Abimare, abigene, 
    Abibedo kude nja.

                 ::An amira dho:: 
                 An amira ni Jalarna,
                 An amira dho.

2.	 An amira dho ni Yesu, 
     An ajwigra the tiende.
     Lembe mi ng’om kpo aweko, 
     Jola Yesu, jola do.

3.	 An amira dho ni Yesu, 
     Dwoka peri, Jalarna.
     Tipo peri rom i ia, 
     Enyuth ira, a peri.

4.	 An amira dho ni Yesu, 
     Rwoth, amira dho iri.
     Mer ku tegoni rom ia, 
     Konj mugisa wia do.

title: I Belong to the King
content:
1.	An a nyathin pa Rwoth, nyathin m’Emaru dit.
    Abibedo i bang’e i ker, 
    Kum Eyero ira polo bedo ber dit, 
    Man nyithindhe birieny kuca do.

                 An a nyathin pa Rwoth, man Emara mandha, 
                 Wa jupare Eweko rwa ngo. 
                 Ceng’ ma Rwoth lwong’owa i ot pare maleng’, 
                 Wabibedo ng’et komker pare.

2.	 An a nyathin pa Rwoth kum ang’ey’ Emara. 
     Kisa pare ku berone de, 
     Ebenyutho ira ka m’acidh’ i ie, 
     En e kapondo ira mi nja.

3.	 An a nyathin pa Rwoth man Enyutho ira 
     Ya kabedo m’i polo berieny. 
     Ka tic ceke mi ng’om ku masendine thum 
     Abimond’ i yom mi kwiocwiny.

title: Do you Wonder Why
content:
1.	An ayio Yesu Kristu nedi? Ayie, ayie?
    An ayio Yesu Kristu nedi? Kum Elara ku rimbe.
    Yesu weko polo kar’ Ebodhwa, Etho piwa.
    Ka kumeno dong’ iyie bende, kum Esendre piwa kpo.

                (ku ba versi ceke kumae, ento nen lembe ma tung’)

2.	 An amaru Yesu Kristu nedi? Amaru, amaru?

3.	 An atimo ru ni Yesu nedi? Atimo, atimo?

4.	 An apaku Yesu Kristu nedi?

5.	 An afoyo Yesu Kristu nedi?

6.	 An ageno Yesu Kristu nedi?

7.	An aworo Yesu Kristu nedi?

8.	 An akio dwogo pare nedi? Akio, akio?

title: I am Happy in the
content:
1.	Tic atimo ku mutoro ni Jalar, an atimo ku mutoro.
    En Eketho kindwa poto, dwoka tek kan atimo ni Jalar.

                Kan atimo ni Jalar abitimo ticne cu 
                Abinwang’u lem ma ber kwa kan atimo ni Jalar.

2.	 Tic atimo ku mutoro ni Jalar, an atimo ku mutoro.
     Kum Ecikukonya ku ba piny m’uru kan atimo ni Jalar.

3.	 Tic atimo ku mutoro ni Jalar, an atimo ku mutoro.
     Lem m’usenda lund udwoko cwinya tek kan atimo ni Jalar.

title: God Will Take Care
content:
1.	Lembe besendi, e cwinyi dieng? 
    Mungu bigwoki En, 
    Cor ceng’ni bang’e i vute dri, 
    Mungu bigwoki En.

                (ku ba versi ceke: Mungu bigwoki En)

                Mungu bigwoki En, ku ba rupiny, ku diewor de. 
                Ekengo wi jupare, Mungu bigwoki cil nja.

2.	 Tek wonabidhe bebidhi dit --- 
     Man tek iol, e ivoc de ngi ---

3.	 Ni canpiny Mungu bikonyi be --- 
     Pi can m’utimi Eng’eyo de ---

4.	 Gin meno ceke bivoyi ngo ---
     Dong’ igene cil i cwinyi kpo ---

title: Lord I want to be a Christian
content:
1.	::Rwoth, ayeny’ abed Jakristu, yor i cwinya, yor i cwinya::
    Yor i cwinya, Rwoth ayeny’ abed Jakristu yor i cwinya.

               (ku ba versi ceke:Yor i cwinya calu maeni)

2.	 ::Rwoth ayeny’ amar jo ceke ---
     Rwoth ayeny’ amar jo ceke ---

3.	 ::Rwoth ayeny’ abed maleng’ njwa --- 
     Rwoth ayeny’ abed maleng’ njwa ---

4.	 ::Rwoth ayeny’ acir abidhe ---
     Rwoth ayeny’ acir abidhe ---

5.	 ::Rwoth ayeny’ abed cal kudi ---
     Rwoth ayeny’ abed cal kudi.---
english_name: Lord I want to be a Christian

title: Jesus Paid it All
content:
1.	Yesu wacuna kumae: “I ng’ic, iromo ngo, 
    Ento tek irwo Ira, ibinwang’u tegona.”

                Yesu culo kpo ku rimbe m’ucwir.
                Dub m’adubo dit mandha, Elwoke dwoke tar.

2.	 Tego peri kende Rwoth ma copo dwoka tar.
     Dubo nyotho cwinya kot, dong’ Ilony adundena.

3.	 An ambe ku bedopwe, akoc ku kisa de.
     Ento rimbi cwir pira m’ebilwoka dwoka tar.

4.	 Kan atund’ i vuti Rwoth, ma con abedo bor,
     Abifoyo kum aboth, beroni upong’a thur.

title: Under the Blood
content:
1.	Rwoth gwok cwinya ku ba rupiny ::the rimoni::
    Kab lworo ku dubona de In, the rimoni ma ber.
    (dar versi ceke kumeno)

                The rimoni, rimo ma ber, rimo mi Iwok ma Iwoko jo,
                Gwoka Yesu Jalarna ndhu the rimoni ma ber.

2.	 Kapondo pa jadubo e ::the rimoni::
     Inyutho yo mi kwo bende ---

3.	 Yesu dong’ Iroma ndhu nja ::the rimoni::
     Keth atim ru ka cwinyi kwa ---

4.	 Kwiocwiny ma ber ni ia ::the rimoni::
     Tic peri timbre ber iwa ---

title: Brighten the Corner
content:
1.	Yesu yenyo wa jukwenda watim tic ire, 
    Kum Eyenyo ngo ya dhanu rwiny, 
    Wabikonyo jo i can ku tego pa Yesu, 
    Kum Yesu bedo i cwinywa.

                 ::Wan wa jukwenda pa Yesu:: 
                 Nying Yesu watuco ka ceke ni dhanu yu, 
                 Wan wa jukwenda pa Yesu.

2.	 Yesu yenyo wa cokwenda wawoth kind dhanu, 
     Wajuk ju ma can utimogi. 
     Watuc igi pi Yesu Jalar, ma E Jajuk, 
     Watim ku tego m’Emio.

3.	 Yesu yenyo wa monkwenda waponj jumanyir 
     Ya rimb Yesu cwir nibodhogi. 
     Tek giyie Ebilarugi ni can ma dit, 
     Bikonyogi nibedo cu.

4.	 Yesu yenyo wan aradu waponj nyithindho 
     Giyi Yesu Rwoth m’umarugi. 
     Gikan Lem pa Mungu i cwinygi,
     Gisag dubo, gidong’ atira ni Yesu.

title: All the way my Saviour
content:
1.	Yesu tela i yo ceke, an ayenyo mange ngo.
    Yesu tho pi dubna bende. Man Edoko jatel yo.
    Lembe pare e m’ujuka kud i can m’asendra ko,
    ::An ang’eyo kan asendra, Yesu e m’utelo yo::

2.	 Yesu tela i yo ceke kud i yo m’ugondre swa.
     Tek atagu mina bero, In i Yesu, kwen mi kwo.
     Kan aol, m’ayenyo voc de, rieu pi talu dwanda kau,
     :: Abinwang’u pi i cana, Yesu e m’utelo yo::

3.	 Yesu tela i yo ceke, yo m’ucidho kamaleng’.
     Abinwang’u yom i bang’e man anwang’u can de mbe.
     Abifoyo jatel wia kum Etelo wia ber.
     ::Abipaku Yesu Kristu kum Etelo wia ber::

title: He will Hold me Fast
content:
1.	Kan abidhe sendo cwinya, Yesu kura En.
    Yioyicna voc i ia, Yesu kura En do.

                 :: Yesu kura En::
                 Kum Jalarna mara sagu, Yesu kura En.

2.	 An aponjo mok’ i kume, mak’ Ekura En.
     Merna kwio, wang’a cido, mak’ Ekura En do.

3.	 An a lonyo dit i wang’e, keth’ Ekura En.
     Ebegwoka kum Ebodha, keth’ Ekura En do.

4.	 Yesu ng’iewa En ku rimbe, dong’ Ekura En.
     Ebigama be i bang’e dong’ Ekura En do.

title: Faith of our Fathers
content:
1.	Ju ma jusendogi pi yioyic gineno can, jutimogi rac.
    Jumulogi ku goc ma lith, jumoko de juwang’u ku mac.

                 Yioyic ma giciro ko, wan de wacir ko cil i tho.

2.	 Jucanyugi ku kidi de, palamularu negogi le.
     Mange jutwiogi de ku kol, yioyic migi lokre de ngo.

3.	 Kadok jumoko sendowa, wan wabed yo ku mer mandha.
     Dong’ wanyai lem mi kwo asu, ku bedopwe, ku lembe ma cu.

title: Move Forward
content:
1.	Wacidhu wu pa ker pa Rwoth m’Enyolowu ku yo mi both.
    Wuai tho tho, wuci yau yau, wucwal tic man wurende pio.

                 ::Wacidhu:: woth i yo mi kwo.
                 ::Wacidhu:: Rwoth Yesu menyo yo.

2.	 Wacidhu ndhu kubang’wa yu ka palacam e eni ndhu.
     Jukai mwoka wupoi pi koth, emaru nyotho cam pa Rwoth.

3.	 Wacidhu kud amora do kum jumalaika kengowa.
     Udul mi jumulembe de gitiekowa gikonyowa.

4.	 Wacidhu, ceng’ udhingo mwony, ku mudho ticne timbre ngo.
     Wuai ku rwo wukweru kpo, wulok cwiny ju m’urwinyo do.

title: O say but I’m Glad
content:
1.	Wer ma mit wok i cwinya tin wer ma yang’ con embe, 
     Yesu Jalar kabu dubna cen, anyong’a mandha.

                  ::Anyong’a benega dit:: Yesu bibino 
                  Anyong’ana kwa, anyong’a mandha.

2.	 Tek can uwok i adundena, merne ukonya dit.
     Weja bibedo i cwinya nja, anyong’a mandha.

3.	 Ribri ma ber nuti kindwa tin wan waku Jalar mwa.
     Bedo i Yesu e ber jufwa, anyong’a mandha.

4.	 Wubin i bang’e ku can mu kpo man Ebilaruwu.
     Wun wubiwero pi merne nja, anyong’a mandha.

title: O where are the Reapers?
content:
1.	E jutic mi mwoka julwong’owu 
    Nikayu i mwoka pa Yesu Rwoth, 
    Ku pala mi lembe jutimo tic, 
    Jutime asu cil i ceng’ pa Rwoth.

                 Jutic ni kani ma kumgi mor, 
                 Ma yenyo ya Mungu yung’gi ceng ajok? 
                 E ng’a bibino nikonyowa, 
                 Nicoko camne juter i kal?

2.	 Ka mwoka e eni i ng’om ceke, 
     E jubedo diedo kum mwokane. 
     Jutim ticne lam ento camne lwar, 
     E kudi wagal ki kum palacam.

3.	 Wubin dong ku pala wu jumaleng’ 
     Wacokra k’amora i mwokane. 
     Keth cwinywu kum tic cil i ceng’ pa Rwoth, 
     Mutoro bisagre i ceng ajok.

title: The Comforter has Come
content:
1.	Yer lembe ma mit dit ni dhanu yu mi ng’om,
    Lem juk m’ukonyo ju m’usendri dit ku can.
    Juyic gicidh giyer kud anyong’a mandha
    Jajuk udaru wok. 

    (dar versi ceke kumeno)

                 ::Jajuk udaru wok:: ma Mungu oro re,
                 Kum lembang’olane, Yer ngbeng’ ni dhanu yu
                 Cil ma ging’eyo ko Jajuk uwok i ng’om.

2.	 Jukuro kendo ngo, Eyenyo dhanu yu 
     Gimi ire kaka m’Ebed i cwinygi kpo. 
     Eromgi gibed tek nitimo tic ni Rwoth ---

3.	 Eyenyo bimo bim i cwiny ju ma gi leng’,
     Gimiri dho ire tegone romgi cu.
     Etel wigi i tic Ekonj mugisa dit ---

4.	 Wacopo poro ngo mer ma Emaru ko 
     Ju ma gidubo swa gikwero berone. 
     Wan ma waromo nyoth wabirieny cal kude ---

title: Where He Leads
content:
1.	Lembe pa Mungu mit dit mandhandha, 
    Sagu lembe mange ceke ma juwinjo. 
    Kristo ebedo leng’ tar sagu pei, 
    En e jampor ni jupare, walub toke!

                Ka---m’Etelo wia,
                (Ka m’Etelo wia, abilubo toke)
                A---bilube do,
                Ka---m’Etelo wia, 
                (Ka m’Etelo wia abilubo toke)
                Lube ku ba ceng’ ceke.

2.	 Mer ma Yesu nyutho mit sagu kpo, 
     Mer mi dhanu copo pore kude ungo. 
     Kisa ni ju m’ukier, bedo mandha, 
     En e jampor ni jupare walub toke!

3.	 Winj lem pare mi mer ‘‘Bin bang’a do,’’
     Ter ma pek m’unuri de i bol i kore. 
     Gen lembang’olane gilokri ngo, 
     Jeng’i kor Jalarni de, e cwinyi bed tek.

title: Far & Near the Fields
content:
1.	Yesu wacu wanen ba p-o-thi ya gicek m’uromo ni kayu.
    Thelembene wa ju pa Mungu wasai juma giywagu both.

                 Rwoth wakweyi yep adundewa,
                 Winjwa Rwoth watuco kier mwa,
                 Kum wagalu, wabedo nyap de,
                 Watimo tic peri ber ungo.

2.	 Orwa Yesu wacidh wayer piri ni ju ma girwinyo i dubo,
     Diewor de bebino pio ma jutimo tic moko ngo.

3.	 In i jayic ma Rwoth uori igalu dwong’ e rombe berwinyo,
     Tek icidho ikelo rombene, Rwoth bimio jambkermiwic.

title: Hold the Fort
content:
1.	Bin juwada, nen abera pa Rwoth Yesu mwa.
    Ebelwong’owa jupare, En aloci mwa.

               “Dong’ wuki, kum Abibino,” Yesu wacu re.
               Wan wadwoko lembe ire “wan wabedo nger.”

2.	 Rwoth bidwogo En ku kite man ku kok ma dit.
     Dwand malaika kud agwara pare de biywak.

3.	 Wabikiedo ku jadegi ku jupare de.
     Rwoth bimio tego iwa, wabivoye be.

4.	 Kadok mony uyenyo dhetho, Rwoth bijengowa.
     Tego ceke ai i bang’e riemo bebe mwa.

title: Mine Eyes Have Seen
content:
1.	Aneno polo yabre, man nen riuni ma tar,
    Ere ngatu ma ni wie ma julwong’o Lemandha.
    Man i bedopwe Epoko lembe man Etimo mony,
    E nyinge Lemandha!

                     :::Dwong’ ni Mungu, Haleluya!:::
                     Wapaku nyinge nja!

2.	 Eronjre de ku kendi ma juvong’o ku rimbe,
     E jamker mi wie dupa man nying wang’e ve lebmac,
     Man ku pala ma ni dhoge En Egoyo thek ma rac,
     Mungu Jategokpo.

3.	 Tek idong’ the kwinyone ceng’ nica ibitim’ ang’o?
     Ebinyono pany mi kwinyo pare, ng’a bikonyi ke?
     Tek ipodho ni Jategokpo enyayu ndiri kwa,
     Lok cwinyi bang’e tin.

4.	 Ka fodi kisa nuti ai, iyi Wod Mungu tin,
     Ebijoli ngisi pare lwar, Elwong’i dong’ ibin.
     Tek igalu ngo iyi Jalar m’utho pi duboni, e ibipake de.

title: There’ll be no Dark
content:
1.	 :::Ndiri tho birwinyo ka Yesu wok,:::
     :::Nicoko jupare kpo.:::
     Ndiri tho birwinyo ka Yesu wok, nicoko jupare kpo.

2.	  :::Ndiba ceke rwinyo ka Yesu wok,:::
      :::Nicoko jupare kpo.:::
      Ndiba kpo birwinyo ka Yesu wok, nicoko jupare kpo.

3.	   :::Goyo nduru rwinyo ka Yesu wok,:::
       :::Nicoko jupare kpo.:::
       Nduru kpo birwinyo ka Yesu wok, nicoko jupare kpo.

4.	   :::Wabipaku Yesu ma Wod Mungu,:::
       :::Wapake ku cwinywa kpo,:::
       Wabipaku Yesu ma Wod Mungu, wapake ku cwinywa kpo.

title: When the Roll is Called
content:
1.	Kajukudh’ agwara kuca e wawinjo dwal ma dit,
    Rundi meni thum e wan wacer k’i tho.
    Ku juwada ceke wabirieyo kuca ka maleng’,
    Ka julwong’o nyinga kuca abiyi.

                   :::Ka julwong’o nyinga kuca,:::
                   Ka julwong’o nyinga kuca abiyi.

2.	 Wabimothra ku mutoro ka wanendra ka maleng’,
     Wa ku jumange m’ugeno Yesu de,
     Ma juloko kumwa ceke e wanwang’u kum ma nyen,
     Ka julwongo nyinga kuca abiyi.

3.	 Dong watim ni Yesu Kristu tic m’Eng’olo iwa cu,
     En Efoyo ju m’ucung i ie ki,
     Ka wadaru tije ceke wabicokra kuca kpo,
     Ka julwongo nyinga kuca abiyi.

title: The Unclouded Day
content:
1.	E! Juyero ira lembe mi ka maleng’.
    Jubewacu ya ebedo ber mandha.
    Lem m’ucido kadi dhau bende mbe kuca,
    Der ma sagu ceng’ urieny kuca nja.

                       Polo en e ka maber, kuca dhanu gimari kindgi.
                       Lem mi dubo kadi tho bende mbe kuca,
                       Der ma sagu ceng’ urieny kuca nja.

2.	 An awinjo ya juwada gidok kuca,
     E ginwang’u ng’ombe ber mire ma!
     Man ng’et kulo kun ku kun yen mi kwo nuti,
     Kec unego ng’atu moko ngo.

3.	 Jubewacu ya piwang’ ton ungo kuca,
     Kadi can umbe, jung’iero kuca dit.
     Ng’ombe ber ma sagu ceke mi ng’om mae,
     Ava ng’ombe nego cwinya dit.

4.	 Jubewacu ya won pacu e Yesu Rwoth,
     Man Ebedo wi komker m’urieny tar pu.
     Pacune e mola kwa, man e leng’ mandha,
     An acidho kuca ka mi kwo.

title: There is a Happy Land
content:
1.	Polo e ka ma ber anyong’a kwa,
    Pacu pa Rwoth mi kwo, pacu mandha.
    Jupare wero ru, wej anyong’a ire ndhu,
    Pak ma gipake ko, e pak mi nja.

2.	 Kwany yo mi polo do, in kud igal.
     Yesu betelo yo, mond ndhu i kal.
     Anyong’a nuti dit, dubo kadi can de mbe,
     Ibed ba Yesu Rwoth, ndhu nja ku nja.

3.	 Mungu bijolowa i pacune, Emaru dhanu yu,
     Ku mer ma dhe. Yesu Etho piwa, En Elwoko dubo mwa,
     Edwokowa leng’ njwa kum rimone.

title: We’re Marching to Zion
content:
1.	Tek wun wumaru Rwoth, wu jumutoro kwa,
    ::Wadong’ wapake wakudu,::
    ::Watieko kom pa Rwoth::

                     Wacidho, acidha, kuca i pacu pa Mungu.
                     Wacidho mal’ i polo, adhura maleng’ pa Yesu.

2.	 Wu ju m’Enyolo nyen, nedi wupake ngo?
     ::Wadong’ wapak ubimo mwa::
     ::Wa jumutoro kwa.::

3.	 Eriemo ndiba cen, e can mwa ringo kpo.
     ::Piwang’wa ceke bende mbe,::
     ::Wacidh’ i ka maleng’::

4.	 Tek wun wuyio Yesu ngo m’utho piwa,
     ::Wadong’ wayie wakudu,::
     Dong’ wabibed’ i polo wakudu mi nja.

title: To Die No More
content:
1.	Thuwa i polo eber dit, tho ku merkum de mondo ngo.
    Usimbru udine rieny dit, ode acel ukuro an.

                       Acidho thuwa ba Mungu, acidho thuwa ba Yesu.
                       Tho nego dhanu kuca ngo, acidho thuwa ba Mungu.

2.	 Udi ma beco dupa tie kuca ng’ei cero malu ngbir.
     Ka an aweko ng’om mae ode acel ukuro an.

3.	 I ng’om abedo jawirok, masendi wok i bang’a kwa.
     Kadok a calu Lazaro, thwo oda ngeng’ ni kuca nja.

4.	 Wek jumange yeny thugi piny,
     Ma mac ku pi de nyothe cen.
     Ayenyo para thwo ma ngeng’ mal’ i polo i vut jadwong’.

5.	 Ka ng’om ku cero daru mwony
     Man ceng’ ku dwi girwinyo kpo.
     Man ke tek piny bimor de mbwom
     Thwo oda cungo ira ngeng’.

title: In the Sweet Bye and Bye
content:
1.	Kal pa Rwoth cido ngo kum e leng’, man ke dubo
    Ku tho bende mbe. Yesu yiko kabedo maber,
    Ebicokowa ndhu ceng’ mange.

                        ::Ng’ombe leng’, ng’ombe leng’
                        Ng’om ma ber mire ma nja ku nja!::

2.	 Ka wanyiko dhu wath kuca bo, wabigoyo muzira wi Rwoth,
     Kwiocwiny pare sagu mi ng’om man kakeca Emiowa yom.

3.	 Kum mugisa m’Ekonjo wiwa, man kum merne
     M’Emaru kowa, wabipaku nying Mungu mi nja,
     En e Wegwa m’upido piwa.
english_name: In the Sweet Bye and Bye

title: Near to the Heart
content:
1.	Kaka mi yom nut’i polo, pacu pa Rwoth Jalar.
    I polo dubo mbe ma gwei kum Mungu yie ngo.

                    E Yesu i Jalar mwa ma Mungu ori con.
                    Tel wiwa gwokwa bende cil ma waneni ko.

2.	 Wanwang’u juk ma mit mandha keni i ‘ng’om ma rac.
     Kuca i pacu pa Jajuk can timo jo de ngo.

3.	 Anyonga kwa ku kwiocwiny ceng’ni i vut Jalar,
     Kum Yesu gonyowa ma gwei kud i masendi mwa.

title: I Shall be Like Him
content:
1.	Kan atundo ka mi dwong’ pa Yesu bo,
    Nwang’u can para thum kpo, bedo cal ku Yesu
    Wang’u ijo li! Cal ku Yesu ma Jalar.

                     ::Cal ku Jalar mwa:: man i derne wabirieny.
                     Cal ku Jalar mwa, ka wabinene.
                     Cal ku Yesu ma Jalar.

2.	 Yesu bidwogo wakure de ngo, m’Ebiwok i wang’wa njwa
     Ayine copo wok i wang’wa eni ayine ng’eire iwa.

3.	 Mungu biloko kitwa ndhu cal kude,
     Yer pire ceng’ ku ceng’ kpo.
     Kan Eloka ndhu ku Tipo cal kude cwinya bikwio kuca.

title: The Home of the Soul
content:
1.	Pacu mi Jukristu en e ber mire ma!
    Die ie riang’ni mandhandha, kabedo ma ber kwa
    Yesu mwa beyiko ::kuca ndhu pi ju ma giyie::
    Kabedo ma ber kwa Yesu mwa beyiko,
    Eyiko ndhu pi ju m’uyie.

2.	 Pacu mi Jukristu eni keni de ngo, keni en e ng’om
     Mi dubo, gin ceke ma n’i ng’om ceng’ mange gibithum.
     ::Lonyo kpo m’i ng’om keni bithum::
     Gin ceke ma n’i ng’om ceng’ mange gibithum,
     Lonyo ceke m’i ng’om bithum kpo.

3.	 Pacu mi Jukristu en e ceng’ni mandha kum nindone
     Dhingo ma gwei. Ayenyo tak de ngo nibed’ i ng’om keni,
     ::An ayenyo anen wang Jalar:: Ayenyo tak de ngo
     Nibed’ i ng’om keni, an ayenyo anen wang’ Jalar.

title: O Think of the Home
content:
1.	Par cu pi kabedo ma ber i ng’et kulo m’urieny pami ceng’,
    Ju ma pwe pa Mungu gicokri
    M’Eronyo ku kendi ma tar pu.
    ::Kuca do, kuca do par cu pi kabedo ma ber::

2.	 Par cu pi juwadwa ma pwe ma gisendri i ng’om calu wan.
     Dong’ kawono gibedo i bang’e ma giwero pak ni Rwoth Mungu.
     ::Kuca do, kuca do par cu pi juwadwa ma pwe::

3.	 An de abimondo i yom kan adaru tic para i ng’om.
     Abirombo ku jumerna dupa, gibekura i vut Mungu Rwoth.
     ::Kuca do, kuca do, an de abimondo i yom::

title: O that will be Glory
content:
1.	Ka tic ku can para ceke bithum,
    An abibedo yo dhu wath maleng’.
    Bedo i vut Rwoth m’amaru mumbe,
    Bibed’ anyong’ana ma nja ku nja.

    (dar versi ceke kumeno)

                     ::Anyong’a kwa, anyong’ana::
                     Ka abineno Yesu Jalarna
                     Meno bibedo anyong’ana kwa.

2.	 An abibedo jamerne ma dhe,
     Yesu bitera ayom bang’e dre.
     Bedo ma wabibedo ku mer kwa, ---

3.	 Juwada moko m’amaru mumbe,
     An abinwang’u vut Jalarna be.
     Bedo ma wabibedo kugi de ---

4.	 I polo abipaku ru Yesu kum tho m’Etho ko abimondo be.
     Bedo m’abibedo kwo i bang’e, ---

title: Face to Face
content:
1.	Wang’wa ku wang’ Yesu Kristu gibinendri ceng’ mange.
    Abinene ku mutoro, Yesu En m’Etho kuma.

                      Abinene abing’eye, kan akadh’ i polo gwei.
                      Abineno lonyo pare, abinene ceng’ mange.

2.	 Ang’eyo kucel kawono, abenene va ku kieu,
     Ento ka Yesu bidwogo abineno wang’e cu.

3.	 Kud i vute abifoye nwang’u ndiri ringo bor.
     Lem m’usenda de bikadhu, ka ma col bilero her.

4.	 Wang Yesune abineno, abing’eye, Ebinen;
     Abineno wang’ Jalarna, Yesu En ku kite dho.

title: Jesus my Saviour
content:
1.	Yesu Jalarna Eloro i ng’om,
    Yesu Wod Mungu m’Esendre piwa.
    Ia wang’ li kan awinjo pire, ya Ebeyenyo an.
    ::Ebino yenyo an::
    Ia wang’ li kan awinjo pire, ya Ebeyenyo an.

2.	 Yesu Jalarna Etho kakara, banja m’i wia Eculo ira.
     Ia wang’ li kan awinjo pire, ya En Etho pira.
     ::Ebino tho pira::
     Ia wang’ li kan awinjo pire, ya En Etho pira.

3.	 Yesu Jalar e jakwac maber dit,
     En Ebesayu ndhu rombe m’ukier.
     Ia wang’ li kan awinjo dwande, ya Ebelwong’o an.
     ::Ebino lwong’o an::
     Ia wang’ li kan awinjo dwande ya Ebelwong’o an.

4.	 Yesu Jalarna bidwogo i ng’om, En Ebicoko juyic m’uyie,
     An abinene m’Eloro i ng’om, Man Ebiting’a de.
     ::Man Ebiting’a de::
     An abinene m’Eloro i ng’om, man Ebiting’a de.

title: Joy to the World
content:
1.	Anyong’a kwa! Rwoth Yesu wok! Wajol Ubimo mwa!
    Wek Emond i adundewa, Emi iwa mutoro kwa.

                    ::Wawer kud anyong’a::
                    Wawer, wawer kud anyong’a.

2.	 Anyong’a kwa Jalar mwa wok, Ekelo both iwa.
     Wek Ekab kier ku dubo mwa, Elonywa ni kum cilo mwa.

3.	 Anyong’a kwa, Rucwic uwok, Ekabu kwong’ mi ng’om. 
     Egonyo giracwia pet, ukudho, can, ku merone.

4.	 Anyong’a kwa, Jajuk uwok, m’Ejukowa mandha. 
     Ekwio cwiny, Ejuko can, Eyweyo piwang’wa m’uton.

5.	 Kero ku dwong’ bed ire nja! Thek ceke pak nyinge! 
     Judode Rwoth mi rwodhi kpo, mugisa kwa Emio nja.

title: O Come all ye Faithful
content:
1.	Wubin, nen Wod Mungu, pake kud anyong’a. 
    Junyole mukere i Bethlehem. 
    Tipo maleng ubino wi min mire. 
    :::Wubin wuyung Wod Mungu::: Yesu Jalar.

    (Dar versi ceke kumeni)

2.	 Jumalaika wero karacelo kudwa, 
     Wumi dwong’ ni Mungu ma malu ngbir. 
     Dong’ cwinywu kwi wu dhanu mi mutoro, ---

3.	 Wajoli Rwoth Yesu kum Iwok i kindwa, 
     Warum ku jurieko wayungi k’ajok. 
     In mi Rucwic Ironjri ku kum ng’eca. ---

title: Silent Night, Holy Night
content:
1.	Lembe ma mit, iwa wang’ li, mudho ng’eny, der urieny. 
    Jubewero pir Imanuel. Mungu loro ing’om ve nyathin. 
    Yesu Kristu ma Rwoth, Yesu Jalarna m’uwok.

    (Dar versi 2, 3 kumeni)

2.	 Lembe ma mit, iwa wang’ li, ju mi thim rwo i lum.
     Kwiocwiny ku mutoro ni ng’om,
     Kwo ma nja bed ni dhanu m’utho ---

3.	 Lembe ma mit, iwa wang’ li, jukwac ai ringo pio
     Kud anyong’a nineno nyathin,
     Girwo bang’e girum ire dwe. ---

4.	 Yesu ma Rwoth, Imanuel, wafoyi, warwo de
     Ve jurieko m’uai i tung’ ng’om,
     Gin mi cingwa ku kumwa de dho,
     Wan wamio ni Rwoth, Yesu Kristu ma Jalar.

title: Once in Royal David’s City
content:
1.	I adhura pa Rwoth Daudi, i dwond dhiang’ junyolo Rwoth.
    Min uboyo nyathin pare man epiele ndhu i dwol.
    Mariamu min nyathin, Yesu En e nyathinne.

2.	 En Eloro kud i polo, man Etundo piny i ng’om.
     En Ebedo i kind dhanu, man Ebedo ni Mungu.
     Tic mi bau Eponjo dit, man Eworo won ku min.

3.	 Fodi e nyathin m’aradu ere cwinye mbe ku co.
     Man Ed’ongo ndhu ku bero, min de kothe ber mandha.
     Wun awia mange kpo, wutim tic ku woro kwa.

4.	 Kan Edoko jalawobi En Eciro abidhe.
     Lembe ceke mulo ie, kero pare voc de ngo.
     Meni En, Ekonyowa, kum Eng’eyo lembe mwa.

5.	 Ceng’ mange ka wabinene tek wamaru lem pare.
     Wabinene mal’i polo karacelo ba Mungu.
     En Elonyo iwa njwa, wabibedo kuca nja.

title: Away in a Manger
content:
1.	I dwol karacelo ku kana ku dhiang’,
    Rwoth Yesu juketho i kacam mi lim.
    E welo ma dit, ento jung’eye ngo,
    Ebino ni yenya kum a jadubo.

2.	 Rwoth Yesu ameri ma an de nyathin.
     Ajoli i ia, kura ku ba ceng’,
     I mudho ku der de tel wia, Yesu.
     Kar’ alund amond i beng’i i polo.

title: The First Noel
content:
1.	Ka jukwac ma gini thim gibekwayu rombe,
    E malaika wok bang’gi m’utuco lembe
    Ya junyolo Yesu Rwoth kuca i Bethlehem,
    E wawero k’anyonga kum Ewok i ng’om.

                     :::Noel::: Yesu ubimo mir Israel.

2.	 E gineno der ma dit kan erieny ku diewor.
     Lworo negogi ento juyero kumae,
     “Kwiocwiny ni dhanu yu, ku mutoro mandha
     Kum junyolo Rwoth Yesu Jalar mi ng’om yu.”

3.	 Juadek ma gi jurieko gineno cero
     Ya enyutho kakare m’Evuto i ot.
     E girwo ni Rwoth Jalar ku gin ma pire lwar,
     Mo, ku mola, udok de ma ng’wice ng’wi ng’ar.

4.	 Dong’ wapak nying Yesu dre, e wathiera ire.
     Man warwo ire Rwoth mi polo ku ng’om de.
     Rimbe oi nilaruwa kan Emire piwa,
     Dong’ wafoyo Wod Mungu kum e Jalar mwa.

title: There’s a Song in the Air
content:
1.	Malaika wero ni jukwac ma n’i thim, man giyero igi:
    “Lworo kud unegwu, kum wakelo rwonglembe ma dit
    Ni ng’om yu, ya junyolo Jalar ma Yesu Kristu Rwoth.”

2.	 Wang’uic sagu dit kud anyonga mandha, giranyutha iwa,
     Wego mio Wode. E junyole mukere i ka cam mi dhiang’,
     Ere, En e Ubimo m’Ejwigre kumae.

3.	 Jumange bino de, cero rieny telo yo, man ecungo wi ka
     Ma junyolo nyathin. Jurieko gibino githiero ire
     Giramia ma tung’ tung’ ma giyunge ko.

4.	 Dwong’ ni Mungu cil tin kum Emio iwa
     Lembe mi kwiocwiny pi Jalar mi ng’om yu.
     Dong’ watimo ang’o ire m’Ejwigre dit?
     Maku wan de warnira ni Yesu ma Rwoth.
english_name: There’s a Song in the Air

title: Low in the Grave
content:
1.	Yesu vuto i liel Yesu Jalarna, 
    Endre Evoyo liel, Yesu Rwodha.

                   Con kan Eai kud i liel En Evoyo tho ma e jakwor. 
                   En Eai jatego, man Evoyo liel, man Ebedo kwo 
                   Ku dhanu pare nja. ::En Eai:: Haleluya Yesu ai!

2.	 Jukur’ avuje de, Yesu Jalarna, 
     Ento jukuro kwe, Yesu Rwodha.

3.	 Juciko bang’e de Yesu Jalarna, 
     Ento juciko kwe, Yesu Rwodha.

4.	 Tho ponjo voye de, Yesu Jalarna, 
     Ento eponjo kwe, Yesu Rwodha.

5.	 Evoyo tho ira, Yesu Jalarna 
     Afoye dit mandha, Yesu Rwodha.

title: He Lives
content:
1.	Ang’eyo Yesu nuti Eni i ia tin,
    Waweco karacelo ku rwo ku ba rupiny.
    Eting’a kan apodho, Ejuko cwinya dit,
    Jatego kpo m’ukonya i can ma lic.

                       ::Eai!:: Evoyo tho ma gwei!
                       Alubo toke ku ba ceng’ i woth mi bedopwe.
                       ::Eai:: En e Jatego kpo!
                       Jawarna bedo kwo mandha, Ebedo i ia.

2.	 Ekonyo dhanu ceke m’ugeno tegone, Etelo wi jupare
     I yo mi bedopwe. Kadwogo pare dhingo kan
     Ebicokowa, biterowa, wabed kuca bang’e nja.

3.	 Ifoi Jalar areri, Evoyo ndiba kpo, mutorone bikonyi,
     Ebedekonyo jo. Iyie, gene, wore, ku pidoic ma cu,
     Jarimoni e Yesu ma Rwoth mi kwo.

title: The strife is o’er
content:
1.	:::Haleluya!::: Juciko liel, masendi thum,
    Jalar mwa voyo tho iwa, wapake ndhu ku pak mandha, 
    Haleluya!

2.	 Eii ku tho ku kero dit, jukwoj Kristu Elalu dra.
     Juwero wej anyong’a kwa, Haleluya!

3.	 Evuto ceng’ adek i liel, ento Eai ku dwong’ ma dit.
     Wayungi Rwoth mi wiwa In, Haleluya!

4.	 Goc peri cangu juperi kum kwir mi tho m’ukayugi,
     Wanwang’u kwo, wapaku in, Haleluya!

title: There is a Green Hill
content:
1.	Yang’ con wi got Golgotha, wi yen m’atharane,
    Juguro Yesu ma Jalar m’utho pi dhanu pet.

                    Emaruwa ku mer mandha, e wan wamare de.
                     Wang’eyo rimbe waruwa, watimo ire de.

2.	 Masendi pare pore ngo, m’Esendre ko piwa.
     Ku ter ma pek m’Eyeyo no kum kier ku dubo mwa.

3.	 Etero dubo mwa bor cen, Eculo banja mwa,
     Ekelo iwa genogen, wanwang’u kwo ma nja.

4.	 Jalar mwa Yesu romo ndhu ni kabu kwir mi tho.
     Eyabu polo iwa ku rimbe m’ulwoko jo.

title: My Faith Looks Up
content:
1.	Tho meni tho mi kum, etho ma nja de ngo, tic pare thum.
    Kume mae m’utop wadwoke ndhu i ng’om,
    Enwang’u yom ma nja, enwang’u yom.

2.	 Tho meni tho mi kum, etho ma nja de ngo, can pare thum.
     ::Eyom ivut Yesu:: 
     Enwang’u yom ma nja, enwang’u yom.

3.	 Tho meni tho mi kum, e tho ma nja de ngo, bicer kendo.
     Yesu m’uvoyo tho biloko kume do,
     En de bi ai i liel bi ai kendo.

4.	 Tho meni tho mi kum, e tho ma nja de ngo, eni polo.
     Ebedo k’anyong’a i kwo ma nja ku nja,
     I polo ba Jalar Yesu Kristu.

title: Jesus May Come Today
content:
1.	Ikuro Yesu tin? Ebidwogo! Nyo fok’ iyie ngo,
    Cwinyi iloko de ngo, tek nwangu Edwogo tin?

                     Ebidwogo, Yesu m’Ubimo mwa
                     Ku dwand malaika, dwal ma dit,
                     Man dwand agwara winjre mit,
                     Wacok dhogwa, wabed ku Yesu nja.

2.	 Wakuro Yesu tin, Ebidwogo! Yesu biterowa
     Kuca i polo mi nja, wa ju ma wagene tin.

3.	 Lworo binega ngo, Ebidwogo! Ka pokolembe wok,
     Para juketho wi Rwoth yang’ con kan Etho pira.

4.	 Ayeny’ awoth ma pwe, Ebidwogo! Lewic binega ngo,
     Abijole k’anyong’a, tek Yesu bidwogo tin.

title: When Jesus Comes
content:
1.	Ceng’ moko Yesu bicoko dhogwa, sukulia tie iwa;
    Kan Ebikoro i tic mwa ceke, girang’o m’ukier iwa?

                            Ceng’ moko Yesu bicoko dhogwa, wabifoyo cokrine?
                            Nyo Ebinwang’u ya wan wanindo?
                            Kie! Kie! Ebitundo rek!

2.	 Ka piny uru poi Jalar bidwogo! Ebilwong’o nyingwa kpo;
     Man tek Etuco pi tic m’atimo, tije nyo atime cu?

3.	 Mugisa pare ni ju m’ukio dwogo pare ku ba ceng’.
     Ju ma girwo ma gikuri gigi, ma woth migi ceke leng’

title: Saved through Jesus’ Blood
content:
1.	Ceng’ moko wabicung’ i wang’ Yesu ku ju m’ucer k’i tho.
    Rwoth mwa bituco lembe mwa ceke,
    Bilwong’o nyingwa kpo.

                  Ebilwong’o nying jupare kpo,
                  Jumaleng’ ma rimb Yesu ng’iewo
                  Kan Elwong’o nyinga abiyi, Yesu tho pira.

2.	 Rwoth mwa bimio sukulia de ni ju m’uvoyo ng’om;
     Man wabibedo kude i polo ma rondo ku rondo.

3.	 Dong’ wabibedo ku jupare nja, wapokra kendo ngo;
     Man wabibolo ter mwa the tiend Rwoth, e wabinwang’u yom.

title: Sands of time
content:
1.	Nindo becikukadhu, rupiny de ni ceng’ni,
    Kinde ma Yesu dwogo ni coko jupare.
    Piny de ucido col dit, ere rupiny biwok;
    E dwong’ bicaru polo ceng’ni vut Yesu.

2.	 Kristu e pi m’udhenyni, man pige mit mandha!
     I ng’om abile nyanok i polo abimadhe dit.
     I polo kisa sagre m’ecopo pore ngo,
     E dwong’ ucaru polo ceng’ni vut Yesu.

3.	 Rwoth Yesu e jamerna, man an a jamerne.
     Ejola ndhu i bang’e an m’a jadubo dit.
     Ageno bero pare kum bero para mbe,
     Abicungo ndhu i wang’e ni kum berone.

4.	 An abineno Yesu m’a pido ru pire;
     Ma wang’a tal i bang’e, Ubimo mi bero.
     Apoi pi poyo cinge, jamkermiwic re ngo.
     Nyathi Rombo En e dwong’ne kuca i polo.

title: There’s a Sweet Day Coming
content:
1.	Ceng’ ma dwong’ biwok ba mi poko lembe,
    Ceng’ ma dwong’ biwok nindo ma nok.
    Jumaleng’ ku judubo bipokri acam k’acwic,
    Ibed’ ayika ni ceng’uno?

                   ::Iyikrine?:: Iyikrine ni dwogo pa Yesu?
                   ::Iyikrine?:: ni lembapoka?

2.	 Ceng’ anyong’a biwok ba mutoro mandha,
     Ceng’ anyong’a biwok andhandha. 
     Anyong’a ni ju m’umaru Yesu kende ba, 
     Ibed’ ayika ni ceng’uno?

3.	 Ceng’ mi can biwok ba ceng’ne ceng’ mi ywak,
     Ceng’ mi can biwok nindo ma nok. 
     Ka jadubo biwinjo: “Ai cen kum ang’ei ngo!” 
     Ibed’ ayika ni ceng’uno?

title: I Love Him
content:
1.	Yesu Kristu e nyathin pa Mungu, 
    Yesu Kristu e Jalar mi dhanu. 
    Etho kor yen pi dhanu mi ng’om yu.
    Wulok cwinyu kawono wuyi Yesune.

                      ::Bidwogo:: Edwogo kendo be
                      Nicoko dhanu m’uyie gibed kugi.

2.	 Yesu Kristu con Eai i polo, 
     Elor i ng’om ni bodho judubo,
     Kadok eng’eyo dubo tak de ngo,
     Etho kor yen nilaruwa wa judubo.

3.	 Juguro Yesu wi yen m’athara, 
     M’enyutho ko mer pare ni dhanu, 
     Kara dhanu ginwang’ kwo i bang’e.
     Elwok dubo migi ceke gibed leng’ njwa.

title: Lo, He Comes
content:
1.	Wunen Yesu Ebebino, yang’ Evoyo iwa tho.
    Jumaleng’ rubanga dupa, gibebino kude ndhu
    ::Haleluya x2 Ebibimo dhanu yu::

2.	 Kwond wang’ ceke gibinene, ku jamker i cinge de.
     Ju ma yang’ gicaye bende, man ku ju m’ugure de.
    ::Gin de gibiywak ku can kwa kum gikwero Yesu Rwoth::

3.	 Dhanu ceke yungo nyingi, kum i Rwoth mi Rwodhi kpo
     Dong’ Ibin Ijol ker peri, man ku dwong’ m’lvoyo ko.
     ::Haleluya x2 wan wakio dwogoni::

title: Angels from the
content:
1.	Malaika tuco lembe pi nyathin ma Yesu Rwoth,
    Ma junyolo i adhura pa Rwoth Daudi i Bethlehem.

                 Warum ire, kum Eromo,
                 Wayunge Ubimo mwa.

2.	 Jukwac dupa igi wang’ li ka gineno dwong’ pa Rwoth.
     Ka giwinjo rwong’lembene gicidho kara giyunge.

3.	 Ju ma riek gi ai yo nyangu gibino ni sayu Rwoth.
     Cero telo yo i wang’gi cil m’ecungo ko wi nyathin.

4.	 Ka jukelo nyathin Yesu ni thiere ba Rwoth Mungu.
     Ju maleng’ ma i hekalu gijole Jalar mi ng’om yu.

5.	 Wa jupare ma wacokra ni rwo ire Jalar mwa.
     Waki bino pare kendo wabed ni jumandha i ng’om.

title: Tel wiwa Mungu ku ba ceng’
content:
1.	Tel wiwa Mungu ku ba ceng’, 
    Ka fodi wa n’i ng’om; 
    I lembe ma watimo kpo, 
    In m’itelo wiwa ri, Itelo wiwa ri. 
 
2.	Tek wabeyenyo cora swa, 
    I yo maber ungo; 
    Itirwa Rwoth, i wang’ayo, 
    Kum wayenyo ngo wakier, Wayenyo ngo wakier. 
 
3.	Tek wabewotho kudi ndhu 
    I tic ku ba rupiny, 
    Lembe mwa ceke cungo cu, Kum itelo wiwa ri, Itelo wiwa ri. 
 
4.	Ka lem ma tek uwok iwa 
    De lembe moko mbe; 
    Kum lworo negowa ungo, 
    Kum itelo wiwa ri, Kum itelo wiwa ri.

title: Wafoyo Mungu Rwoth
content:
1.  Wafoyo Mungu Rwoth ku dhogwa man k’adunde; 
    Etimo gin ma dit, E ng’om ku polo pake, 
    Anyong’a negowa; cil ma tinuni de 
    Mugisa pare lwar ubedo dit mandha. 
 
2.  I Mungu mi bero I wothna kpo bed kago, 
     Wabed kud anyong’a, ku kwiocwiny ma sagu. 
     Man gwokwa ku bero, tel wiwa de i yo. 
     I ndiba de konywa cil ma wamond i kwo. 
 
3.  Wafoyi dit Wegwa, ku Wodi de m’Ubimo, 
     Edaru tic pare, ekwayu pi jupare; 
     I Mungu ma acel, ma ng’om ku polo kpo 
     Upaku nyingi dwong’, gibipaku rondo.
